825.description: A white cat with green eyes and purple swirls sits by a lily pad pond, gazing toward a vibrant, swirling psychedelic formation above the water. The surreal scene features colorful faces, a glowing yellow orb containing a cat silhouette, and a perfect mirror reflection in the calm water, all framed by lush green trees under a purple sky.

824.title: Spiral Cat Vision
824.description: A white cat with green eyes stands in the foreground, gazing toward a vibrant cosmic spiral vortex. To the left, a cluster of stylized women's profiles in colorful silhouettes appear to emerge from or observe the swirling psychedelic pattern.

826.title: Vortex Eye Spiral
826.description: A surreal swirling vortex of teal, purple, and red organic forms spirals inward toward a large, detailed green eye with a dark pupil at the center. The composition features intricate circular patterns, dotted lines, and biomorphic shapes flowing dynamically around the central gaze.

827.title: Vibrant Spiral Ancestors
827.description: A psychedelic surreal painting featuring four stylized green-skinned women in profile with elaborate patterned headdresses, emerging from a swirling vortex tunnel of concentric rainbow colors. Horizontal bands with geometric diamond patterns cross the composition against a dynamic background of flowing brushstrokes and dots.

828.title: Surreal Cosmic Eye
828.description: A large cracked red eye with a fiery iris containing a green spiral and white highlight dominates the left side. Flowing colorful tendrils and abstract silhouettes of faces in vibrant hues extend from the eye into a swirling cosmic background filled with circles, spirals, and starry patterns.

829.title: Surreal Baby Head Vortex
829.description: A large, glossy baby's head with blue eyes and rosy cheeks floats above a swirling, multicolored vortex. From its mouth emerges a long, flowing stream of ethereal female figures with flowing hair, intertwined with smaller faces and colorful abstract patterns against a muted gray background.

830.title: Psychedelic Hair Swirls
830.description: A vibrant psychedelic artwork featuring stylized female profiles with elaborate, swirling hair patterns in purple, green, and gold. The figures are set against a geometric checkerboard background with symbolic motifs and small floating demonic or imp-like creatures.

831.title: Buddha Lotus Vortex
831.description: A psychedelic digital artwork featuring a seated Buddha figure in traditional robes with hands in prayer position, positioned above a large blooming lotus flower. The central imagery emerges from a swirling cosmic vortex of concentric rings filled with stars against a dark space-like background.

832.title: Alien Buddha Lotus Vision
832.description: A surreal painting depicts a blue-skinned Buddha-like figure in orange robes holding glowing orbs, with an alien head emerging from above. The alien's tongue extends as a rainbow stream of dripping orbs and symbols into a large, luminous yellow and blue lotus flower against a cosmic starry background.

833.title: Cosmic Vortex Portal
833.description: A surreal psychedelic artwork featuring four stylized female faces with ornate headdresses arranged around a spiraling tunnel that radiates yellow energy beams from a dark central void. The circular composition includes flowing patterns, lightning-like cracks, and floating orbs against a muted purple-gray background.

834.title: Buddha Lotus Spiral
834.description: A vibrant psychedelic artwork depicts a standing Buddha figure in green robes beside a large glowing pink lotus flower. They float above a hypnotic swirling vortex of concentric circles in rainbow hues against a starry cosmic background, with three stylized female faces on the right.

836.title: Silhouette in Cosmic Landscape
836.description: A silhouetted woman in traditional patterned robe walks along a winding orange path under a large, vibrant pink and purple spiral portal in the night sky. The surreal scene includes bare black trees, a large red chrysanthemum, rolling green hills, and a starry background with colorful circular patterns.

835.title: Buddha Lotus Fleur-de-Lis
835.description: A vibrant digital artwork split into two panels. The left features a glowing golden Buddha standing on a large luminous lotus flower containing five silhouetted African faces, set against a starry night sky with decorative patterned borders; the right shows a large ornate fleur-de-lis symbol in green and yellow on a purple background with bubble motifs.

837.title: Mystic Wanderer at Twilight
837.description: A silhouetted figure in a patterned robe walks across orange sand dunes beneath a large black crescent moon and a vibrant pink-purple swirling vortex in the night sky. A leafless tree frames the surreal scene with shooting stars and glowing celestial orbs above a green horizon.

838.title: Alien and Cosmic Flower
838.description: A grey skeletal alien with large yellow eyes crouches on cracked dark ground, holding the stem of an enormous vibrant red flower. The flower's petals contain stylized human faces and figures while a woman's profile emerges from its center, set against a starry green and black cosmic sky filled with planets and celestial bodies.

839.title: Surreal Desert Heartscape
839.description: A surreal painting depicts a woman in a green patterned dress walking across orange sand dunes while dragging a large, melting blue wave-like structure. In the foreground a cracked black heart with dripping edges frames a miniature landscape of trees and a path, set against a vibrant sky with a glowing purple sun and floating geometric shapes.

821.title: Whirling Underwater Voyagers
821.description: Two figures in ornate diving suits ride a large mechanical fish through a swirling vortex of blue water. A vibrant cosmic burst of red, purple and yellow radiates from the top with floating sea creatures and intricate golden gears surrounding them.

840.title: Surreal Cosmic Dreamscape
840.description: A vibrant surreal night scene featuring a large twisted black tree silhouette against a starry purple sky. A glowing pink cosmic orb with swirling patterns and rings dominates the center, surrounded by transparent bubbles containing stylized female profiles, while crystalline blue and purple mountains form the foreground.

842.title: Desert Portal Queen
842.description: A queen in ornate golden robes and crown walks across orange desert dunes toward a large circular portal showing a starry sunset over mountains. To the right, giant glowing mushrooms with green caps and purple stems grow on a patch of grass under a swirling purple sky with a bright sun.

841.title: Psychedelic Horses and Lotus
841.description: A vibrant surreal desert scene featuring three stylized horses walking along a winding path. A massive red and green lotus mandala radiates from the left side while yin-yang symbols float in the air against a split green and orange sky with stylized clouds and figures on a distant hill.

843.title: Cosmic Beetle Ride
843.description: A vibrant surreal scene shows three women with colorful afro hairstyles riding a giant stylized beetle over a glowing city skyline at twilight. A large silhouetted tree with intricate foliage frames the left side while a swirling pink cosmic portal and crescent moon dominate the psychedelic night sky.

844.title: Floral Women Portrait
844.description: A vibrant psychedelic artwork depicts four women in profile with green, yellow, blue, and purple skin tones, their heads adorned with large red chrysanthemums and a bouquet of orange tulips. The background features a gradient from teal to green with colorful spiral and circular patterns in pink, orange, and yellow.

846.title: Psychedelic Alien Vision
846.description: A surreal psychedelic artwork featuring a black silhouette of a woman with a crescent moon and swirling pink galaxy where her head should be. A green alien with large sparkling eyes and sharp teeth emerges from a purple portal, reaching out, set against a vibrant cosmic background with stylized flowers and patterned faces.

845.title: Desert Corn Can Alien
845.description: A surreal desert scene at twilight features a woman in a patterned yellow robe walking away while scattering golden particles. In the center, a green alien with large orange eyes emerges from a metal trash can adorned with corn, standing between her and a horned male figure with a glowing cracked head.

847.title: Surreal Eye and Orange Cat
847.description: A vibrant psychedelic painting dominated by a large stylized eye with a vertical red-orange slit pupil and fiery iris. An orange cat walks along a swirling colorful spiral path in the foreground while the background features jagged multicolored mountains and floating transparent bubbles containing smaller scenes.

848.title: Surreal Eye and Cat
848.description: A large stylized eye with a vertical red iris and tentacle-like eyelashes floats in a psychedelic sky above a volcanic landscape. An orange patterned cat leaps across a vibrant, multicolored flowing path in the foreground.

850.title: Cosmic Steampunk Egg
850.description: A large cracked beige egg with an orange beak and big blue eyes stands on mechanical bird legs, covered in miniature buildings and gears. A fiery orange cat with flaming tail leaps from a swirling rainbow vortex while abstract figures, symbols, and flame patterns float in a vibrant green and multicolored background.

849.title: Cosmic Eye Over Earth
849.description: A surreal painting depicts a massive red-eyed tentacled entity hovering above a vibrant, molten Earth wrapped in glowing purple and green serpentine forms. Below, green humanoid figures with raised arms stand on cracked volcanic ground as lava flows from a central fissure beneath the planet.

851.title: Psychedelic Skull Voyage
851.description: A woman in a small wooden boat rows across a calm lake at night, gazing up at a giant, colorful, exploding skull floating in the sky. The surreal scene features vibrant aurora borealis, glowing orbs, and psychedelic patterns over a distant forested shoreline.

852.title: Cosmic Orange Cat
852.description: A vibrant surreal painting features a bright orange cat with a spiraling tail resting within a swirling purple and pink vortex resembling a galaxy. Surrounding the cosmic scene are multiple stylized female faces with green and purple hair, enclosed in translucent bubbles decorated with flowers, stars, and swirling patterns against a dark starry background.

854.title: Cosmic Cat and Melting Blob
854.description: A vibrant surreal painting features an orange tabby cat with green eyes leaping from a swirling purple and black vortex. A large blue melting creature with oversized yellow-green eyes and a worried expression drips onto the ground, connected by a thick braided purple tendril.

853.title: Cosmic Portal Vision
853.description: A surreal painting depicts a large turquoise and purple swirling vortex portal framed by cracked ice-like stones, set against a vibrant cosmic background with shooting stars and nebulae. Within the portal, stylized human figures in green and yellow patterns gaze into the swirling abyss, surrounded by abstract decorative elements in the corners.

855.title: Cosmic Dragon Witch
855.description: A vibrant psychedelic painting shows a green-skinned woman with flowing multicolored hair standing in profile as an orange cat with spiral patterns walks across her shoulders. Below her a long, colorful Chinese-style dragon with yellow accents curves through the scene against a swirling purple cosmic background filled with stars.

856.title: Cosmic Dream Weaver
856.description: A vibrant stylized portrait of a woman in profile with elaborate, flowing hair that transforms into a swirling cosmic galaxy. An orange cat leaps from her hair into the colorful vortex of stars and nebulae against a bright orange background.

858.title: Cosmic Cat and Fiery Eye
858.description: A vibrant orange cat with a long flowing tail reaches toward a giant stylized eye with a glowing red-orange iris. The eye is embedded in a swirling cosmic vortex of purple, pink, and teal patterns surrounded by floating colorful orbs.

857.title: Surreal Cosmic Eye
857.description: A vibrant surreal painting centered on a large stylized human eye with a red sclera and intricate blue and green patterns in the iris containing two silhouetted faces. The composition features horizontal bands of color depicting boats with figures on turquoise waters, green and yellow patterned lower sections, all set against a dark cosmic background with constellations, stars, and red vein-like lines radiating outward.

859.title: Woman and Cosmic Cat
859.description: A woman in a flowing lavender headscarf and robe gazes left at a vibrant orange tabby cat floating beside her. Swirling ribbons of magenta, lime green, and purple emanate from the cat against a starry cosmic portal in the background.

860.title: Surreal Cracked Eye Landscape
860.description: A large, cracked red eye dominates the surreal composition, its iris containing a silhouetted figure within swirling yellow patterns and green foliage. The eye is surrounded by floating stylized faces, swirling motifs, a setting sun, and lush green vegetation emerging from the right side against a muted green background.

861.title: Cosmic Veil Spiral
861.description: A stylized portrait of a woman in profile with a translucent veil, gazing toward a vibrant swirling cosmic vortex filled with stars. Colorful wavy bands with orange circular motifs flow across the composition against a deep blue background.

862.title: Cosmic Teal Owl
862.description: A vibrant, stylized painting of a large translucent teal owl with concentric rainbow eyes and a red beak, set against flowing waves of green, red, and white. The owl is surrounded by multiple circular portraits of women with elaborate updos in various skin tones, interspersed with geometric shapes and decorative patterns.

863.title: Surreal Eye Portrait
863.description: A large cracked and veined red eye with golden ornate patterns in the iris, held by a feminine hand with pink nails. In the background, a stylized purple and green female face with closed eyes appears amid glowing circular motifs.

865.title: Vibrant Psychedelic Portrait
865.description: A stylized portrait of a woman's face with closed eyes, her skin and flowing hair covered in colorful paint splashes, swirls, and circular patterns. A hand with painted nails rests gently on her cheek, with vibrant drips and abstract elements extending outward against a muted background.

864.title: Alien Cooking Cosmic Feast
864.description: A vibrant surreal painting depicts a green alien in a purple apron stirring a large copper pot of melting quesadillas with purple steam rising, while a robed sun goddess with an elaborate orange headdress stands beside with open arms. The psychedelic scene includes a starry sky with constellations, a ringed planet, flying tacos, and a colorful layered landscape with circular portals containing faces.

866.title: Friendly Monster in Meadow
866.description: A massive, smiling green monster with large sparkling eyes and flower decorations leans over a colorful hillside path. Four women in vibrant patterned dresses and headwraps stand together in the foreground, gazing up at the gentle giant as a bright sun rises over rolling green hills.

867.title: Lime Dog Whisper
867.description: A vibrant lime-green dog portrait with intricate spiral patterns and psychedelic details, its head filling most of the frame. A human hand with decorated nails gently touches the dog's snout against a pastel background of concentric circles and small cartoonish figures.

868.title: Desert to Forest Journey
868.description: A vibrant surreal painting depicts a winding path transitioning from a red desert with cacti on the left to a lush green forest on the right. Four stylized female figures with intricate patterns stand in the foreground, facing a large red sun with a human profile and radiating rays in the sky.

869.title: Celestial Baby Orb
869.description: A surreal painting features a large disembodied baby head with blue eyes, rosy cheeks, and golden dots floating in the center. Smaller stylized figures with green and yellow skin hold a miniature version of the head while abstract golden circles, swirling lines, and additional faces populate the muted green background.

871.title: Psychedelic Smiley Horses
871.description: A vibrant surreal painting depicts a large green smiley face with eyelashes floating over swirling water patterns on the left. Two ornate green horses with purple manes, covered in intricate patterns and smiley faces, gallop through the scene under a bright orange sun with radiating beams.

870.title: Psychedelic Oracle Scream
870.description: A surreal painting of a green-skinned figure with closed eyes and an open mouth screaming, their multicolored tongue extending towards a large cracked red eye with a smaller green figure inside its pupil. The background is a starry cosmic space with swirling psychedelic patterns.

872.title: Eye of the Eternal Bloom
872.description: A surreal painting features a large, bloodshot red eye with a golden iris and green pupil, cracked like dry earth and weeping tears. To the right, a serene woman with dark skin and a golden patterned headwrap emerges from lush green foliage beneath a radiant orange sun.

873.title: Emerging Alien Forest Beings
873.description: A surreal painting depicts a line of four green-skinned humanoid aliens with large golden eyes emerging from dense jungle foliage. A bright orange sun with radiating rays appears in the upper left while clusters of colorful circular cells or bubbles float across the right side of the composition.

874.title: Mosaic Elder and Green Dog
874.description: A surreal portrait of an elderly man with a cracked, mosaic-like face filled with tiny family scenes, one large red eye with radiating patterns, and a bright green dog with intricate spiral designs positioned to his right. The dark background contains floating colorful orbs with embedded figures and black spiral motifs.

875.title: Fragmented Man and Canine
875.description: A surreal painted portrait shows an elderly man's face on the left, composed of cracked mosaic-like fragments revealing smaller faces within. A vibrant green dog-like creature with red eyes emerges from the center, overlapping a large cracked circular form containing a detailed red eye on the right.

876.title: Mosaic Mind and Jellyfish
876.description: A surreal psychedelic painting features a large cracked mosaic head with multiple faces embedded in its surface, positioned on a decorative pedestal. A pink octopus-like creature with many eyes melts over the pedestal while extending tentacles into the head's mouth, as a large green jellyfish with cartoon eyes floats nearby.

877.title: Psychedelic Green Dog
877.description: A vibrant surreal painting features a large lime-green dog in profile with intricate purple patterns on its ear, surrounded by swirling psychedelic motifs. To the right, a smiling blue mushroom character with red cap stands in reflective water next to a smaller yellow mushroom, all set against a dark background filled with hidden faces and organic forms.

878.title: Cosmic Eye Sorceress
878.description: A surreal painting of a giant stylized human eye with a cracked sclera in purple, red, and gold tones. Inside the iris, a night sky scene shows a woman with flowing green hair wearing a patterned robe, standing and gazing at a large purple moon with four golden silhouetted figures.

880.title: Green Dog Ouroboros
880.description: Psychedelic green dog with intricate patterns intertwined with a looping serpent-like body forming an infinity symbol. The creature has a detailed patterned ear, yellow eyes, and extended tongue against a purple background with circular motifs.

879.title: Mosaic Gothic Portrait
879.description: A large-scale surreal mosaic portrait of an elderly man's face and shoulders, constructed from fragmented colorful tiles containing smaller scenes of stylized figures and patterns. The background features a dark gothic castle with illuminated windows under a blood-red stormy sky with floating figures and dripping paint effects.

881.title: Surreal Eye of Equus
881.description: A large cracked white orb dominates the center, containing a vivid red and golden eye surrounded by purple and pink flowers on vines. Two brown horses stand in a green rolling landscape with a wooden fence, flanked by stylized female profile faces adorned with flowers against a dark purple background with spiral patterns.

882.title: Fragmented Mind Balloon
882.description: Surreal portrait of an elderly man with a cracked and fragmented face revealing colorful patterned pieces, attached to a vibrant, dripping hot air balloon made of melting green, yellow, and magenta shapes. Small human figures ride in a basket suspended from the balloon against a muted purple background with floating circles.

883.title: Green Dog and Crystal Orb
883.description: A vibrant green dog covered in intricate black patterns and swirls stands in profile, gazing toward a large glowing crystal orb. Inside the orb is a surreal landscape with orange and pink mountains under a sunset sky, floating geometric shapes, and circular patterns, set against a dark purple and blue background with abstract yellow terrain.

884.title: Psychedelic Bubble Portrait
884.description: A surreal digital artwork featuring multiple iridescent bubbles floating against a dark teal background. Each bubble contains stylized female profiles with intricate green and gold swirling patterns in their hair, connected by flowing lime-green liquid forms and drips.

885.title: Infinity Bubbles
885.description: A surreal painting featuring a glowing green infinity symbol at the center, surrounded by clusters of translucent pink and magenta bubbles containing green abstract forms. Paint drips and splatters flow from the bubbles against a swirling dark blue and turquoise background.

886.title: Pink Castle in Bubbles
886.description: A surreal painting depicts a glowing pink block with a melting castle structure on top, dripping viscous pink liquid onto a black, tiered platform. The dark background is filled with translucent bubbles containing colorful stylized female profiles and abstract patterns, surrounded by green and yellow abstract shapes.

887.title: Lime Dragon Infinity
887.description: A vibrant fantasy illustration of a serpentine dragon with a female human-like face, coiled into an infinity loop. The creature has deep purple scales, bright green slime drips, golden horns, and is set against a swirling purple and turquoise cloudy sky with decorative golden symbols.

888.title: Cabbage Mandala of Faces
888.description: A surreal circular composition features concentric layers of vibrant green cabbage leaves spiraling inward toward a glowing red core. Female faces with closed eyes emerge from the leaf edges, surrounded by floating translucent bubbles containing smaller faces, spirals, and floral elements against a dark blue background.

889.title: Silhouette in Cosmic Dream
889.description: A vibrant surreal painting features a black silhouette of a woman in an elegant gown, adorned with ornate golden jewelry, standing before a massive red moon. Translucent blue bubbles containing smaller silhouetted figures float around her against a swirling, multicolored sky.

890.title: Psychedelic Waterfall Scene
890.description: A vibrant psychedelic landscape featuring a bright green waterfall cascading into a turquoise pool with glowing concentric circles. Three stylized women with green skin and elaborate colorful hair adornments occupy the foreground, set against rolling hills, pine trees, and distant purple mountains under a teal sky.

891.title: Bubbles of Memory
891.description: A woman with vibrant red hair and bangs is shown in profile, facing right as she blows a stream of translucent pink bubbles. Each bubble contains miniature scenes and figures, including yellow cat-like creatures and human forms, set against a swirling cosmic background of deep blue and luminous green.

892.title: Bubble Arrow Portrait
892.description: A stylized portrait of a woman with glowing orange eyes and intricate purple braided hair adorned with beads and patterns. A large iridescent bubble containing her mirrored reflection is pierced by a feathered arrow, with colorful liquid dripping from the puncture against a dark background.

893.title: Psychedelic Queen Portrait
893.description: A vibrant profile portrait of a green-skinned queen with purple curly hair, wearing an ornate golden crown. Ethereal green liquid flows from the crown against a turquoise background filled with flowers, circles, and mathematical symbols.

894.title: Eternal Transition
894.description: A surreal painting shows four identical profiles of a serene green-haired woman with closed eyes and braided hair, fading from vibrant yellow-green on the left into translucent ghostly forms. On the right, three black skeletal grim reaper figures with red dripping liquid stand in hooded robes against a background of overlapping colorful spirals and concentric circles.

896.title: Psychedelic Bubble Portraits
896.description: A vibrant psychedelic composition features two large circular frames containing stylized female profile heads with elaborate swirling hair patterns in bright colors. The pink background radiates with colorful starburst lines while surrounded by numerous translucent blue bubbles of varying sizes, some containing smaller abstract figures.

895.title: Psychedelic Bubble Portraits
895.description: A vibrant surreal painting featuring multiple stylized female profiles in green, yellow, and pink, enclosed within overlapping translucent blue bubbles against a radiating pink and orange background. The composition includes smaller floating bubbles with miniature figures and radiating lines creating a dynamic, explosive effect from the center.

897.title: Cactus Dream Bubbles
897.description: A vibrant surreal landscape features green cactus stalks with human faces inside translucent iridescent bubbles floating above a yellow hill. Colorful stylized flowers in yellow, orange, and red bloom from the cacti against a swirling pastel sky with decorative circular patterns.

898.title: Wolf Spirit Collective
898.description: A vibrant surreal painting depicts a large green wolf in profile facing left, its head and neck filled with intricate patterns and multiple overlapping female faces in purple, pink, and teal. The background is a textured pink field populated by numerous floating blue orbs with red outlines and small decorative elements.

900.title: Wolf Queen with Bubbles
900.description: A surreal digital painting features a large, stylized purple and black wolf with glowing yellow eyes, wearing a golden crown. A woman in a flowing purple gown sits on an ornate throne in front of the wolf's neck, surrounded by iridescent soap bubbles against a vibrant patterned background.

899.title: Triune Cosmic Eye
899.description: A surreal psychedelic artwork featuring three colorful profiled female heads with horns and spiral patterns emerging from a central large bloodshot eyeball with a fiery red and black swirling vortex pupil. The heads are green, teal, and purple with ornate circular decorations, set against radiating colorful rays and a burning cracked ground with thorny vines below.

901.title: Galloping Horses in Cosmic Orbs
901.description: Two vibrant green horses with swirling patterns gallop toward each other across colorful, wavy ground patterns while colorful paint-like splashes erupt between them. The background features multiple blue circular orbs containing stylized female profiles with golden headdresses on a peach-colored field, with one larger central orb showing a green-haired profile.

902.title: Cosmic White Cat
902.description: A luminous white cat with vibrant green eyes sits upright in the foreground, gazing toward the viewer. Behind it, a swirling vortex of colorful light radiates outward, featuring stylized human and Buddha-like faces floating in a psychedelic cosmic stream.

903.title: Bubble Women Portrait
903.description: A vibrant psychedelic artwork depicts multiple stylized female faces with elaborate spiral hair inside large translucent soap bubbles. The faces feature bold, flat colors in green, yellow, pink, and purple against a swirling cosmic background of blended hues.

904.title: Eternal Cycle of Life
904.description: A surreal painting shows four identical green-skinned women in profile with long braided hair, their eyes closed in serene meditation. Below them stand six black skeletons with glowing red vascular systems, blood pooling at their feet against a vibrant background of concentric psychedelic spirals.

905.title: Surreal Feminine Still Life
905.description: A vibrant surreal painting featuring four overlapping profiles of women with green hair and ornate earrings, merging into swirling patterns. The scene includes a vintage yellow camera on a red plaid cloth, a pink bowl filled with flowers and lavender, floating orange slices, and abstract decorative elements on a deep maroon background.

906.title: Queen and Skeleton Horde
906.description: A silhouetted queen with a golden crown and flowing yellow hair sits on a purple platform holding a small purple orb, facing a procession of seven black skeletons with red dripping blood and visible ribcages. The skeletons stand in a group against a vibrant red and lime green swirling psychedelic background with yellow spiral patterns and red liquid pooling on the ground.

907.title: Emerald Trinity and Orb
907.description: Three identical female profiles with elaborate green spiral hair and ornate necklaces face right, their hair flowing and merging into a large glowing green orb encircled by orange rings. The surreal painting features dripping paint effects in green and yellow against a muted purple background.

908.title: Queen of Skeletons
908.description: A crowned purple queen sits on a purple throne as a line of black skeletons with glowing eyes and red ribcages stand before her holding skulls. Green energy streams flow from the queen toward the skeletons against a vibrant red and orange swirling background filled with skull motifs and yellow silhouettes.

911.title: Ethereal Green Goddesses
911.description: Four stylized female profiles with closed eyes merge into one another, their hair transforming into flowing green waves that culminate in a large glowing orb filled with orange branching patterns. The figures feature intricate patterns, golden sun earrings, and dripping paint effects against a muted background.

910.title: Queen of Skulls
910.description: A crowned purple-skinned queen with long flowing golden hair sits on a throne, holding a scepter while addressing a group of twelve black skeletons with glowing green eyes and red liquid dripping from their mouths and bodies. The background is a vibrant psychedelic composition of swirling green, red, and orange patterns with circular motifs and dripping effects.

909.title: Fourfold Green Oracle
909.description: A surreal painting shows four identical female profiles in a row, each with long flowing green hair adorned with intricate spirals, circles, and dripping patterns. They gaze toward a glowing spherical orb on the right that mirrors their colors with green, yellow, and orange dripping forms against a muted purple-gray background.

912.title: Queen of the Undead
912.description: A regal purple-skinned queen with a golden crown and dripping colorful hair sits on a patterned throne holding a staff topped with a bleeding skull. She is surrounded by a procession of black skeleton figures with red liquid dripping from their eye sockets against a vibrant radiating background.

914.title: Queen and Skeleton Court
914.description: A dark-skinned queen with a golden crown sits at a purple table, facing a line of five identical black skeletons with red blood dripping from their skulls and ribcages. The skeletons stand behind the table as if in a macabre procession against a vibrant, explosive background of swirling flames and patterns.

916.title: Queen of the Undead
916.description: A crowned skeletal queen with long flowing golden hair sits on a throne, facing a procession of seven black skeletons with melting red faces and dripping red liquid from their eye sockets. The surreal scene is set against a swirling psychedelic background of red, orange, and green spirals populated with floating skulls and small silhouetted figures.

915.title: Four Green Goddesses
915.description: A surreal painting featuring four identical women in profile with long flowing green hair adorned with golden sun and eye motifs. To their right floats a large translucent green orb containing faint reflections of their faces, set against a muted lavender background with radiating colorful rings and dripping paint effects.

913.title: Emerald Goddesses in Harmony
913.description: A surreal painting featuring five identical green-skinned female profiles in a row, their hair flowing with intricate Celtic spirals and decorative patterns. The rightmost figure merges into a glowing green orb containing two colorful, ethereal female faces surrounded by vibrant bubbles and drips.

917.title: Emerging Goddess Vision
917.description: A surreal painting shows four identical female profiles with closed eyes and vibrant green flowing hair lined up horizontally. Their hair transforms into a large glowing orb on the right containing layered translucent faces amid swirling patterns and dripping paint effects.

918.title: Queen of the Undead
918.description: A regal skeletal queen with long flowing golden hair sits on a purple throne, wearing an ornate crown and purple robe. She is attended by a chained line of seven identical bloody-eyed skeleton figures standing in formation against a vibrant red and green swirling background filled with skulls.

919.title: Emerging Green Goddesses
919.description: A surreal painting of five identical female profiles in a row, their skin and flowing hair rendered in vibrant shades of green with intricate patterns and dripping paint effects. They face a large glowing orb on the right containing a radiant sun-like spiral and a faint sixth female face, set against a muted lavender background with floating circular motifs.

920.title: Queen of the Damned
920.description: A crowned queen in a purple dress sits on a purple throne extending her hand toward a group of seven black skeletons with glowing yellow eyes. Red liquid drips from their eye sockets, jaws, and the queen's crown and dress against a vibrant red and orange background filled with swirling green patterns and floating skulls.

922.title: Queen of the Damned
922.description: A blue-skinned queen with a golden crown and flowing green hair sits on a purple throne, gazing left. She is accompanied by a row of black dripping skeletons with glowing red eyes and mouths against a swirling psychedelic background of red, orange, and green with skull motifs.

923.title: Green-haired Goddesses and Sun
923.description: A surreal painting shows four identical women in profile with long flowing green hair, positioned in a row facing right. Their forms gradually fade and merge into a large glowing green and yellow sun with orange rays on the right side of the composition.

921.title: Emerald Goddesses and Orb
921.description: Four identical green-skinned female profiles with elaborate swirling hair and golden facial markings stand in a row, their hair and faces dripping with green liquid. A large glowing green orb with a yellow halo contains a similar female face and colorful swirls, with liquid dripping from it onto the ground.

924.title: Queen and Skeleton Retinue
924.description: A regal queen in a purple gown and golden crown sits on a throne holding a small skull, gazing upward. She is attended by six identical black skeletons with glowing green eyes, their forms dripping with red and green liquid against a vibrant, psychedelic background of swirling patterns, crowns, and lightning bolts.

926.title: Queen of the Damned
926.description: A crowned skeletal queen with long flowing blonde hair stands at a balcony, her mouth dripping blood. Below her, a line of black skeletons with glowing yellow eyes and red dripping substance stand in formation against a swirling psychedelic background.

925.title: Green Triune Oracle
925.description: Four identical green female figures with ornate patterns and dripping paint are shown in profile facing a glowing green orb containing celestial symbols and orbiting lines. The surreal composition features yellow drips and circular motifs against a muted gray background.

927.title: Fourfold Green Oracle
927.description: Four identical green-skinned female figures in profile face right, connected as one being with ornate golden headdresses and dripping paint textures. A large glowing green orb with orange-yellow center is connected by a flowing green tendril from the figures' mouths, set against a muted background with colorful circular patterns.

928.title: Queen of Skeletons
928.description: A blue-skinned queen with long flowing yellow hair and a golden crown sits on a purple throne, gazing at six red-robed skeletons standing in a line. The skeletons have glowing red eyes and black glossy skulls, set against a vibrant psychedelic background of dripping skulls and swirling patterns.

929.title: Green Goddess Spiral
929.description: Four green-skinned female profiles with elaborate green hair and facial markings face left in a row. Their flowing hair merges into a large circular psychedelic spiral of concentric green, yellow, and orange rings containing two smaller faces, all set against a muted gray background with starbursts and dripping paint effects.

931.title: Green Goddesses Orb
931.description: Four identical green-skinned female figures in profile are merged side-by-side, their long flowing hair and bodies dripping with vibrant green and yellow liquid. They collectively reach with elongated arms toward a large glowing green orb featuring concentric spiral patterns, set against a radiant orange halo.

930.title: Queen of the Damned
930.description: A vibrant surreal painting depicts a crowned purple-skinned queen with long flowing golden hair sitting on a purple platform, gazing at a group of seven black dripping skeletons with glowing red eyes. The background features bold concentric circles, melting skull motifs, and dripping red and green liquid forms against a black field.

933.title: Stasis and Pandemonium
933.description: A surreal psychedelic scene featuring a blue-skinned figure with golden tears and ornate headpiece standing beside a black silhouetted demonic entity with glowing pink eyes. The room has vibrant orange walls covered in circular patterns and dancing figures, with 'STASIS' and 'PANDEMONIUM' written on opposite walls under a starry cosmic arch.

932.title: Surreal Psychedelic Portrait
932.description: A vibrant surreal painting depicts a woman's face split in color, with the left side blue and the right side featuring intricate patterns. A large green dog-like creature with swirling designs rests its head on top of hers, while a massive cracked red eye with a yin-yang pupil drips golden liquid on the right.

934.title: Psychedelic Green Dog
934.description: A surreal painting of a large green dog with intricate black patterns and a metallic dripping texture, shown in profile facing right. The dog stands before a large yellow circular backdrop against a dark blue and purple cosmic background filled with floating transparent bubbles containing stylized human figures and ornate yellow designs.

935.title: Cybernetic Demon Eye
935.description: A metallic android with glowing yellow eyes and the word 'DEMON' on its forehead is connected by a red tendril to a massive biomechanical eye featuring a red iris, internal orbs, and clockwork elements. The surreal composition is set against a swirling psychedelic background populated with small green demons and intricate patterns.

936.title: Stasis Clock Surreal
936.description: Four identical hooded skeletal figures with long black braids stand in a row, red and green liquid dripping from their eye sockets and robes. To their right, a large colorful clock with Roman numerals displays the word STASIS in glowing green letters, surrounded by swirling psychedelic patterns and a cluster of glossy blue spheres with neon spikes.

938.title: Four Emerald Nymphs
938.description: Four identical female profiles with golden skin and flowing green hair adorned with spiral patterns stand in a row facing left. A large ornate dragonfly perches on the head of the rightmost figure against a soft purple background filled with smaller dragonflies and glowing golden swirls.

939.title: Psychedelic Waterfall Vision
939.description: A vibrant surreal scene depicts a multicolored waterfall flowing from a dark stone cliff into a glowing pool, with the water formed from intricate human-like figures. In the foreground, rows of stylized green and yellow profiles with elaborate headdresses face the waterfall, while a radiant mandala-like sunburst radiates from the top center against a backdrop of floating spirals and red demonic faces.

941.title: Braided Goddess and Blue Oracle
941.description: Four identical green-haired women with long ornate braids stand in profile behind a cosmic table, facing a surprised blue creature with lightning-bolt eyes and a sunburst halo. The creature gestures in awe toward a swirling yellow, green, and purple portal on the starry surface.

940.title: Crown of the Grim Council
940.description: A group of seven skeletal figures in ornate black robes with gold patterns stand in a row, their skulls dripping long streams of red liquid. One skeleton holds a golden staff while another reaches toward an elaborate golden crown adorned with skulls, jewels, and pearls resting on a purple cushion.

942.title: Psychedelic Volcanic Vision
942.description: A surreal painting featuring overlapping female faces with vibrant green and purple skin, surrounded by swirling colorful patterns and tentacle-like hair. In the background, erupting volcanoes spew lava across a cracked fiery landscape beneath a dark sky, while a large red eye with tentacles floats above.

943.title: Psychedelic Surreal Portrait
943.description: A vibrant surreal portrait of a green-skinned woman with large yellow eyes and black lips, her elaborate hair formed from colorful swirling patterns, tentacles, and eye motifs. In the background, two erupting volcanoes spew lava flows across a dark landscape with small silhouetted figures, while a massive red-orange eye with a star pupil emerges from the right side of her head.

944.title: Mosaic Woman and Orange Horse
944.description: A surreal portrait of a woman whose face and neck are covered in a black mosaic or stained-glass pattern filled with vibrant orange, yellow, and pink circles. An orange horse stands beside her in a field of pink flowers against a green background filled with swirling psychedelic patterns.

945.title: Bear and Poppy Woman
945.description: A vibrant psychedelic portrait shows the profile of a smiling woman with intricate green swirling hair adorned with red poppies merging with the head of a friendly brown bear. The bear has bright blue eyes while the woman has one blue eye and one yellow star-patterned eye, surrounded by floating paw prints and additional poppies against a colorful swirling background.

946.title: Geometric Woman and Orange Horse
946.description: A vibrant psychedelic portrait of a woman whose face and neck are covered in a mosaic of bright pink, lime green, and yellow triangular patterns. An orange horse gallops beside her face while her multicolored hair flows into swirling psychedelic patterns against a dark green background filled with pink flowers.

947.title: Woman and Bear with Poppies
947.description: A vibrant psychedelic portrait of a woman with flowing, multicolored swirling hair intertwined with large orange poppies. Beside her is a friendly brown bear with oversized sparkling blue eyes, both surrounded by floral patterns and decorative circles on a dark green background.

948.title: Psychedelic Woman and Horse
948.description: A vibrant surreal portrait of a woman's face and flowing hair merges with colorful geometric patterns and black line art. An orange horse stands beside her amid pink flowers in a rolling green landscape under a multicolored sky.

949.title: Woman and Bear Portrait
949.description: A vibrant psychedelic portrait of a woman with flowing orange and pink hair adorned with large red poppies, positioned beside a brown bear with large luminous blue eyes. The background features swirling patterns in green, purple, and yellow with circular motifs and floating flowers.

950.title: Psychedelic Portrait with Orange Horse
950.description: A vibrant surreal portrait of a woman with long flowing multicolored hair, her face divided into black and white with geometric triangular patterns in bright yellow, purple, and blue. An orange horse with white spots stands beside her amidst a psychedelic green landscape filled with large pink flowers, swirls, and abstract patterns.

953.title: Poppy Woman and Bear
953.description: A vibrant, stylized portrait of a woman with intricate face paint and flowing psychedelic hair made of swirling patterns and poppy flowers, positioned beside a brown bear with matching colorful facial designs. They are surrounded by large red-orange poppies, green leaves, and a decorative background of floral and geometric motifs.

952.title: Psychedelic Mosaic Portrait
952.description: A surreal portrait of a woman's face composed of purple and yellow mosaic fragments, with flowing dark hair. She stands in a vibrant field of pink flowers beside an orange horse, set against a green landscape with spiral patterns and silhouette faces in the background.

951.title: Psychedelic Bear Woman
951.description: A vibrant portrait of a woman with blue hair, bear ears, and intricate henna-like patterns on her face, surrounded by large red poppies and swirling foliage.

954.title: Psychedelic Woman and Horse
954.description: A vibrant surreal artwork depicts the left half of a woman's face in detailed black and white linework, while her right side transforms into a mosaic of colorful geometric triangles containing eyes and spirals. An orange horse with purple mane stands in a lush field of pink flowers and DNA-like spirals, set against a swirling green landscape with floating orbs and decorative patterns.

955.title: Psychedelic Bear Woman Portrait
955.description: A vibrant surreal portrait of a woman with bear-like features including rounded ears and a brown bear snout, blue eyes, and a third eye on her forehead. She has long flowing red hair adorned with red poppies, set against a swirling psychedelic background with colorful patterns and dripping paint effects.

956.title: Surreal Mosaic Woman with Horse
956.description: A vibrant surreal portrait of a woman's profiled face filled with geometric mosaic patterns and embedded eyes. An orange horse stands amid oversized pink flowers while the woman's colorful hair flows into swirling psychedelic patterns against a green landscape.

957.title: Psychedelic Poppy Woman and Bear
957.description: A vibrant, stylized portrait of a woman with intricate, multicolored swirling hair adorned with large red poppies, featuring glowing purple eyes and yellow facial patterns. She is accompanied by a colorful, decorated bear with matching psychedelic patterns and glowing eyes, set against a hypnotic background of concentric circles and vibrant patterns.

958.title: Mosaic Woman with Horse
958.description: A vibrant surreal portrait of a woman whose face and neck are covered in a colorful geometric mosaic pattern of triangles and polygons. Her long flowing black hair is adorned with intricate yellow circular patterns as she stands in a green landscape filled with large pink flowers, accompanied by a bright orange horse.

959.title: Floral Woman and Bear
959.description: A vibrant psychedelic portrait of a woman in profile with elaborate, swirling orange hair adorned with red poppies and green leaves. She gazes at a friendly green bear covered in colorful flowers, set against a bright green background with circular patterns.

960.title: Psychedelic Mosaic Woman
960.description: A surreal portrait of a woman with a cracked, multicolored geometric mosaic pattern covering the left side of her face and neck. Her long, flowing hair blends vibrant orange, blue, and black tones while an orange horse stands amid pink and purple flowers against a green, patterned background.

961.title: Woman and Bear Portrait
961.description: A vibrant psychedelic portrait of a woman with flowing orange spiral hair and large heterochromatic eyes, nuzzling a friendly brown bear with bright blue eyes. The composition is surrounded by red and orange poppies, green leaves, and intricate swirling patterns in a colorful mandala background.

962.title: Psychedelic Portrait with Horse
962.description: A surreal portrait of a woman with long flowing black hair, her face fragmented into a vibrant mosaic of geometric shapes and colors. An orange horse gallops through a psychedelic green field filled with large pink flowers and swirling patterns.

963.title: Woman with Bear Mask
963.description: A vibrant psychedelic portrait of a woman with long flowing blue and green hair adorned with orange poppies. She holds a stylized brown bear mask decorated with flowers next to her face, set against a swirling background of green, yellow, and purple patterns.

964.title: Fragmented Dream Portrait
964.description: A vibrant surreal portrait of a young woman with long flowing dark hair, her face and neck composed of a mosaic of geometric shards in greens and purples. She is surrounded by pink flowers, an orange horse figure, swirling green patterns, and abstract geometric shapes in the background.

965.title: Poppy-haired Girl and Bear
965.description: A vibrant surreal portrait shows a young girl in profile with elaborate swirling red-orange poppy hair adorned with flowers and curls. She gently embraces a large stylized purple bear with a bright blue eye, surrounded by floating poppies, oak leaves, and decorative circular patterns in the background.

966.title: Geometric Dreamscape
966.description: A vibrant surreal portrait of a woman whose face is partially covered in colorful geometric triangular patterns, with long flowing multicolored hair. To her right stands an orange horse adorned with patterns and surrounded by pink flowers against a psychedelic rainbow sky and rolling green hills.

969.title: Woman with Two Bears
969.description: Psychedelic portrait of a woman with vibrant red and orange swirling hair adorned with intricate patterns, large green eyes, and dark lips. She is surrounded by two colorful bears with matching psychedelic patterns, blue eyes, and bright red poppies against a lime green background with spiral motifs.

967.title: Girl and Bear with Poppies
967.description: A vibrant psychedelic portrait of a young woman with large expressive eyes and flowing multicolored hair intertwined with bright orange poppies. She is accompanied by a friendly brown bear with large patterned eyes, set against a dark green background filled with swirling yellow and purple spirals.

968.title: Mosaic Woman and Orange Horse
968.description: A vibrant psychedelic artwork featuring the face of a woman whose right side is composed of a colorful mosaic of geometric shapes in pink, green, and yellow. To her right, a bright orange horse gallops through a field of large pink flowers against a swirling green background.

970.title: Psychedelic Portrait with Horse
970.description: A surreal mixed-media portrait of a woman split between black and white line art on the left and vibrant psychedelic colors on the right. An orange horse with spiral patterns stands in the foreground amid a field of pink flowers, with floating moons, geometric shapes, and swirling hair elements filling the composition.
970.medium: digital illustration with ink and acrylic effects

972.title: Surreal Mosaic Horse Portrait
972.description: A vibrant surreal artwork featuring a woman's face in profile with her right side composed of a colorful geometric mosaic. A large orange horse stands prominently in the center, with a smaller orange horse below it, surrounded by pink flowers, green rolling hills, and floating yellow circles containing small figures.

971.title: Woman and Bear Portrait
971.description: Psychedelic portrait of a woman with vibrant orange and red swirling hair adorned with flowers, positioned beside a purple bear with large blue eyes and intricate patterns. The composition features bold poppies with green leaves in the foreground against a bright green background filled with circular motifs, lightning bolts, and swirling lines.

973.title: Psychedelic Poppy Queen
973.description: A vibrant surreal portrait of a woman with swirling multicolored hair adorned with large orange poppies, positioned beside a crowned green bear with blue eyes. The background is filled with concentric psychedelic circles and floral elements in a highly detailed, colorful composition.

975.title: Psychedelic Poppy Bear
975.description: A vibrant portrait of a female brown bear with large sparkling blue eyes and purple lips, adorned with orange poppies in her hair and flowing colorful patterns extending from her head against a swirling green and blue background.

974.title: Mosaic Woman and Horse
974.description: A vibrant surreal portrait of a woman's face and shoulders composed of green, purple, and yellow geometric mosaic fragments with multiple eyes. To her right stands an orange horse covered in pink flowers, set against a rolling green landscape dotted with large pink daisies under a purple sky.

976.title: Woman and Galloping Horse
976.description: A vibrant surreal painting depicts a woman's face and neck on the left, her features fragmented by colorful geometric polygons and intricate patterns. To the right, an orange horse gallops through a field of pink flowers beneath a green sky filled with yellow circles and swirling motifs.

977.title: Psychedelic Poppy Girl
977.description: A vibrant surreal portrait of a woman with a yellow face, elaborate swirling multicolored hair filled with flowers and patterns, and large expressive eyes. She is accompanied by a cute teddy bear with big blue eyes peeking from behind her hair, surrounded by bright orange poppies and green leaves against a purple patterned background.

979.title: Psychedelic Poppy Bear
979.description: A whimsical bear's head is adorned with intricate patterns, vibrant flowers, and mismatched colorful eyes against a purple background. Swirling green and pink floral motifs with orange poppies flow dynamically around the bear's face.

978.title: Psychedelic Portrait with Horse
978.description: A surreal mixed-media portrait of a woman's face with one side rendered in black and white sketch and the other in vibrant colors, her hair and neck transforming into colorful swirling patterns. The background features a bright orange horse standing in a green field with pink flowers, geometric stained-glass shapes, circular motifs, and a patterned green border.

980.title: Fragmented Woman and Horse
980.description: A vibrant surreal portrait of a woman's face split between black and white line art on the left and colorful geometric stained-glass patterns on the right. Her multicolored flowing hair merges with a bright orange horse standing in a psychedelic green landscape filled with pink flowers and abstract patterns.

981.title: Psychedelic Poppy Girl
981.description: A vibrant portrait of a young woman with large blue eyes, red curly hair adorned with bear-like ears, and bright red poppies growing around her face and shoulders. Her lower body merges into swirling green foliage against a dark green background filled with concentric rainbow circles and hypnotic psychedelic patterns.

982.title: Mosaic Woman with Horse
982.description: A vibrant surreal portrait of a woman with cracked porcelain-like skin revealing a colorful geometric mosaic pattern on her face. Her long flowing black hair with yellow streaks merges into a lush garden background filled with large pink and orange flowers, while a bright orange horse stands to her right.

983.title: Psychedelic Poppy Bear
983.description: A vibrant surreal portrait of a woman with flowing, multicolored swirling hair adorned with red poppies, gazing upward. Beside her is a purple teddy bear with large blue eyes and a golden heart nose, also crowned with poppies against a vivid green and purple background.

984.title: Psychedelic Mosaic Portrait
984.description: A vibrant surreal portrait of a woman with long flowing black hair, her face covered in a colorful geometric mosaic of triangles and polygons. An orange horse stands beside her amid pink flowers, with silhouettes of people visible within the horse's body against a psychedelic background of swirling patterns and vibrant hues.

985.title: Woman and Bear Portrait
985.description: A vibrant psychedelic portrait features a woman's face with flowing red-orange hair intertwined with a large bear's head. Both subjects have striking blue eyes and are surrounded by bright orange poppies and swirling green foliage against a patterned background.

987.title: Bear Goddess Portrait
987.description: A vibrant psychedelic portrait of a woman whose face merges with a brown bear's head, featuring blue eyes, long flowing orange hair adorned with red poppies and green leaves, set against a swirling colorful background.

988.title: Mosaic Woman and Orange Horse
988.description: A vibrant surreal portrait of a young woman whose face and neck are partially covered in a colorful geometric mosaic pattern. An orange horse with a flowing mane stands beside her in a field of pink flowers, set against a swirling psychedelic background of green hills, yellow circles, and decorative floral motifs.

989.title: Woman and Bear with Poppies
989.description: A vibrant, stylized portrait of a woman with green swirling hair adorned with large red poppies, positioned beside a friendly purple bear whose face is also decorated with flowers. The composition is filled with intricate psychedelic patterns, green foliage, and a glowing yellow halo effect around the subjects.

990.title: Psychedelic Mosaic Woman
990.description: A surreal portrait of a woman's face split between black and white line art on the right and a vibrant multicolored geometric mosaic on the left. An orange horse with decorative bridle stands beside her against a swirling green and purple psychedelic background filled with pink flowers.

991.title: Woman and Bear with Poppies
991.description: A vibrant psychedelic portrait of a woman with elaborate blue and multicolored swirling hair adorned with poppies, positioned beside a friendly brown bear with blue eyes and geometric facial markings. Both are surrounded by large orange-red poppies and lush green leaves against a background of concentric circles and intricate patterns.

992.title: Surreal Woman's Portrait
992.description: A vibrant psychedelic portrait of a woman's face split into geometric sections with colorful triangular patterns. An orange horse stands amid pink flowers in a green rolling hills landscape, with floating yellow orbs and swirling colorful hair elements.

993.title: Psychedelic Bear Muse
993.description: A vibrant surreal portrait of a woman with flowing multicolored hair adorned with poppies, hearts, and cartoon figures, positioned beside a large blue bear with bright blue and yellow eyes staring directly forward.

994.title: Fragmented Dream Portrait
994.description: A surreal portrait of a woman with long flowing black hair and golden eyes, her face composed of multicolored geometric fragments that appear to be breaking apart. An orange horse with yellow spots gallops through a vibrant field of pink flowers against a green patterned background filled with floral and psychedelic motifs.

995.title: Psychedelic Woman and Bear
995.description: A vibrant surreal portrait of a yellow-skinned woman with swirling multicolored hair adorned with red poppies, holding a blue teddy bear covered in decorative patterns and flowers. The background is a rich purple field filled with circular mandala patterns, hearts, and additional poppies.

996.title: Mosaic Horse Woman
996.description: A vibrant surreal portrait of a woman's face with geometric multicolored triangular patterns covering the right side, while her long flowing black hair transforms into a landscape filled with running orange horses, pink flowers, and green rolling hills in the background.

998.title: Dragon's Rainbow Breath
998.description: A woman with green makeup and a patterned robe stands with her mouth open, exhaling a vibrant torrent of colorful patterned ribbons and tentacles. A large glowing green and yellow dragon coils behind her against a starry cosmic sky filled with constellations and purple clouds.

997.title: Poppy Woman and Bear
997.description: A vibrant psychedelic portrait shows a woman with elaborate, colorful swirling hair adorned with large orange poppies, positioned beside a friendly bear with matching multicolored fur and striking blue eyes. The composition features intricate patterns, floral elements, and a decorative background of concentric circles in green and yellow tones.

999.title: Enchanted Oriental Lake
999.description: A surreal Asian-inspired landscape features traditional pagodas on misty mountains and a reflective lake with boats. Translucent floating orbs in purple, green, and yellow contain stylized female figures with traditional hairstyles and headdresses against a vibrant, dripping watercolor sky.

1001.title: Cosmic Egg Awakening
1001.description: A surreal painting depicts a woman's head with purple curly hair and large green eyes emerging from a cracked egg containing a glowing golden orb. The vibrant pink-orange background radiates with light beams while surrounded by floating purple orbs and circular patterns with spiral and eye motifs.

1000.title: Cabbage Dreamscape
1000.description: A vibrant surreal painting framed by a giant green and purple cabbage leaf. Within the leaf's interior, East Asian women in traditional attire appear alongside a red pagoda, sailboats on reflective water, and misty blue mountains under a swirling green and yellow sky.

1002.title: Surreal Psychedelic Vision
1002.description: A large stylized portrait of a woman with glowing yellow eyes and intricate spiral patterns dominates the left side of a vibrant surreal landscape. In the foreground, a group of people in 1970s attire stand on yellow steps beside two transparent bubbles containing floating eyes, set against a backdrop of colorful mountains and a retro building under a swirling red and orange sky.

1006.title: Lotus Pond Spirit
1006.description: A green-skinned female figure with large, multicolored eyes emerges from a pond filled with vibrant pink lotus flowers. She wears a patterned head covering while psychedelic yellow and purple swirls float across the water and background.

1003.title: Woman Riding Cosmic Dragon
1003.description: A woman with flowing black hair in a vibrant green patterned dress rides a large, ornate dragon with purple and green scales. The dragon breathes orange flames while a swirling green cosmic vine adorned with colorful glowing orbs arcs overhead against a starry purple night sky.

1005.title: Lotus Pond Vision
1005.description: A surreal portrait of a green-skinned figure with one large orange eye and a smaller normal eye, wearing a patterned headwrap adorned with pink lotuses. The figure emerges from swirling psychedelic waters filled with blooming lotus flowers, some containing small faces, against a vibrant background of floating symbols and ethereal figures.

1004.title: Broccoli Spirit Over Lake
1004.description: A vibrant surreal painting featuring a giant smiling broccoli-headed figure with a pagoda on its head, waving from a rocky island in a misty lake. In the foreground, a stylized green-skinned woman with elaborate swirling multicolored hair looks toward the scene while small boats with figures sail on the water below traditional Chinese mountains.

1009.title: Woman and Cosmic Rat
1009.description: A woman with purple hair and a flowing patterned cloak stands gazing up at a giant, vibrant green rat with pink ears. The rat has a long, coiled, scaly tail resembling a serpent, set against a starry purple night sky.

1008.title: Cosmic Octopus Trinity
1008.description: A vibrant surreal painting depicts a large green octopus-like creature with three female faces emerging from a glowing crater on a colorful alien moon. The starry space background swirls with crescent moons, planets, and nebulae in vivid hues.

1007.title: Man and Dragon Companion
1007.description: An elderly man wearing a black fedora, glasses, and a patterned face mask stands beside a large, vibrant green and yellow dragon. The fantastical scene is set against a swirling purple and yellow cosmic background filled with stars, glowing circles, and ethereal faces.

1010.title: Psychedelic Alien Trinity
1010.description: A vibrant surreal painting depicts a green alien figure with a single large eye emerging from a glowing yellow platform on a purple cratered planetary surface. Above the alien, three stylized female faces in pink and magenta with elaborate swirling yellow hair merge together, emitting colorful beams and tentacles into a starry cosmic background.

1012.title: Aurora Serpent Sorceress
1012.description: A vibrant fantasy painting depicts a green-skinned woman with flowing black hair, adorned in intricate patterns, riding a massive purple and yellow serpentine dragon. The scene is set against a starry purple sky with glowing green aurora borealis swirls and magical golden particles.

1011.title: Cosmic Serpent Oracle
1011.description: A woman with long braided hair stands atop a massive, iridescent serpent whose coiled body is covered in glowing blue and purple scales. She holds a glowing blue staff while surrounded by floating translucent orbs containing intricate mandala patterns against a vibrant cosmic sky.

1013.title: Dragon and Paw Print Guardian
1013.description: A vibrant painting depicts a silhouetted female figure with a patterned headscarf holding a glowing orb, standing beside the head of a large, ornate blue and green dragon. The dragon's coiled body frames a large red circle filled with colorful animal paw prints against a starry purple night sky with swirling patterns.

1014.title: Blue Stasis Bear
1014.description: A large blue cartoon bear covered in green spiral and paw print patterns stands on a purple circular rug with pink paw prints. The bear has large white eyes, a yellow snout, and is positioned in front of a vibrant red background featuring a giant black bear paw print, yellow circular motifs, and repeated 'STASIS SURPRISE!' text.

1018.title: Citrus Crown Rave
1018.description: A vibrant psychedelic artwork depicts a black silhouette of a dancing woman with curly hair reaching toward a large ornate golden crown floating in a burst of radiant light. The background swirls with colorful concentric circles, citrus slices, green leaves, and floating masquerade masks against a dark purple and blue field.

1016.title: Floral Dreamer in Swirls
1016.description: A woman with long flowing red hair stands serenely among vibrant pink flowers, her eyes closed and hand gently touching her cheek. The background is filled with overlapping translucent circles, bubbles, and swirling patterns in shades of blue, green, and yellow.

1017.title: Dragon Rider in Neon Sky
1017.description: A silhouetted woman in flowing robes rides a long, ornate serpentine dragon across a vibrant, swirling night sky. Below, a dark industrial city with smoking factories and glowing East Asian characters contrasts with the luminous celestial scene above featuring stars, crescent moons, and ethereal figures.

1015.title: Silhouette on Cosmic Serpent
1015.description: A black silhouette of a woman in flowing robes stands atop a massive, glowing serpentine dragon that coils across the frame. The vibrant night scene features a purple and magenta starry sky with swirling, psychedelic patterns in greens, blues, and yellows.

1020.title: Eye of the Ancients
1020.description: A surreal painting features a giant central green eye with a starry iris and ornate geometric patterns, flanked by stylized Native American women's profiles with elaborate feathered headdresses on the left and a polluted industrial cityscape with smokestacks on the right. Dark smoke merges with a fiery orange and purple sky while blue and yellow orbs with paint drips float in the foreground alongside scattered black feathers.

1019.title: Dancing Silhouettes by the Sea
1019.description: Vibrant surreal painting featuring black female silhouettes dancing energetically on turbulent ocean waves. Industrial city with smoking smokestacks and neon signs forms the dystopian background under a colorful starry sky, contrasted by large stylized flowers in the foreground.

1021.title: Mother Nature's Lament
1021.description: A vibrant surreal portrait of a green-skinned woman in profile whose face and hair are intricately patterned with mandalas and foliage. She gazes toward a polluted industrial city on the horizon belching black smoke into an orange sky while turbulent emerald waves crash against the rocky shore where tiny human figures walk.

1022.title: Psychedelic All-Seeing Eye
1022.description: A vibrant surreal painting features a large central green all-seeing eye within a blue ornate circle, emitting yellow and cyan lightning bolts. A stylized yellow-green woman with long purple hair adorned with circular patterns appears on the left against a purple background filled with colorful swirling clouds, floating smaller eyes, black feathers, and circular portraits.

1023.title: Electric Sorceress
1023.description: A vibrant stylized illustration of a blue-skinned woman with long flowing black hair adorned with leaves and vines. She stands in profile holding a glowing lightning bolt in her outstretched hand against a cosmic purple and green background filled with swirling patterns, stars, and silhouettes.

1024.title: Psychedelic Spiral Teardrop
1024.description: A vibrant, hand-painted spiral composition featuring a large turquoise teardrop shape on the left side. The concentric rings contain repeating patterns of stylized eyes, black feathers, green frog-like figures with yellow heads, and blue flowers against a purple and green background.

1026.title: Surreal Psychedelic Vision
1026.description: A vibrant surreal painting featuring a large central green eye with a silhouetted figure in the pupil, set against a starry blue eyelid. To the right, a cracked purple heart with a green eye drips liquid, while below, four stylized female faces with swirling colorful hair emerge from a lava-filled rocky landscape under a swirling red and orange sky.

1025.title: Steampunk Spider and Orange Dancer
1025.description: A surreal night scene featuring a giant mechanical steampunk spider with glowing orange eyes and smoking pipes, towering over a cobblestone street with tiny figures holding umbrellas. On the right, a large silhouetted female dancer in an orange-patterned dress performs with smaller dancing figures against a vibrant purple swirling background.

1028.title: Dragon Rider at Dusk
1028.description: A green-skinned woman with curly hair rides a large, ornate green and yellow dragon with purple accents. They soar above reddish-brown mountains under a purple and gray twilight sky featuring a bright yellow crescent moon and scattered stars.

1029.title: Celestial Turtle Gathering
1029.description: A vibrant underwater scene shows a large ornate sea turtle swimming through a crowd of colorful humanoid figures seated in an auditorium. Beams of golden light shine down from a circular ornate portal at the top, illuminating the gathering amid coral and sea life.

1030.title: Sea Turtle Theater
1030.description: A vibrant sea turtle with a colorful patterned shell swims overhead through a circular underwater theater, observed by a diverse audience seated below. The scene features glowing stage lights, coral decorations, and other sea creatures in the blue aquatic background.

1027.title: Woman and Dragon in Poppies
1027.description: A woman with long flowing purple hair stands in a vibrant field of red poppies, wearing a yellow and green patterned dress. She gently touches a large, coiled green dragon with glowing yellow accents that rests beside her under a swirling, starry purple night sky filled with ethereal figures and luminous circles.

1033.title: Celestial Dragon Rider
1033.description: A woman with flowing green hair rides a large, ornate dragon across a starry purple night sky. The entire scene is overlaid with diagonal translucent bands of blue and green containing swirling patterns and foliage.

1034.title: Dragon Rider in Motion
1034.description: A woman with flowing blue hair rides a long, serpentine dragon across a vibrant, abstract background. The scene features dynamic streaks of color, swirling patterns, and starry elements suggesting swift movement through a cosmic or magical realm.

1032.title: Cosmic Mind Emergence
1032.description: A surreal painting depicts a cluster of stylized human heads in green, blue, and purple emerging from a crater on the moon's surface. Flowing, tentacle-like swirls of color extend from the heads, containing smaller faces and intricate spiral patterns against a starry black space background.

1031.title: Psychedelic Robot Over City
1031.description: A towering steampunk robot with glowing orange eyes and a circular Aztec-patterned halo stands over a neon-lit city street at night. In the foreground, four women in vibrant 1960s psychedelic dresses and patterns walk along the sidewalk near the Apollo Arcade sign under a swirling, colorful sky.

1036.title: Melancholy Sun and Profiles
1036.description: A stylized illustration features a large yellow sun with a sad, tearful face in the upper left. Three colorful female profiles with intricate hair and floral details appear on the right against a vibrant green background with diagonal blue and green stripes.

1037.title: Surreal Fleur-de-Lis Dreamscape
1037.description: A vibrant surreal painting featuring a large ornate fleur-de-lis decorated with swirling patterns and faces on the left. To the right, a crystal ball displays a colorful beach scene with pebbles and mountains, while a sad sun with a mustache and eyes hangs above against a green and maroon backdrop.

1035.title: Cosmic Spiral Sisters
1035.description: A vibrant psychedelic painting featuring multiple stylized green-skinned women with elaborate updos and spiral hair patterns, surrounded by floating blue spheres and colorful swirling ribbons against a radiant background. A large central spiral vortex with yellow lightning-like cracks dominates the composition, with one woman's face enclosed in a transparent bubble in the upper right.

1038.title: Cosmic Silhouette Sorceress
1038.description: A black silhouette of a female figure with elaborate curly hair stands against a vibrant cosmic sky, holding a glowing blue orb. Her flowing green and yellow gown transforms into swirling tentacles and patterns that merge with a large blue spiral galaxy and a massive red moon in the background.

1040.title: Psychedelic Dog and Silhouette
1040.description: A vibrant surreal painting featuring a large green cartoon dog with swirls on its face looking toward a silhouetted woman in a colorful patterned dress. The background contains a giant red moon, swirling rainbow patterns, and numerous floating bubbles with tiny dogs and stars inside.

1039.title: Eclipse City Muse
1039.description: A stylized silhouette of a woman in an elaborate flowing gown stands against a vibrant city skyline, gazing upward at a massive bisected moon that is half blood-red and half glowing yellow.

1041.title: Eye of the Red Moon
1041.description: A surreal painting featuring a giant red moon that forms the background of a highly detailed human eye with a vibrant green and yellow patterned iris. A silhouetted woman in ornate colorful attire stands on the left with a trail of small yellow figures along her dress and the eye's upper lid, while a red teardrop falls from the eye.

1042.title: Slime Sorceress under Red Moon
1042.description: A silhouetted woman in an elegant purple dress stands in profile, her hair flowing as she holds a large glowing green slime orb with a dripping smiley face. The vibrant psychedelic background features a massive red moon surrounded by floating smiley orbs and abstract symbols in swirling pink, orange, and green hues.

1043.title: Psychedelic Moon Silhouette
1043.description: A black female silhouette stands against a large red moon, her form and elaborate headdress composed of and dripping with vibrant green slime. Translucent blue bubbles containing smiley faces float around her while the psychedelic background blends pink, orange, and yellow hues with swirling patterns.

1045.title: Celestial Dream Weaver
1045.description: A silhouetted female figure with flowing long hair sits within the branches of a stylized tree, extending her hand toward a giant red moon. The tree's branches form a net holding numerous glowing blue orbs containing smaller silhouetted figures, set against a vibrant cosmic sky with stars, comets, and swirling patterns.

1044.title: Psychedelic Green Oracle
1044.description: A vibrant surreal portrait of a green-skinned female figure with braided hair, her mouth wide open as if singing or screaming, with colorful liquid dripping from her face and neck. She is surrounded by floating blue bubbles, swirling rainbow patterns, and a large glowing planet with rings in the cosmic background.

1046.title: Psychedelic Cosmic Waterfall
1046.description: A vibrant surreal painting depicts a multicolored waterfall cascading from a dark cliff into a swirling pool below. In the sky, a glowing yellow orb, a large ringed planet with intricate patterns, and colorful spiral formations float against a pink and orange gradient backdrop.

1050.title: Floral Wave Goddesses
1050.description: A vibrant psychedelic painting featuring three stylized women's faces in profile emerging from large pink and yellow peonies. Stylized blue and green ocean waves with white crests and crescent moons swirl in the background under a pink and yellow sky.

1047.title: Psychedelic Green Oracle
1047.description: A vibrant surreal painting depicts a green-skinned woman with a braided multicolored hairstyle and melting facial features, her mouth open as a swirling rainbow vortex of colorful patterns and stars emerges. To her right, a majestic blue horse with flowing mane gallops across undulating, rainbow-striped hills under a starry cosmic sky filled with glowing orbs.

1048.title: Cosmic Women in Bubbles
