On the right, a swirling fiery vortex of orange and red flames engulfs two green figures with glasses, all set against a vibrant patterned background with floating colored spheres on the floor.

1274.title: Pink Octopus Banana Monster
1274.description: A vibrant surreal painting features a grinning pink octopus-like creature with large black eyes, standing in a brown puddle while holding a yellow banana. The background contains floating golden rings, diagonal brown stripes, and multiple floating female faces with curly black hair against a purple and yellow backdrop.

1273.title: Cyclops Lounge
1273.description: A massive red cyclops creature with a flaming body and spiral patterns stands hunched in a fiery, volcanic landscape. To the right, a green-haired woman in a patterned outfit reads a book while seated in a transparent bubble chair, surrounded by colorful orbs and swirling psychedelic patterns under a dark sky.

1272.title: Cosmic Egg and Spiral
1272.description: A large decorated egg tied with golden rope sits on a stone surface in the foreground, connected by the rope to a massive circular structure in the background. The structure features a vibrant spiral galaxy with a glowing yellow center, surrounded by an audience of stylized green-skinned figures wearing colorful headwraps who are seated in rows facing the cosmic display.

1276.title: Psychedelic Mantis Oracle
1276.description: A vibrant green praying mantis with intricate patterns holds a glowing green orb containing an orange sun and silhouetted landscape. The background features brown and yellow spiral patterns with a row of stylized human silhouettes on the left.

1278.title: Psychedelic Octopus Lotus
1278.description: A vibrant pink octopus with large black eyes and a toothy grin stands in a brown puddle, one tentacle raised in a wave. To its right, a glowing multicolored lotus flower with intricate patterns floats inside a bright yellow orb against a dark purple cosmic background filled with stylized faces and floral motifs.

1275.title: Surreal Egg Cityscape
1275.description: A large decorated egg with line drawings of faces and patterns rests on a mauve surface in the foreground. A vibrant, winding river path leads through a colorful stylized city toward a large ornate sun or orb in a radiant pink and orange sky.

1277.title: Pink Octopus Monster
1277.description: A cute pink octopus-like creature with large black eyes and a toothy grin stands in a puddle of brown ooze. Three stylized women's faces with 1960s hairdos appear in a beam of light from the creature's raised tentacles against a colorful geometric background.

1279.title: Psychedelic Wave and Heart
1279.description: A woman in a green patterned dress stands gazing at a large purple heart with dripping paint and celestial motifs, set against a vibrant multicolored wave with intricate patterns and a solid red background.

1280.title: Psychedelic City Sunset
1280.description: A vibrant psychedelic painting depicts a winding river with two illuminated bridges flowing through a stylized cityscape under a massive radiant sun. In the foreground, a group of stylized green human profiles with intricate headdresses and patterns gaze toward the glowing horizon, all framed by diagonal translucent bands.

1281.title: Cybernetic Colossus Over Neon City
1281.description: A towering red mechanical spider robot with glowing orange eyes stands on a wet, reflective street in a futuristic city at night. In the sky above, a procession of stylized women's profiles in vibrant colors floats among floating orange rectangles and clouds of green mist.

1282.title: Afrofuturist River City
1282.description: A vibrant surreal painting depicts four women in profile with elaborate African-inspired hairstyles, facial patterns and jewelry gazing toward a winding river cityscape. The fantastical urban landscape features colorful bridges, glowing patterned buildings and a massive ornate sun with geometric symbols dominating the psychedelic sky.

1284.title: Gothic Portrait at Sunset
1284.description: A surreal portrait of a woman with large hypnotic spiral eyes and intricate face tattoos featuring tiny silhouetted figures. Her long black hair is filled with colorful swirling patterns against a dramatic red and orange sunset sky with a silhouetted gothic castle and a large glowing sun.

1283.title: Celestial Woman Portrait
1283.description: Vibrant profile portrait of a woman with elaborate flowing hair filled with colorful celestial patterns including moons, stars, and swirls. A circular window to her right reveals a stylized mountain landscape with a glowing sun or moon on the horizon under a starry sky.

1285.title: Cornfield Octopus Farmer
1285.description: A pink octopus creature with a wide toothy grin stands in the center wearing a green jacket and corn-cob goggles, holding several ears of corn while corn silk drips from its tentacles. The surreal scene is filled with swirling green corn stalks, floating bubbles containing teeth and smaller creatures, and vibrant psychedelic patterns in the background.

1286.title: Psychedelic Praying Mantis
1286.description: A vibrant green praying mantis with large purple compound eyes holds a glowing green orb emitting yellow light. The insect is adorned with intricate floral patterns and surrounded by oversized yellow and purple flowers with faces emerging from the foliage.

1287.title: Four Women in Profile
1287.description: Vibrant stylized artwork featuring four women of color shown in profile, facing right. Their skin is colored in bright yellow, magenta, green, and blue tones, adorned with elaborate headwraps, buns, and floral decorations against a background of lush tropical leaves, bananas, flowers, and dynamic paint splashes.

1288.title: Psychedelic Praying Mantis
1288.description: A large, intricately patterned green praying mantis with oversized purple compound eyes stands over a small green frog with a red eye. Both are positioned on vibrant pink and green lily pads in a surreal pond surrounded by lush, stylized foliage and flowers.

1289.title: Psychedelic Mantis and Cats
1289.description: A vibrant surreal painting depicts a large green praying mantis with intricate purple patterned eyes holding two colorful cats. One cat is orange with floral patterns and the other is purple with swirling designs, all set against a swirling cosmic background of reds, oranges and yellows.

1290.title: Mantis and Paw Silhouette
1290.description: A vibrant painting features a large black paw print silhouette filled with a detailed green praying mantis facing a woman's profile, surrounded by lush yellow and purple floral patterns against a red-to-pink gradient background. Vertical borders on both sides display repeating black paw prints with green and yellow accents.

1291.title: Psychedelic Paw Bubble Dream
1291.description: A vibrant surreal painting featuring a large red and black paw print with ornate swirls at its center, surrounded by floating blue bubbles containing small cat-like figures. Stylized profiles of two women with elaborate psychedelic hair appear on the left side, all set against a colorful gradient background with black paw prints lining the edges.

1293.title: Frog's Ladder to the Moon
1293.description: A vibrant surreal painting depicts a large ornate green frog sitting on a stone ledge at night. A glowing yellow ladder ascends from the frog toward a crescent moon amid a starry sky filled with swirling patterns, surrounded by lush stylized jungle foliage and two colorful silhouetted faces.

1292.title: Mantis Muse
1292.description: A detailed surreal portrait of a woman whose body merges with a large green praying mantis, shown in profile facing left. She has purple skin, ornate curly green hair adorned with flowers, and large purple compound eyes, set against a vibrant green background filled with yellow floral elements, gears, and floating purple orbs containing golden silhouettes.

1294.title: Cosmic Praying Mantis
1294.description: A vibrant green praying mantis stands in a pond creating ripples, set against a fantastical landscape of rolling hills covered in yellow flowers. The night sky above features a glowing golden celestial ring, stars, and swirling purple and blue nebulae.

1295.title: Praying Mantis Oracle
1295.description: A vibrant surreal painting features a large green praying mantis with intricate patterns and purple compound eyes, positioned on the right. In the center, an ornate oval portal with rainbow borders contains five women's faces with elaborate green hair and floral decorations, all encircled by lush yellow-green foliage and flowers against a dark swirling background.

1296.title: Psychedelic Mantis Guardian
1296.description: A large green praying mantis with intricate spiral patterns and silhouette portraits on its back stands prominently in the foreground. It is framed by colorful swirling vines and foliage against a vibrant sunset city skyline with a glowing yellow sun.

1297.title: Psychedelic Mantis Portal
1297.description: A large green praying mantis with intricate patterns and dripping texture stands in the foreground against a vibrant cosmic background. Behind it, a swirling rainbow vortex contains three stylized female faces in profile, surrounded by floating planet-like rings and circular motifs.

1299.title: Mantis and Silhouettes
1299.description: A large, vibrant praying mantis with intricate green, yellow, and purple patterns dominates the left side of the composition. To the right, a group of stylized female silhouettes in colorful profiles emerges from ornate swirling patterns against bold black and white brush strokes.

1298.title: Banana Bug Hybrid Portrait
1298.description: A surreal portrait of a purple-skinned woman with green eyes whose head merges with a large, segmented green beetle. A peeled banana emits swirling purple and yellow smoke patterns from her mouth area while smaller beetles float in the background.

1300.title: Lily Pond Reflection
1300.description: A surreal painting of a purple-skinned woman with a bald head covered in colorful spiral and floral patterns, shown in profile emerging from a lily pond. Her reflection appears below the water's surface amid green lily pads, swirling yellow plants, and a rainbow arc in the background.

1301.title: Bear Pond Reflection
1301.description: A colorful painting depicts a large brown bear's head adorned with a flower crown of pink blossoms and green leaves, positioned above a blue pond with lily pads that reflects the bear's face. The vibrant scene includes yellow bananas, purple and yellow silhouettes of figures, swirling patterns, and paint drips against a bright blue background.

1302.title: Humpty Dumpty Reflection
1302.description: A surreal night scene features a crowned yellow egg character with a red bow tie and half-closed eyes, standing in a lily pond while a speech bubble says "STILL HERE". A silhouetted figure with flowing purple hair holds a banana beside the egg, with both reflected in the water below against a vibrant cosmic sky with swirling galaxies and foliage.

1305.title: Banana Octobot Inferno
1305.description: A metallic spherical robot with large green eyes and copper tentacles holds bananas while floating on lily pads in a pond. Behind it, a fiery explosion of flames and dark smoke rises, with banana motifs and stylized jungle foliage surrounding the surreal scene.

1304.title: Floral Pond Reflections
1304.description: A vibrant psychedelic painting depicts three stylized female profiles emerging from a lily pond, adorned with colorful flowers and foliage. The background features overlapping translucent circles in bright hues, with the figures' reflections visible in the calm water below.

1303.title: Wooden Mouse with Lollipop
1303.description: A brown wooden mouse figurine with large black eyes and a red bindi sits centrally holding a yellow lollipop. The background is a painted artwork featuring colorful swirling patterns, two green circular motifs with stylized faces, and the signature 'Sita 24' in a yellow circle.

1306.title: Floral Dream Portrait
1306.description: A vibrant painting of a woman with bright magenta hair styled in an intricate braided updo adorned with large pink and purple flowers. She is surrounded by oversized cosmos flowers, green vines, and floating circular patterns containing smaller versions of her portrait against a vivid blue background.

1309.title: Sloth Mother and Child
1309.description: A surreal painting depicts the silhouetted profile of a mother with a bun holding her child, both adorned with colorful spiral patterns. They emerge from a swirling brown tunnel where a realistic sloth with yellow claws peeks out from a circular opening, surrounded by floating translucent orbs in a dreamy background.

1308.title: Floral Muse Portrait
1308.description: A vibrant portrait of a woman with magenta hair adorned with pink peonies, bananas, and golden ornaments. She wears a patterned green top against a swirling background of blue, green, and yellow abstract shapes with additional flowers and dripping paint effects.

1307.title: Alien and Psychedelic Woman
1307.description: A vibrant surreal painting split between a colorful floral world and a dark cosmic night. On the left a purple-skinned woman with a decorated headscarf holds a large pink flower while an elongated grey alien crouches on the barren ground on the right, both surrounded by cosmic flowers and celestial bodies.

1310.title: Green Braid Metamorphosis
1310.description: A surreal painting shows four identical green-skinned female profiles with long braided hair, arranged in a row from left to right. On the right side, the figures transform into black skeletons with red liquid dripping from their skulls and ribcages against a vibrant psychedelic background of swirling patterns.

1311.title: Crimson Circle Ritual
1311.description: A group of hooded skeletal figures with glowing red eyes stand in a semi-circle holding hands, their black robes dripping with red liquid. They are positioned before a large concentric green spiral target with smaller targets floating above, all set against a purple swirling background.

1313.title: Skeletal Overlords of Neon City
1313.description: A group of six black skeletons with dripping red, yellow, and green paint stand in the foreground on a glowing highway interchange at sunset. Behind them is a sprawling cyberpunk city skyline under a swirling, psychedelic orange and purple sky with a setting sun.

1312.title: Cabbage Heart Odyssey
1312.description: A vibrant surreal painting depicts a giant green cabbage with a glowing red heart at its core, surrounded by a circular border of silhouetted African profile portraits. A winding orange road leads through fields of smaller cabbages toward a large red sun on the horizon, with three figures walking along the path.

1314.title: Skeleton Procession
1314.description: A surreal procession of black skeletal figures in hooded robes stands in the foreground, each with red liquid dripping from their eye sockets and jaws. The background consists of vibrant concentric spirals and circular patterns in yellow, purple, and pink, with multiple floating female faces and additional red drips.

1315.title: Cabbage Portal Dreamscape
1315.description: A vibrant surreal painting featuring a giant green cabbage with a glowing red and black portal at its center, set against a winding desert road. Stylized women with green hair appear on the right alongside floating circular patterns and a large red sun in a colorful sky.

1316.title: Surreal Cosmic Wheel
1316.description: A large ornate brown wheel with eight spokes dominates the scene, featuring a central purple eye and various symbolic images along its rim. In the foreground, a vibrant blue and orange bird perches on a ginkgo branch, while colorful planets, stars, and clouds float against a gradient sky above an orange desert landscape.

1317.title: Surreal Green Eye Vision
1317.description: A large, detailed green human eye dominates the composition, its iris filled with intricate yellow floral patterns. A vibrant blue and orange bird perches on a dark branch adorned with ginkgo leaves and white flowers, surrounded by floating stylized faces with green hair against a purple cosmic background.

1318.title: Surreal Robotic Dreamscape
1318.description: A vibrant psychedelic painting features a large metallic blue robot with glowing orange eyes, intertwined with nature elements including a colorful bird perched on a branch, giant red-capped mushrooms, ginkgo leaves, and a pond with lily pads. The background displays intricate swirling patterns in deep reds and purples, with small human figures visible within the mushroom stems and yellow hands reaching from the foliage.

1319.title: Green Monster and Retro Robot
1319.description: A vibrant surreal painting depicts a large grinning green monster with yellow eyes and patterned skin, exhaling colorful lips and smoke from its mouth. To its right stands a retro television-headed robot with glowing yellow eyes, wires, and small human figures on its torso, set against a cosmic starry background with swirling patterns.

1320.title: Onion Wizard Mushroom City
1320.description: A large anthropomorphic yellow onion with a grumpy face and wizard hat stands in a psychedelic forest surrounded by giant red-capped mushrooms. In the background, a glowing neon city with construction cranes is reflected in a river under a swirling yellow and purple sky.

1321.title: Psychedelic Bird on Ginkgo Branch
1321.description: A vibrant blue and orange bird perches on a bright green ginkgo branch adorned with white flowers and small dark figures. Swirling pink, purple, and yellow patterns flow from the branch, surrounded by floating bananas, circular motifs, and stylized human heads against a white background.

1322.title: Mushroom Cyborg Vision
1322.description: A metallic cyborg head with glowing yellow eyes emerges from a pond covered in lily pads and vibrant red-capped mushrooms. The surreal scene is set against a deep red background filled with floating transparent bubbles containing miniature mushroom illustrations.

1323.title: Stasis Bird and Faces
1323.description: A vibrant psychedelic painting features a large blue and orange bird with patterned wings perched among green ginkgo leaves and white flowers. Stylized human and dog-like faces with intricate orange patterns are arranged horizontally across the center against a purple background with decorative borders.

1324.title: Celtic Wave Muse
1324.description: A close-up profile portrait of a woman with pale skin, vibrant green eyes, and intricate green Celtic knotwork weaving through her dark flowing hair. Stylized white and grey ocean waves emerge from her mouth while a smaller nested scene appears within the wave pattern.

1325.title: Psychedelic Faces in Waves
1325.description: A vibrant horizontal painting displays five stylized, colorful faces aligned side by side against a grey background. The faces feature intricate patterns, large expressive eyes, and are framed by decorative teal wave borders dotted with bright circular accents and planetary motifs.

1326.title: Psychedelic Multi-Eyed Vision
1326.description: A vibrant surreal painting featuring five stylized eyes arranged in a horizontal row against a radiating pink background. The large central eye is flanked by four smaller eyes with intricate iris patterns, all connected by flowing green organic lines and dripping details.

1328.title: Phoenix and Crescent Silhouettes
1328.description: A vibrant surreal artwork depicts four colorful female profile silhouettes stacked in a row, adorned with intricate patterns and headdresses. A large dark blue phoenix with glowing accents flies toward a prominent black crescent moon against a striped teal and purple background with floating orbs.

1327.title: Desert Wanderer Vision
1327.description: A stylized painting depicts a robed figure with a golden head covering walking through orange sand dunes. The sky swirls with blue and white patterns surrounding a large golden celestial body, while a decorative border of symbolic eyes and faces runs across the bottom.

1329.title: Psychedelic Eye and Robot
1329.description: A vibrant surreal painting depicts a large multi-tentacled eye creature with red and purple hues emerging from a swirling vortex on the left. On the right, a massive metallic robot head with glowing yellow eyes overlooks a winding path where three small human figures walk through a colorful, rolling landscape under a psychedelic sky.

1330.title: Mushroom Vision Portal
1330.description: A large green mushroom with white spots rises from a pond covered in lily pads and smaller mushrooms. Four stylized female faces with intricate head patterns float in glowing blue and yellow spiral portals around the central mushroom.

1332.title: Fleur-de-Lis Eye Portrait
1332.description: A vibrant surreal portrait of a dark-skinned woman in profile with a large, intricate green eye dominating the left side. The iris features a golden fleur-de-lis at its center with a glowing light burst, surrounded by decorative patterns, while the woman's face and background are adorned with additional golden fleur-de-lis symbols.

1331.title: Fleur-de-Lis Vision
1331.description: A vibrant surreal portrait of a dark-skinned woman in profile with elaborate colorful hair adorned with fleur-de-lis symbols. Her large green eye contains a glowing golden fleur-de-lis at its center, with sparkles flowing toward a large ornate golden fleur-de-lis floating to the right, while multiple translucent faces fade into the background.

1333.title: Spiral Eyes Infinity
1333.description: Two stylized faces in profile face each other, one green on the left and one orange on the right, connected by a large interlocking orange and purple spiral pattern filled with smaller eyes. A decorative band of orange eyes runs across the top against a swirling blue and yellow background.

1334.title: Psychedelic Kitchen Party
1334.description: Two women in retro 60s dresses stand in a vibrant pink kitchen, gazing in amazement at a cute green vegetable creature wearing a party hat and holding a cherry, perched in a bowl of produce under a hanging lamp.

1335.title: Psychedelic Eyeball Orbs
1335.description: A vibrant surreal composition features four vertical oval panels with stylized faces and eyes connected by ornate chains against a swirling purple background. In the foreground, a glossy green cartoonish creature with a wide smile sits beside a large detailed eyeball with orange iris and intricate patterns, all rendered with dripping paint effects and smiley face motifs.

1336.title: Psychedelic Gollum Vision
1336.description: A surreal portrait of a green, wrinkled, large-eared humanoid with bright green eyes and a distressed expression. The figure is surrounded by colorful translucent bubbles and circular psychedelic patterns, with a massive, highly detailed green eye dominating the right side containing intricate inner visions.

1337.title: Frog's Surreal Salad Bowl
1337.description: A vibrant surreal painting featuring a large green frog holding a cherry, sitting inside a purple bowl filled with pink and blue cloud-like forms, corn, a cucumber, and other vegetables. A stylized woman's profile with leafy hair and gold jewelry appears on the left, surrounded by swirling green vines and floating yellow coins against a swirling pink background.

1338.title: Cosmic Floral Goddesses
1338.description: A vibrant psychedelic artwork featuring three stylized female faces in green, purple, and yellow emerging from a large central flower with swirling green vines and hair. The composition is set against a textured red and pink background adorned with yellow dots and crescent moons.

1340.title: Swamp Witch with Blue Orbs
1340.description: A green-skinned witch with long lime hair, glowing red eyes, and purple lips stares directly at the viewer. She is surrounded by large blue crystalline orbs connected by metal chains floating against a swirling pink, orange, and yellow psychedelic background with smaller orbs and faint colorful silhouettes of female figures.

1339.title: Surreal Eye with Watering Plants
1339.description: A large stylized human eye with a pink and yellow patterned iris dominates the composition, its pupil reflecting a small figure watering plants. Water streams from the eye into a vibrant blue vase overflowing with lush green houseplants and pink flowers, while a row of smaller stylized female figures with colorful hair appears along the bottom.

1341.title: Psychedelic Eye Vision
1341.description: A vibrant surreal painting depicts a teal-skinned woman in profile with an elaborate updo, raising her hand near her face. A giant ornate green eye emerges from a cresting wave of colorful mandala patterns, swirling lines, and floating golden particles against a purple background.

1342.title: Stasis in the Bubble
1342.description: A vibrant psychedelic painting depicts a green-skinned woman with yellow hair sitting inside a large transparent bubble, holding a potted plant while water splashes from a blue polka-dotted vase in the foreground. The scene is filled with numerous floating bubbles, potted plants with heart-shaped leaves, colorful orbs on stands, and swirling patterns against a rich brown background.

1343.title: Cosmic Mustache Portrait
1343.description: A vibrant surreal painting featuring three stylized human figures against a pink tie-dye background. The central translucent red face is flanked by a golden-skinned woman with a patterned headwrap on the left and a lime-green woman with banana-like hair and constellation markings on the right, all connected by flowing green vines beneath a large black mustache and three celestial orbs in a starry nebula.

1344.title: Spiraling Floral Faces
1344.description: A vibrant psychedelic artwork featuring magenta female profiles adorned with golden dots, intertwined with a large stylized flower that gradients from deep pink to bright orange and yellow. The composition is filled with swirling spiral patterns in red and green vines against a muted gray background.

1345.title: Spiraling Faces Artwork
1345.description: An abstract painting featuring multiple stylized female profiles with elaborate headdresses and flowing hair that intertwine into vibrant red, yellow, and green spirals and circular patterns across a white background.

1347.title: Surreal Lakeside Gathering
1347.description: A vibrant surreal painting depicts three stylized women's profiles merged within a large teal circular motif floating above a calm lake. In the foreground, a woman in a patterned headscarf sits in a yellow patterned boat on a purple shore, while two sailboats with circular designs glide across the water under a gradient sky filled with colorful orbs.

1348.title: No Entry Psychedelic Scene
1348.description: A surreal psychedelic landscape features a red sun or moon in a swirling red and orange sky. In the foreground, silhouetted figures with spiral hair stand before a weathered 'NO ENTRY' sign, set against a tie-dye patterned red ground with green vine-like forms and yellow circular motifs.

1346.title: Sailing in Spiral Waters
1346.description: A vibrant psychedelic painting depicts two sailboats with women aboard on a body of water dotted with yellow circles. In the foreground on the right, two women with elaborate green and pink spiral hairstyles stand on the shore observing the scene.

1350.title: Spiral Goddess Trio
1350.description: Psychedelic artwork featuring three stylized female profiles formed by flowing, concentric spiral patterns in red, orange, and yellow. The central figure has golden facial details and holds a spiral motif, while the side figures display intricate afro-like curls composed of swirling circles and dots against a dark background.

1351.title: Afrocentric Swirl Silhouettes
1351.description: Stylized silhouettes of four Black women in profile with elaborate updos and earrings, set against a dynamic background of swirling red and black patterns. The composition features flowing golden-yellow line art, decorative circular motifs, and vibrant patterns throughout the hair and background.

1352.title: Eternal Duality
1352.description: A surreal painting showing four identical green-haired women in profile on the left, adorned with intricate yellow spiral patterns, gradually transitioning into red as skeletal grim reaper figures with bleeding eyes emerge on the right. The background features vibrant psychedelic circular motifs in purple, yellow, and red that blend into dark, ominous patterns behind the skeletal figures.

1354.title: Witch under Blood Moon
1354.description: A dramatic digital painting featuring a beautiful witch in a large white feathered hat and black starry dress, holding a glowing red orb staff. She stands on gnarled dark roots against a massive blood-red moon with two translucent overlapping portraits of her face.

1353.title: Surreal Chrysanthemum Bowl
1353.description: A large magenta chrysanthemum with dripping petals emerges from a green cracked bowl filled with blueberries. Inside a transparent bubble floating above are a multi-tiered pagoda, a white and blue eyeball, a yellow butterfly, and a black bat, all set against a soft gradient background with stylized clouds.

1355.title: Witch and Blue Monster
1355.description: A surreal night scene featuring a large blue melting monster with yellow eyes and a sad expression in the foreground. A witch in a pointed hat stands on the monster's dark tentacles holding a staff, set against a blood-red moon, misty mountains, and a traditional East Asian pagoda beside a lantern-lit lake.

1356.title: Crying Blue Monster Over Lake
1356.description: A large amorphous blue creature with sad yellow eyes and dripping tears looms over a misty East Asian landscape. Traditional pagodas, boats on the water, and ink-wash mountains appear below in a surreal watercolor scene with yellow and blue paint drips.

1357.title: Melting Ghost and Red Chrysanthemum
1357.description: A large blue ghost with wide sad eyes and dripping texture stands in a lavender field, holding a small wooden boat while reaching toward a giant red chrysanthemum. The surreal landscape features a sunset over a lake with distant mountains, while black dripping substance falls from the top right against a green sky.

1358.title: Melting Blue Creatures
1358.description: A surreal psychedelic scene shows three women with colorful patterned clothing and elaborate hairstyles standing in a flower field, gazing at large melting blue blob-like creatures with sad yellow eyes. One creature rests on a giant red flower while smaller ones dot the purple meadow under a vibrant dripping sunset sky with stylized green trees.

1359.title: Chrysanthemum Dream
1359.description: A stylized profile portrait of a young woman with flowing turquoise and yellow hair adorned with small flowers. Her hair merges into a large, dramatic red and black chrysanthemum from which two small yellow figures emerge holding hands.

1360.title: Celestial Tree at Sunset
1360.description: A vibrant surreal landscape features a massive tree with intricate roots extending into a lavender field under a starry night sky that transitions into a colorful sunset over rolling hills and a reflective body of water. Three women in patterned dresses with spiral designs stand in the foreground observing the scene, while smaller figures appear in the distance.

1361.title: Melting Moon Hug
1361.description: A sad blue melting creature with yellow eyes and a downturned mouth is being gently embraced by a cheerful smiling crescent moon wearing a green patterned bandana. The vibrant night scene is filled with glowing psychedelic circles, stars, and colorful drips against a dark cosmic background.

1362.title: Smiling Sun Over Psychedelic Shore
1362.description: A large green smiley face with intricate patterns floats above a rippling body of water reflecting a vibrant sunset sky. On a grassy hill, a woman in a patterned dress gazes upward at a trail of colorful floating smiley faces, while other figures in similar attire walk along the shore beside a large red chrysanthemum.

1364.title: Crystal of Many Faces
1364.description: A lone hiker with a red backpack stands on a mossy cliff overlooking a vast lavender field, gazing up at a large transparent crystal sphere containing four stylized overlapping female profiles in purple, green, pink, and yellow. The surreal landscape features a winding river at sunset with colorful swirling skies and decorative spiral patterns throughout the scene.

1363.title: Psychedelic Woman and Lotus
1363.description: A vibrant profile portrait of a woman with a multicolored face and hair filled with swirling patterns, landscapes, and flowers. She gazes toward a large red lotus flower containing smaller stylized female figures within its petals, set against a colorful gradient sky with reflective water below.

1366.title: Reflections of Nature
1366.description: A surreal painting depicts three overlapping female profiles emerging from a reflective body of water, adorned with flowers, vines, and circular patterns. The vibrant scene features a glowing sunset over distant land, tall green reeds, and floating transparent bubbles with plant motifs.

1367.title: Fleur-de-Lis Lavender Dream
1367.description: A vibrant surreal landscape at sunset featuring a large golden fleur-de-lis adorned with red flowers hovering above rolling lavender fields. Three stylized dark-skinned women with elaborate patterned headwraps and hair stand in the foreground gazing toward the horizon, surrounded by a giant red chrysanthemum and swirling green hills under a purple and golden sky.

1365.title: Psychedelic Bubble Goddess
1365.description: A vibrant surreal painting depicts a large central female figure with green patterned skin and elaborate red and black floral headdress floating above a reflective body of water. Numerous translucent bubbles containing smaller versions of similar stylized female faces drift across the foreground against a colorful sunset sky with lotus-like flowers.

1368.title: Golden Egg and Chrysanthemum
1368.description: A stylized portrait of a dark-skinned woman wearing a yellow patterned headwrap, eyes closed, holding a large cracked golden egg in her palm. A massive red and gold chrysanthemum blooms beside her head against a vibrant green swirling background with decorative borders.

1370.title: Cosmic Frog at Sunset
1370.description: A vibrant surreal landscape features a large green frog with intricate patterns and big colorful eyes, sitting in a dark cosmic pool while holding a glowing yellow orb. The scene includes a winding road, reflective water, rolling green hills, and a massive red sun with silhouettes against a purple and orange sky.

1369.title: Fleur-de-Lis Vision
1369.description: A vibrant surreal painting features a large stylized golden fleur-de-lis on the left containing colorful human figures. On the right, a purple-skinned woman with a patterned green headwrap gazes toward a massive psychedelic eye in the sky that contains a smaller fleur-de-lis in its pupil, above a reflective body of water with lily pads at sunset.

1371.title: Golden Egg in Bloom
1371.description: A vibrant surreal illustration shows a large cracked golden egg resting on an outstretched, tattooed hand. A red chrysanthemum with a woman's face blooms to the left while multiple colorful female faces emerge from a radiant burst in the upper right.

1373.title: Stasis Fusion
1373.description: A surreal still life painting featuring a large cracked white eggshell with a golden egg inside, a massive black bear paw print emerging from the shell, and a vibrant red chrysanthemum flower at the base. The background displays a green gradient with overlapping circular patterns and silhouettes of stylized female faces in yellow and purple.

1372.title: Fox and Flower City
1372.description: A vibrant surreal scene featuring a large red multi-petaled flower with intricate green and yellow faces at its center, positioned on the left. On the right, a red winged fox with orange accents sits on a grassy cliff edge, overlooking a background of green skyscrapers topped with bananas under a swirling pink and orange sky.

1374.title: Stasis Bear Dead
1374.description: A vibrant psychedelic poster featuring a grotesque green zombie skull with bulging bloodshot eyes at the center of a massive glowing yellow bear paw print. The background contains swirling hypnotic patterns, colorful dotted circles, and rows of repeated stylized human silhouettes along the bottom.

1375.title: Cosmic Egg Hatching
1375.description: A surreal psychedelic scene features a large golden egg cracked open on a colorful patterned table. Above it floats a menacing red and black creature with glowing spiral eyes, antlers, and a jagged yellow mouth dripping liquid, set against a starry green cosmic background with a translucent green female profile on the left.

1376.title: Oni and Chrysanthemum
1376.description: A surreal Japanese-inspired artwork featuring a black silhouetted woman with an elaborate floral hairstyle holding a fierce red oni mask with yellow eyes and sharp teeth. A large vibrant red chrysanthemum blooms between the mask and a sinister black tree spirit with glowing white eyes and a jagged grin, all set against a glowing green background with floating orbs.

1377.title: Alien and Silhouette Bloom
1377.description: A vibrant surreal illustration shows a green alien with large patterned eyes emerging from a cracked surface, adorned with red chrysanthemums. To the left, a black silhouette of a woman with an elaborate banana-and-swirl headdress stands amid large red flowers and bunches of bananas against a green-to-yellow gradient background.

1378.title: Grim Reaper and Cthulhu
1378.description: A skeletal Grim Reaper in a black hooded robe adorned with colorful spirals holds two large red chrysanthemums. To the right, a purple octopus-like creature with yellow spots emerges from a rocky mound beneath a swirling cosmic nebula.

1380.title: Skeleton Reaper with Cosmic Bloom
1380.description: A hooded skeleton with glowing purple eyes holds a large red spider chrysanthemum while a flowing purple cosmic scarf extends from its form, containing stars, a yellow banana, and a purple octopus emerging from a cratered moon-like surface. In the green gradient background, a serene woman's face with sunflower-like hair floats beside the grim reaper figure amid floating yellow crescent shapes.

1381.title: Cosmic Frog Vision
1381.description: A vibrant surreal painting of a large green frog with spiral patterns and enormous purple eyes, holding a glowing circular mandala containing human faces. The frog floats against a starry night sky with swirling yellow and green energy forms, above a serene landscape of purple hills, a lake with concentric ripples, and a setting sun.

1382.title: Melting Moon Hug
1382.description: A large blue melting creature with multiple faces embedded in its dripping form extends an arm to embrace a cheerful yellow sun with a winking expression. The surreal scene is set against a dark starry background filled with colorful concentric circles, fireworks, and glowing particles.

1383.title: Oni and Shadow Demon
1383.description: A vibrant psychedelic illustration features a large red Japanese oni mask with golden horns and intricate patterns, held by a dark clawed hand. To the right floats a black amorphous shadow creature with glowing white eyes and a wide toothy grin, set against swirling rainbow circles and a gnarled dark tree under a starry green sky.

1384.title: Cracked Android Sunset
1384.description: A green humanoid android with golden crack lines, one glowing yellow eye and one red eye, stands in the foreground. Behind her is a vibrant psychedelic sunset over a body of water with concentric circles, rendered in a surreal illustrative style.

1385.title: Fractured Dreamer and Frog
1385.description: A young person with closed eyes and green swirling patterns on their head emerges from a shattered geometric structure on the left. A large, vibrant green frog with clockwork eyes floats in a starry blue night sky, connected by flowing, tentacle-like green forms containing embedded faces.

1387.title: Frog Between Worlds
1387.description: A surreal painting shows a man with antlers and a glowing cracked head on the left, holding a glowing green frog with star-patterned eyes in his palm. On the right, a young boy with a similarly cracked and glowing head stares forward against a vibrant mountainous landscape under a crescent moon.

1388.title: Antlered Void Portrait
1388.description: A surreal painting split between two figures against a cracked, colorful background. On the left, a serene young person with closed eyes and leafy vines in their hair; on the right, a dark silhouette with glowing yellow cracks and branching antlers filled with fire and flowers.

1389.title: Millipede and Bananas
1389.description: A surreal painted portrait shows a person with green spiral patterns on their face, holding a large black and white segmented millipede in their open palm. The background consists of swirling red and magenta patterns with floating yellow bananas and concentric circles.

1390.title: Grim Reaper with Octopus
1390.description: A skeletal Grim Reaper in a dark blue hooded robe holds a scythe while standing on a large cracked grey rock. A green octopus with large yellow eyes and orange suction cups clings to the rock beside him.

1391.title: Psychedelic Floral Muse
1391.description: A vibrant surreal artwork featuring a woman's green and purple face in profile, her long yellow hair merging with the petals of a giant pink and orange flower. The dark background is densely patterned with oranges, bananas, grapes, leaves, and smaller stylized female figures in yellow and purple silhouettes.

1392.title: Octopus on the Moon
1392.description: A vibrant purple and green octopus with large yellow eyes emerges from a crater on the surface of a grey moon. The background is a dark starry space filled with floating oranges, colorful swirling ribbons, and two stylized human faces in the upper right.

1386.title: Psychedelic Eye Portrait
1386.description: A vibrant surreal painting features a woman's profile on the left with intricate green and purple patterns in her hair, reaching toward an enormous, highly detailed green eye dominating the center and right. The composition uses dripping yellow liquid elements against a swirling blue background with decorative patterns throughout.

1393.title: Psychedelic Afro Silhouettes
1393.description: A vibrant surreal painting featuring overlapping profile faces of Black women with elaborate spiral afro hairstyles inside a large magenta orb. The scene is set in a colorful grassy field with fantastical plants, fish swimming through rainbow loops, and abstract colorful forms against a brown and white background.

1395.title: Dancing Citrus Spiral
1395.description: A vibrant purple cartoon character with a smiling face, stick legs, and an orange slice skirt dances at the center of a swirling vortex of rainbow colors. The dark background is patterned with repeating illustrations of oranges and green leaves.

1394.title: Psychedelic Bubble Women
1394.description: A vibrant surreal painting featuring multiple stylized female profiles with lime green and yellow skin, surrounded by overlapping translucent bubbles containing faces and spiral patterns. A large pink and orange flower with citrus-slice details emerges from the center against a deep blue background filled with circular motifs.

1396.title: Bubble Dream Portrait
1396.description: A side profile of a young woman with long, flowing reddish-brown hair adorned with leaves, surrounded by translucent blue bubbles containing crescent moons, stars, and swirls. The vibrant background features concentric rainbow spirals in psychedelic colors.

1397.title: Psychedelic Alien Butterfly
1397.description: A vibrant green alien with large purple eyes and a slight smile stands centered, its body covered in intricate patterns. Large, ornate butterfly-like wings in shades of purple, pink, and yellow extend from its shoulders against a dark background filled with glowing orbs and swirling lines.

1398.title: Floral River Goddesses
1398.description: Four green-skinned women in profile with elaborate headdresses of vibrant blue and purple flowers, leaves, and bananas gaze toward a colorful river at sunset. The psychedelic landscape features rippling water, distant purple hills, and floating banana shapes beneath a dramatic orange, pink, and purple sky.

1399.title: Green Dog Banana Dream
1399.description: A vibrant pop-art style portrait of a lime-green dog wearing a pink banana-patterned collar, set against a psychedelic sunset landscape with a reflective river filled with floating bananas.

1401.title: Psychedelic Mermaid Orb
1401.description: A vibrant surreal painting depicts the silhouette of a woman with long curly hair and tentacle-like horns, her profile visible inside a large transparent orb. The orb contains a colorful sunset landscape over rippling water, surrounded by floating fish, abstract swirls, and multicolored glowing orbs against a purple background.

1400.title: Psychedelic Mayan Oracle
1400.description: A surreal green-skinned figure with a cracked stone-like face, heterochromia, and elaborate braided headdress dominates the composition. Below, silhouetted ancient ruins and tribal figures stand on a desert landscape beneath a vibrant cosmic portal filled with swirling nebulae, planets, and glowing symbols.

1403.title: Psychedelic Turtle Vision
1403.description: A vibrant surreal painting depicts a large ornate sea turtle floating in a cosmic space, adorned with intricate patterns and orange circles. Below it, three stylized women's profiles with flowing colorful hair gaze upward, while autumn maple leaves in pink, orange, and yellow drip from the top against a gradient background.

1402.title: Psychedelic Mermaid Portrait
1402.description: A vibrant surreal painting of a woman's profile with a large magenta sphere for a body, her hair flowing as colorful swirling patterns filled with fish and bubbles. The foreground features a fantastical underwater garden with colorful mushrooms and coral-like plants.

1404.title: Cosmic Vortex Sorceress
1404.description: A woman in a flowing red and black dress stands on a rocky outcrop, holding a glowing red circular orb that emits rays of light. She is surrounded by a vibrant psychedelic vortex of swirling orange, red, and yellow energy that flows into green, tentacle-like organic structures dotted with yellow glowing orbs against a radiant pink background.

1405.title: Phoenix and Celestial Orb
1405.description: A dark-skinned woman in a black gown holds a glowing red orb while a massive blue phoenix with fiery accents flies overhead, clutching another orb in its beak. The surreal night scene features a starry sky with yellow comets, surrounded by vibrant stylized citrus-like fruits and foliage in a fantastical landscape.

1406.title: Phoenix Crown Muse
1406.description: A vibrant profile portrait of a green-skinned woman wearing an elaborate crown of flames, flowers, and golden filigree. A large black phoenix with glowing orange eyes emerges from her flowing dark hair, which swirls into intricate patterns against a purple and yellow sky.

1407.title: Cabbage and Citrus Sorceress
1407.description: A woman in a flowing black and purple gown with green hair stands on rocky ground, reaching toward a large orange slice. A giant green cabbage with a small figure inside dominates the right side against a dark background filled with floating citrus slices and green leaves.

1408.title: Mystic Woman by the Sea
1408.description: A woman in traditional dress stands on coastal rocks holding a glowing orb, gazing toward a large orange stepped pyramid under a bright sun. A massive, colorful swirling cosmic cloud filled with symbols, trees, and figures dominates the sky above turquoise waters.

1409.title: Melodic Orchard Sorceress
1409.description: A woman in a flowing dark gown adorned with musical symbols stands in profile, holding a glowing red orb that emits concentric circles and musical notes. She is surrounded by a vibrant, swirling rainbow sky, while an orchard of orange fruits and crescent moons grows from a dark, rocky landscape below.

1410.title: Psychedelic Dog and Cosmic Mountain
1410.description: A vibrant green dog with intricate patterns and a decorated collar stands in the foreground, gazing toward a glowing purple mountain with lightning bolts under a swirling cosmic sky filled with planets, stars, and celestial faces.

1411.title: Crystal Ball Oracle
1411.description: A blonde woman with elaborate braids and green orbs in her hair leans over a green table, intently studying four glowing crystal spheres that contain miniature scenes. The vibrant red background is filled with intricate golden spiral and circular patterns.

1413.title: Three Women in Mystic Landscape
1413.description: Three women with green skin and colorful head coverings stand in profile facing right, positioned in a field of purple flowers. Behind them is a surreal landscape with a reflective body of water, a glowing purple orb in the sky, a spiral galaxy formation, and a jagged mountain under a yellow and purple swirling sky.

1412.title: Triune Psychedelic Sirens
1412.description: A vibrant surreal painting shows three identical green-skinned women in profile, facing right, with elaborate swirling hair that drips and merges into the sky. They stand before a colorful sunset lake reflecting concentric ripples and a glowing circular sun over distant mountains.

1414.title: Celestial Silhouettes
1414.description: Four colorful silhouetted female figures with intricate spiral and swirl patterns in their hair stand in profile against a dreamy, cloudy sky. A large glowing crescent moon decorated with swirls and dots hangs in the purple and yellow twilight above rolling green hills.

1415.title: Celestial Crown Over Mountain
1415.description: A vibrant psychedelic painting depicts a large ornate crown floating in a starry night sky above a purple mountain and reflective lake. Below the crown, four stylized green female figures with intricate patterns stand in a row watching the glowing cosmic scene.

1416.title: Cosmic Sea Turtle Journey
1416.description: A vibrant surreal painting of a large green sea turtle swimming through stylized turquoise waters at sunset. The turtle's shell features glowing circular windows revealing tiny figures inside, while its head has intricate braided patterns and a golden earring, with silhouetted human figures standing on distant purple shores.

1417.title: Blueberry Lotus Vision
1417.description: A vibrant surreal painting features a stylized woman's head in profile, her hair composed of blueberries and leaves, rising from a large red and yellow lotus flower. The lotus emerges from a green bowl filled with blueberries, surrounded by floating colorful orbs containing silhouetted faces, butterflies, and abstract patterns against a white background with paint splatters.

1418.title: Psychedelic Dream Landscape
1418.description: A surreal portrait of a purple-skinned woman in profile with her eyes closed, her flowing hair transforming into swirling green and yellow organic forms that drip and merge with a vibrant landscape. The background features rolling purple and green hills, a turquoise body of water with golden swirls, a large yellow sun, and a field of colorful flowers under a gradient sky.

1419.title: Psychedelic Braided Sisters
1419.description: A vibrant pop art painting featuring four stylized Black women in profile with colorful skin tones of green, magenta, and yellow. Their hair merges into a thick, flowing green and yellow braid that swirls dramatically across the composition against a turquoise and purple background with geometric shapes and circular patterns.

1420.title: Psychedelic Women Portrait
1420.description: A vibrant psychedelic artwork featuring multiple stylized female profiles with intricate spiral and circular patterns in their hair and on their bodies. The figures are rendered in bright neon greens, blues, and yellows against a dynamic purple background with splashes of color and geometric shapes.

1422.title: Enchanted Forest Silhouettes
1422.description: A vibrant, stylized painting depicts four colorful female silhouettes with intricate spiral patterns walking along a glowing yellow path through a dense, magical forest. The scene is filled with layered foliage, trees, and swirling psychedelic details in a rich autumnal palette.

1423.title: Psychedelic Unicorn Turtle
1423.description: A vibrant green sea turtle with a spiraled unicorn horn swims through a purple cosmic background. The turtle features a colorful mane of pink, yellow, and orange hair, intricate spiral patterns on its shell, and is surrounded by floating jellyfish-like forms and glowing circular motifs.

1424.title: Cybernetic Forest Muse
1424.description: A golden robotic head with glowing yellow eyes merges with a colorful female silhouette, whose braided hair flows into ornate golden patterns. The figure is surrounded by a vibrant, psychedelic forest of swirling plants, autumn trees, and abstract organic forms against a deep red background.

1425.title: Cybernetic Oracle
1425.description: A metallic golden android with glowing yellow eyes and exposed circuitry faces right, its head surrounded by layered green and yellow profiles filled with swirling psychedelic patterns and three garlic bulbs. To the right, a large cluster of vibrant blue crystals sits atop a rocky outcrop with multiple waterfalls cascading into a colorful reflective pool below.

1426.title: Psychedelic Forest Smoker
1426.description: A vibrant surreal forest scene features a large stylized character in the foreground wearing a green hat with a feather, smoking a pipe that emits purple smoke. Smaller similar figures peek from behind stylized trees along a winding path in an autumnal woodland filled with swirling patterns and vibrant foliage.

1427.title: Psychedelic Alien Hares
1427.description: A surreal psychedelic painting featuring two large brown hares leaping across a teal background, one wearing a floral headdress. Below them are three alien figures: a yellow humanoid holding a plant, a green alien juggling a glowing orb, and a purple alien with raised hands, all surrounded by vibrant floral patterns and foliage.

1428.title: Psychedelic Couple Portrait
1428.description: A vibrant pop art style illustration shows a man and woman in profile facing opposite directions, both wearing green hats and scarves. The man smokes a pipe while the woman has stylized 1960s hair, set against a swirling background of colorful circles, lips, and psychedelic patterns.

1429.title: Centipede of Psychedelic Faces
1429.description: A large human hand with green and yellow patterns holds a black and white centipede-like creature with red eyes and curly antennae. The vibrant blue background is filled with overlapping colorful psychedelic faces and swirling circular patterns in pink, green, yellow and purple.

1430.title: Cybernetic Horse and Robot
1430.description: A surreal painting featuring a translucent turquoise skeletal horse with glowing yellow eyes on the left, its form intertwined with ethereal female faces in flowing hair-like patterns. On the right, a detailed metallic robot head and shoulders with glowing yellow eyes and embedded human-like female faces stares forward against a red and purple backdrop with concentric circles.

1431.title: Neon Skeleton Beast
1431.description: A person in a hooded green cloak kneels on a rocky outcrop holding a lantern and a long staff, gazing up at a large glowing turquoise skeletal canine creature with intricate internal anatomy and flowing colorful patterns from its spine. Above them floats a large metallic robot head with glowing yellow eyes against a vibrant starry sky filled with swirling aurora borealis in green, pink, and red hues.

1432.title: Aurora Dreamer with Lantern
1432.description: A solitary figure in a hooded jacket kneels on a starry hill, holding a glowing lantern and a staff while gazing upward at a vibrant, swirling night sky filled with colorful auroras, spirals, flowers, and geometric shapes.

1433.title: Cybernetic Serpent Oracle
1433.description: A metallic robotic head with glowing yellow eyes and Roman numerals VII on its forehead is entwined by a large purple snake with a yellow eye. In the lower left, three stylized female profiles in green, purple, and pink appear against a vibrant cosmic background of swirling nebulae and clouds.

1434.title: Cybernetic Island Vision
1434.description: A vibrant surreal painting depicts a small rocky island with a seated metallic robot at the center of a swirling blue vortex sea. The right side features a large red-hued cyborg head emitting light rays, a glowing blue skeletal canine creature, and various technological and organic motifs against a starry cosmic background.

1435.title: Cosmic Reaper on Balcony
1435.description: A skeletal figure in a purple hooded robe stands on a wooden balcony overlooking a swirling blue sea, holding a bouquet of pink and purple flowers. To the right, a large melting clock with a cosmic galaxy face and Roman numerals drips against a vibrant, psychedelic sky.

1436.title: Cybernetic Serpent Oracle
1436.description: A metallic futuristic android head with glowing golden eyes wears intricate geometric patterns and headphones. A vibrant purple snake coils around its head and neck while a colorful Earth-like globe with fiery orange core floats in front, all set against a cosmic red background with swirling nebulae and circuit patterns.

1437.title: Lizard Clock Surreal Dream
1437.description: A vibrant green lizard with a large orange eye clings to an ornate clock face, its body and tail forming the clock hands. The surreal scene features swirling pastel patterns, floating clouds, and multiple watchful eyes in the background.

1438.title: Snake and Centipede
1438.description: A vibrant surreal painting depicts a large blue snake with white patterns and red eyes, smoking a cigarette while coiled above a human hand with green nails holding a large black centipede. Colorful abstract smoke in purple, green, and yellow swirls across the deep blue background alongside yellow spiral patterns.

1439.title: Smoking Serpent Clock
1439.description: A large ornate clock with Roman numerals features three women's faces in its center. A vibrant blue snake with a red eye coils around the clock face while smoking a cigarette, exhaling purple and rainbow smoke against a purple background.

1440.title: Melting Clock Painters
1440.description: Two women in patterned dresses and wide-brimmed green hats sit on stools painting a large melting clock canvas in a vibrant, psychedelic landscape. The scene features swirling green hills, distant purple mountains, floating clouds, and a pastel sky with multiple small clocks scattered in the grass.

1441.title: Celestial Timekeeper
1441.description: A surreal desert landscape features a giant cracked clock with a woman's profile emerging from its face, melting like liquid toward the ground. In the foreground, a robed woman with long dark hair walks across orange dunes while gazing up at the massive timepiece and a glowing celestial orb in a starry sky.

1442.title: Vibrant Alien Women Mural
1442.description: A colorful painting depicts four stylized women in profile with green, yellow, pink, and green skin tones, adorned with intricate patterns and headwraps. They stand in a futuristic white hallway with large glass windows as vibrant paint splashes, spheres, and circular patterns explode across the scene.

1443.title: Desert Wanderer with Orbs
1443.description: A figure in a flowing green robe and headwrap walks barefoot along a winding path through orange sand dunes. The surreal sky glows with a large radiant sun surrounded by colorful floating spheres and spiral patterns.

1445.title: Desert Mystic Spiral
1445.description: A figure in a green patterned robe with long braided hair stands in an orange desert, gazing at a large luminous spiral of white and purple symbols rising into a swirling cosmic sky. A bright yellow celestial body glows above amid purple and green circular patterns.

1444.title: Stasis Melting Portrait
1444.description: A surreal psychedelic portrait of a bald man with a large black mustache and spiky crown, his head melting into dripping magenta slime with green and yellow patterns. In the background, a procession of colorful silhouetted heads with swirling psychedelic motifs floats above a vibrant green field covered in yellow spirals.

1379.title: Fox Dragon Surreal Vision
1379.description: A vibrant red and orange fox with large bat-like dragon wings and a braided mane stands on a floating grassy island. The scene features psychedelic swirls, floating eyes, a large ornate circular portal with a central green eye symbol, and a stylized red flower against a purple background.

189.title: Cosmic Mushroom Landscape
189.description: A surreal painting depicts a giant glowing mushroom with a yellow-green cap and purple stem at the center of a mystical mountain valley. A winding starry path leads toward it under a vibrant cosmic sky filled with swirling nebulae, shooting stars, and colorful auroras, surrounded by smaller mushrooms and pine trees.

547.title: Hooded Necromancer
547.description: A hooded figure with a cracked, skull-like face stands in the foreground holding a glowing green candle. Behind him swirls a massive green vortex with floating butterflies, while a cracked red celestial body and jagged mountains fill the dramatic sky.

1446.title: Mirror-Holding Blue Lizard
1446.description: A vibrant surreal painting depicts a large blue lizard-like creature with green scales and spines holding a small mirror. It stands in a psychedelic room with patterned walls, a circular floor design, and a large blue shadow of a gecko-like figure on the back wall.

1349.title: Onion-Haired Psychedelic Portrait
1349.description: A vibrant surreal illustration features a woman's face with green and yellow patterned hair that flows into long braided tentacles. An anthropomorphic purple onion with an angry expression, wearing a green bow tie, stands in front holding a banana while giving the middle finger.

1447.title: Neon Serpent Lightning
1447.description: A vibrant surreal painting featuring a glowing purple snake coiled in an infinity shape, its body adorned with crescent moons. Bright yellow lightning bolts strike from above while a human face emerges from colorful cosmic clouds against a starry background.

1448.title: Stasis Unit 7
1448.description: A surreal desert scene featuring a towering, rusted biomechanical stasis machine labeled 'STASIS UNIT 7' with glowing circular windows and dripping green ooze. In the foreground, a green-skinned woman in an ornate patterned robe stands observing, while a line of four identical figures walks toward the horizon under a massive moon covered in intricate green clockwork patterns.

1449.title: Psychedelic Serpent Eye
1449.description: A large stylized human eye with a vibrant green iris filled with concentric circles and small flowers dominates the composition. A purple snake with yellow spots coils around the eye, its tongue touching a glowing orb at the center, while yellow flowers and a woman's profile appear on the left against a cosmic nebula background.

1450.title: Cosmic Serpent Vision
1450.description: A vibrant surreal painting features a large glowing purple snake with yellow patterned scales and a vertical slit eye, coiled against a black starry background. Ethereal female profiles with ornate headwraps emerge from swirling psychedelic clouds of pink, purple, and green, intersected by bright yellow lightning bolts.

1451.title: Serpent Eye Vision
1451.description: A surreal close-up of a human eye with a vibrant green iris containing a purple snake coiled around a dark central pupil. Yellow flowers, green foliage, and cosmic purple swirls with stars emanate from the eye against a light blue background.

1452.title: Neural Stasis Projection
1452.description: A surprised blue amorphous creature with large yellow eyes sits on a glowing circular platform, connected by a glowing blue cord to a vibrant futuristic cyberpunk city visible through a large window. The background wall is covered in repeating circular patterns featuring human head silhouettes and text reading 'STASIS', 'NEURAL PROTOCOL', and 'NEUROLOGIC PROTOCOL'.

1453.title: Cosmic Green Alien
1453.description: A vibrant psychedelic painting features a large green alien with oversized red eyes and a slight smile, emerging from behind a blue planet. The scene is filled with floating blue orbs containing smaller yellow figures, swirling patterns, and a fiery orange and yellow cosmic background.

1454.title: Grim Reaper and Time Beetle
1454.description: A vibrant surreal painting depicts a skeletal Grim Reaper in a purple hooded cloak holding a large green beetle with a clock face. The scene is framed by a large clock with Roman numerals surrounded by colorful swirling patterns, clouds, and smaller clock-faced figures.

1455.title: Eye of the Enchanted Forest
1455.description: A giant stylized human eye dominates the composition, its iris containing a dark silhouette of a pine forest with glowing lights. In the lower left foreground, a woman with braided hair wearing a patterned green robe stands facing the eye, observing it.

1456.title: Psychedelic Broccoli Reaper
1456.description: A vibrant surreal scene featuring a hooded skeleton with a glowing green skull, draped in colorful patterned robes, riding a massive cluster of broccoli. A large iridescent beetle perches on the figure's arm while translucent bubbles containing smaller creatures float against a swirling cosmic background of yellow, purple, and green.

1457.title: Cosmic Triple Goddess
1457.description: Three women in profile face right, their bodies and hair adorned with intricate psychedelic spiral patterns in vibrant neon colors. They are set against a dark cosmic background filled with galaxies, nebulae, and swirling colorful patterns.

1458.title: Roller Coaster Sisters
1458.description: Four women with elaborate, colorful hairstyles and headscarves stand in profile in the foreground, gazing right. Behind them a bright green roller coaster twists over a turbulent blue ocean with a colorful coastal town and water tower visible in the distance.

1459.title: Blue Monster and Purple Friend
1459.description: A large blue cartoon creature with lightning bolt eyes and green gloves holds a small smiling purple spiky creature. They stand on a colorful mandala rug in a room with swirling blue walls, yellow flowers, and three stylized female profile faces on the right.

1460.title: Robot and Cosmic Muse
1460.description: A surreal painting split between a nude stylized woman with elaborate hair on the left and a metallic robot with glowing yellow eyes on the right. Between them floats a vibrant swirling planet with purple glowing rings set against a starry nebula background.

1461.title: Dreamcatcher Elephant Earth
1461.description: A surreal painting depicts a bright green elephant with pink accents standing on the left, its trunk raised toward a glowing Earth globe at the center. The Earth is encircled by a large, ornate purple dreamcatcher hanging from the branches of a twisted, stylized tree on the right, with women perched among its limbs against a starry night sky.

1462.title: Stasis-7 Robot
1462.description: A whimsical steampunk robot with a large blue spherical head labeled 'STASIS-7' featuring a wide toothy grin and two circular eyes containing miniature portraits. Its cylindrical yellow body displays multiple circular pods holding small stylized human figures, with green liquid dripping from the top section and mechanical segmented legs visible below.

1463.title: Lizard in Desert Bubble
1463.description: A vibrant surreal painting depicts a green lizard wearing sunglasses and a gold chain, lounging inside a transparent floating bubble chair on a patterned desert landscape. A winding road leads toward distant purple mesas under a giant red sun, with a colorful flower-like tree and scattered psychedelic spheres in the foreground.

1464.title: Serpentine Airship
1464.description: A vibrant steampunk airship shaped like a submarine is coiled by a large, multicolored snake with blue eyes and a golden tongue. The vessel features multiple glowing yellow circular portraits, dripping green slime, and intricate brass gears, set against a dark background with swirling purple figures and an orange fiery sky.

1466.title: Eye of the Storm
1466.description: A surreal psychedelic portrait of a blue-skinned elf-like woman with pointed ears and glowing yellow facial markings, holding a bright lightning bolt that connects to a massive stylized green cat-like eye containing a silhouetted figure. The composition is filled with swirling patterns, floating eye motifs, and electric blue energy against a vibrant cosmic background.

1465.title: Psychedelic Egg Muse
1465.description: A woman viewed from behind with long, flowing multicolored hair in swirling patterns of pink, purple, and gold faces a large decorated egg resting on a dark cloth. The surreal scene features floating petals, golden sparkles, and ethereal faces emerging from the hair against a vibrant cosmic background.

1467.title: Braided Dreamscape
1467.description: A surreal painting depicts a pale woman with closed eyes and long orange braided hair that flows like a river across a psychedelic landscape. Her braid leads to a transparent hanging chair holding patterned pillows, while a colorful tree of glowing orbs stands nearby beneath a large red spiral sun.

1468.title: Cosmic Mountain Muse
1468.description: A surreal portrait of a serene woman with closed eyes, her hair flowing into a vibrant green and purple cosmic mountain crowned by a glowing spiral of light. She exhales a swirling vortex of yellow and magenta energy containing floating crystals, set against a dreamy background of green and purple nebulae filled with circular mandala patterns.

1470.title: Surreal Eclipse Garden
1470.description: A vibrant surreal scene depicts a dark-skinned woman in a blue outfit and wide-brimmed hat sitting in a hanging egg chair. She is surrounded by stylized plants, floating colorful eyeballs, glowing orbs on stalks, and two large ethereal female faces under a dramatic red and black solar eclipse.

1469.title: Alien Veil Over Desert Road
1469.description: A large green-skinned woman's face with dark hair dominates the surreal composition, her mouth area covered by a yellow insectoid alien creature with large black eyes and patterned markings. The background features a winding pink road leading through an orange desert landscape under a red sun, with smaller groups of stylized human figures framed in geometric panels along the left and bottom edges.

1472.title: Rainbow Hair in Meadow
1472.description: A woman with an extraordinarily long, flowing mane of multicolored hair sits in a lush green field at sunset, her back to the viewer. An iridescent egg rests on a dark cloth beside her, surrounded by pink petals and flowers against a backdrop of distant mountains.

1471.title: Breath of the Cosmos
1471.description: A stylized profile of a woman with extraordinarily long, flowing multicolored hair decorated with floral and circular patterns. She exhales a glowing, swirling vortex of rainbow light and pink petals against a dark, cosmic background.

1474.title: Mushroom Sorceress
1474.description: A silhouetted female figure with crescent moon headpiece and beaded hair stands beside a giant glowing mushroom with red and white spotted cap. She reaches out to touch its twisting luminous stem against a blood-red full moon in a dark enchanted forest.

1473.title: Boy with Ruby Ornament
1473.description: A young boy with closed eyes and jeweled hair holds a large, glossy red spherical ornament resting on a holly leaf. The vibrant psychedelic background features colorful silhouettes of female profiles surrounded by swirling patterns and floral motifs.

1475.title: Lotus Dreamer
1475.description: A serene woman's face with closed eyes emerges from swirling blue and green forms, a large purple lotus flower blooming from her forehead. The composition is framed by flowing pink organic shapes against a soft pastel background filled with glowing circles and patterns.

1476.title: Cosmic Emerald Vortex
1476.description: A surreal psychedelic painting featuring a glowing yellow orb at the center of a green braided circular portal, with a bright green crystalline mountain erupting from it. Flowing green liquid splashes across the foreground while stylized human faces and alien symbols float in a swirling purple and blue cosmic background with radiating light beams.

1477.title: Mushroom Ballet Dance
1477.description: A vibrant surreal painting depicts two graceful dancers in a backbend pose, supporting each other beneath an enormous glowing mushroom. The forest scene features swirling psychedelic patterns, luminous fungi, and ethereal light emanating from the giant mushroom cap.

1478.title: Green Alien Portal
1478.description: A surreal painting featuring a green alien with large purple eyes emerging from swirling green smoke. To the right is a woman's face with closed eyes and golden hair, surrounded by floating vinyl records and circular patterns in green, purple, and yellow.

1481.title: Ballerina Crown Lift
1481.description: Two ballerinas perform an acrobatic lift against a vibrant purple background. The upper dancer wears an ornate golden crown while balanced in arabesque, supported by the lower dancer in a sparkling green and gold tutu.

1480.title: Mushroom Ballet at Sunset
1480.description: A vibrant surreal painting depicts two ballerinas in flowing green and purple costumes performing a graceful lift by a reflective body of water. A massive, intricately patterned mushroom with a green cap and white spots stands prominently on the shore, surrounded by stylized pine trees under a fiery red and orange sky.

1483.title: Mushroom Medusa
1483.description: A vibrant psychedelic portrait of a green-skinned female figure with glowing red eyes, ornate facial markings, and snake-like hair entwined with a colorful serpent. She holds a large, luminous green mushroom with white spots and a purple patterned underside against a dark, swirling background with faint female faces.

1482.title: Alien Oracle in Cosmic Arena
1482.description: A green-skinned alien with large purple eyes and golden patterns stands in the foreground, its hand resting on the head of a pale woman with flowing pink hair and closed eyes. They are positioned within a vast circular amphitheater filled with an audience of stylized figures, beneath a swirling purple and orange cosmic sky featuring a radiant golden sun emblem.

1484.title: Ballet at Sunset Lake
1484.description: Two ballerinas in colorful patterned leotards and tutus perform a graceful lift on the surface of a reflective lake at dusk. A large rat stands on a wooden dock watching a glowing lantern flower while a giant red sun with spiral patterns sets over the forested horizon.

1485.title: Corn Cyborgs in Stasis
1485.description: A vibrant surreal illustration features three green humanoid figures with corn cob heads and faces, wearing intricate futuristic helmets and armor. They stand against a glowing red background with large psychedelic mushrooms, vines, and floating particles above them.

1486.title: Mushroom Sorceress
1486.description: A vibrant surreal portrait of a green-skinned female figure with a large yellow mushroom cap growing from her head, adorned with tiny skulls. Her flowing blue and orange hair swirls with psychedelic patterns while her face features skeletal jaw details, glowing red eyes, and blue lips against a dark forest backdrop filled with more skulls and ethereal figures.

1487.title: Psychedelic Mushroom Gathering
1487.description: A vibrant surreal scene features a massive glowing mushroom with white dripping patterns and circular panels containing groups of tiny human figures. Below it, a line of stylized women with colorful patterned skin and elaborate hairstyles stand in a glowing, otherworldly forest with hanging lights and melting forms.

1488.title: Psychedelic Skull Muse
1488.description: A vibrant pop-art portrait of a blue-haired woman with bright blue lips holding a small yellow skull between her fingers. A large green zombie-like skull with glowing red eyes peers over her shoulder from behind, all set against a hypnotic background of swirling colorful spirals.

1489.title: Zombie Egg Hypnosis
1489.description: A large green zombie with glowing orange eyes and cracked skin stares intensely from the right side of the frame. A smooth purple egg sits on a flat surface to the left, surrounded by colorful hypnotic swirls, floating yellow silhouette heads, and concentric target circles.

1490.title: Astronaut and Cosmic Entity
1490.description: A female astronaut in a white spacesuit stands on a patterned cosmic surface, reaching toward a tall dark amorphous figure covered in colorful spherical orbs. Vibrant swirling ribbons of red, orange, green and blue flow between them, containing stylized faces and abstract patterns against a starry nebula background.

1492.title: Chick in Cosmic Lily
1492.description: A large golden-yellow lily flower blooms against a starry purple night sky, its petals cradling multiple dark-skinned children's faces. In the foreground, a yellow winged chick with large blue eyes emerges from a colorful patterned basket, pointing upward as three blue patterned butterflies flutter nearby, surrounded by vibrant green and pink silhouetted figures.

1491.title: Alien Skull and Astronaut
1491.description: A green skeletal alien with red eyes and intricate braids stares directly at the viewer from the left side. In the center, an astronaut in a decorated white spacesuit kneels on a glowing yellow rock, reaching toward a large green planet covered in yellow circles and skulls, while a small white egg with spiral patterns rests on a purple surface in the foreground.

1493.title: Lotus Meditation
1493.description: A green-skinned woman with closed eyes sits serenely within a large pink lotus flower floating on a pond. Her hair is composed of intricate colorful spirals while two smaller figures with yellow hair rest on lily pads below and a vibrant psychedelic swirl of rainbow patterns flows to the right.

1494.title: Serenity on Mystic Waters
1494.description: A woman with an elaborate headwrap rows a decorated wooden boat across dark reflective water. Above her, vibrant, swirling psychedelic patterns in fiery colors form faces and abstract shapes against a gradient sky.

1495.title: Cosmic City Faces
1495.description: A vibrant surreal painting featuring four stylized female profiles in the foreground with intricate facial patterns and colorful skin tones.
