They face a towering futuristic city skyline silhouetted against a massive glowing orange celestial body with swirling purple orbital rings in a starry cosmic sky.

1496.title: Psychedelic Alien Portrait
1496.description: A vibrant surreal painting of a green-skinned alien with a large head, black eyes with orange spirals, and a slight smile. The figure merges with a realistic human eye on the right side, surrounded by colorful swirling patterns, concentric circles, and stylized human faces in yellow against a purple border.

1497.title: Golden Retriever and Alien
1497.description: A golden retriever puppy holds a bouquet of red tulips in its mouth while a green alien stands beside it with one hand raised. The background features a stylized industrial city with smoking factories under a vibrant orange and purple sky, with a woman's silhouette and floating abstract patterns.

1498.title: Celestial Dream Theater
1498.description: A surreal painting depicts a giant ethereal woman with golden curled hair floating above an audience seated in a circular amphitheater. Her eyes are closed as she rests her hand near her face, set against a vibrant cosmic sky featuring a radiant sun, swirling colorful clouds, and ornate mandala patterns.

1499.title: Cosmic City Silhouette
1499.description: A vibrant surreal painting featuring a black city skyline with illuminated windows silhouetted against a massive glowing orange sun or planet. In the foreground, a series of stylized female profiles with elaborate, colorful psychedelic hair and facial patterns curve along a winding cosmic ring decorated with symbols and smaller planetary motifs.

1500.title: Celestial Dreamer Portrait
1500.description: A stylized portrait of a woman with pale blue skin and elaborate golden braided hair in an updo, her eyes closed in serene expression. She is surrounded by a large pink celestial orb containing a faded duplicate of her face, set against a dark starry background with vibrant swirling psychedelic patterns in purple, orange, and green.

1501.title: Starry Countryside Reverie
1501.description: A blonde woman in a green patterned dress stands pensively in a rural landscape, her hand touching her chin as colorful swirling patterns emanate from her head and body into the night sky. The background features rolling yellow fields, wooden fences, farmhouses, trees, and a vibrant starry sky filled with swirling orange, purple, and blue clouds.

1502.title: Dual-Faced Verdant Entity
1502.description: A surreal portrait of a female figure with pale lavender skin and flowing green hair, her face split between a serene human side with glowing yellow and purple eyes and a monstrous green plant-like side featuring a wide open maw filled with sharp yellow teeth and a glowing eye.

1503.title: Infinity Dragon in Landscape
1503.description: A large orange dragon with intricate circular patterns forms an infinity symbol across a rural countryside scene. In the foreground, a woman in a red dress and golden headdress holds yellow flowers while standing beside the dragon's body.

1505.title: Braided Muse Over Cityscape
1505.description: A woman in profile with elaborate golden braided hair adorned with flowers and leaves, wearing a green pixelated top, stands in a rural landscape with wooden fences and houses. Behind her rises a futuristic green and yellow city skyline under a cloudy sky filled with glowing orange orbs and abstract light patterns.

1504.title: Psychedelic Infinity Dragon
1504.description: A vibrant surreal painting depicts a large orange infinity loop with intricate patterns, formed by two green dragons with golden manes and saddles. A woman in a flowing red cape and headdress rides atop the loop while a large smiling bubble emoji floats in the upper right against a swirling psychedelic sky.

1506.title: Stasis Serpent
1506.description: A large, vibrant blue snake with intricate psychedelic patterns and a red eye smokes a cigarette while coiled in a rural landscape. Purple smoke rises from the cigarette forming swirling shapes containing human faces, with the word STASIS floating in the purple cloud above.

1507.title: Infinity Dragon and Maidens
1507.description: A vibrant surreal painting depicts a large ornate orange dragon forming an infinity loop across a colorful flower field. A woman in a red hooded cloak rides the dragon holding a staff topped with a glowing smiley face orb, while a woman in a yellow dress stands below among oversized flowers; hot air balloons float in the background under a purple and orange sky.

1508.title: Garlic and Bubble Smile
1508.description: A surreal scene features an anthropomorphic garlic bulb with an angry face, bow tie and earring, standing between green spheres on a patterned surface. A large iridescent smiley-face bubble floats above, set against a psychedelic background of swirling concentric circles in yellow, purple and green.

1509.title: Bubble Witch Pumpkin
1509.description: A vibrant surreal painting shows a woman with long flowing red hair enclosed in a large transparent bubble with a smiley face, floating above a glowing purple jack-o'-lantern that drips pink liquid. The scene is surrounded by colorful flowers and set against a gradient purple night sky with decorative swirls.

1510.title: Smiling Cloud Vision
1510.description: A vibrant surreal painting shows a green-skinned woman with a colorful patterned headwrap gazing at a large smiling pink and purple cloud inside a translucent bubble. Her outstretched hand reaches toward the bubble while surrounded by swirling floral patterns, tulips, and peonies in a psychedelic dreamlike landscape.

1512.title: Mushroom Guardian
1512.description: A large yellow robot with a solemn expression sits beneath an enormous glowing green mushroom cap adorned with white spots. In the foreground, three small girls in yellow dresses hold hands while walking along a winding glowing path through a psychedelic forest.

1511.title: Cybernetic Dragon Portrait
1511.description: A detailed digital painting of a metallic humanoid cyborg with intricate circuit patterns and glowing yellow eyes, merged with a blue scaled Chinese dragon that coils around its head. The figure is set against a vibrant cosmic nebula background with purple, blue and red hues filled with floating East Asian decorative motifs.

1513.title: Corn & Unit 44
1513.description: A surreal psychedelic scene featuring a green-suited astronaut with a corn cob head holding blue spheres, standing beside a large metallic robot head labeled UNIT 44 with glowing orange eyes. The background shows a vibrant cosmic nebula with dripping paint effects and floating smaller astronaut figures.

1515.title: Serpent and Crescent Moon
1515.description: A surreal painting featuring a large green scaled serpent with an open mouth and a woman's face emerging from purple and yellow smoke. In the upper right, a dark crescent moon contains three colorful stylized female profiles, while three green horses with yellow manes gallop across a vibrant, wavy orange and pink landscape below.

1514.title: Smiling Cloud in Bubble
1514.description: A vibrant psychedelic painting shows a purple-skinned woman with green hair offering a bouquet of smiling flowers toward a large transparent bubble containing a fluffy pink cloud with a winking smiley face. The surreal scene is surrounded by swirling vines, floating bubbles, and colorful silhouettes against a bright turquoise and pink background.

1516.title: Psychedelic Egg Vision
1516.description: A surreal psychedelic scene features a large iridescent egg on a black platform containing the profile of a woman with green spiral hair. In the background, a green-skinned woman with flowing hair rides two translucent green horses across swirling colorful patterns and floating petals.

1517.title: Emerald Horses and Serpent
1517.description: Two vibrant green horses with Celtic spiral patterns gallop across a psychedelic landscape as a large green serpent with open mouth and red eyes emerges from swirling purple clouds filled with stylized female faces.

1518.title: Cosmic Green Horses
1518.description: A vibrant psychedelic painting depicts two green horses with yellow manes galloping across a surreal landscape. Three riders with green skin sit atop the rear horse while glowing orbs and blue energy beams connect elements of the cosmic scene featuring a starry lake, rainbow sun, and stylized mountains.

1520.title: Green Horses in Boat
1520.description: A vibrant surreal painting depicts three women in colorful headscarves rowing a wooden boat on a swirling purple river while two large green horses with yellow manes gallop through the water beside them. The background features sailboats on the horizon, stylized trees, and a psychedelic sky filled with spiral clouds and a glowing sun.

1519.title: Four Ornate Women Portrait
1519.description: A vibrant, stylized painting depicts four women shown from the shoulders up in a row, each with elaborate, swirling hairstyles and headdresses. Their faces feature striking orange spiral eyes, intricate facial patterns, and decorative neck and ear adornments against a psychedelic background of concentric circles.

1521.title: Flower-Crowned Serpent Woman
1521.description: A woman in profile with reddish-blonde braided hair wears a colorful flower crown and a green patterned garment. A large, ornate purple and yellow serpent coils around her neck and shoulders, its head raised beside her against a swirling, psychedelic sky.

1522.title: Cybernetic Dragon Oracle
1522.description: A surreal painting features a metallic robotic head with glowing yellow eyes and golden horns, partially covered in blue dragon scales. A black silhouette of a woman with flowing multicolored hair stands before swirling psychedelic patterns, dragons, and geometric motifs against a vibrant red and cosmic background.

1523.title: Cyborg in Neon City
1523.description: A profile portrait of a metallic cyborg with glowing yellow eyes and exposed mechanical components. The figure's neck and shoulder feature vibrant psychedelic patterns in bright colors, set against a dark gothic cityscape with illuminated spires under a red and magenta sky.

1524.title: Dragon and Sorceress
1524.description: A surreal cosmic painting featuring a large blue dragon coiled through swirling nebulae and a silhouetted female figure with flowing starry hair holding a small glowing orb. In the foreground, a green-skinned woman's cracked face with one yellow eye and one red eye stares forward, set against a vibrant purple and teal galaxy background.

1525.title: Celestial Dragon and Moon Goddesses
1525.description: A vibrant psychedelic artwork depicts a large blue and purple dragon coiled around a bright green crescent moon with radiating blue spikes. Four stylized female faces with intricate headdresses emerge from the moon against a deep magenta background with colorful circular motifs.

1527.title: Cosmic Dragon Realm
1527.description: A vibrant surreal painting depicts a large blue and orange Chinese dragon encircling a glowing orange orb containing a misty mountain landscape with a red pagoda and boats on water. Four stylized human figures with colorful skin and intricate patterns appear in the foreground against a starry cosmic background with swirling purple and blue nebulae.

1528.title: Spiraling Desert Visions
1528.description: A surreal painting depicts a procession of identical women with elaborate blue spiral hair walking along a winding golden path through a desert landscape dotted with cacti. Large circular motifs resembling vinyl records or cosmic patterns float in the sky around a prominent red-orange sun.

1526.title: Surreal Procession to Red Sun
1526.description: A vibrant surreal painting depicts a winding golden path leading toward a large red sun with circular patterns, set against a dramatic red and orange sky. In the foreground, stylized women with elaborate patterned headwraps and colorful attire stand near a cluster of multicolored faces, while dark gothic castles with glowing windows loom in the background.

1529.title: Green Goddess Over Wasteland
1529.description: A surreal double-faced female profile with vibrant green skin and intricate swirling patterns dominates the left side. Her hair flows into dripping green tendrils above a dark futuristic city skyline, while an orange desert road winds through a barren landscape toward rocky formations under a large red sun.

1531.title: Green Cosmic Wanderer
1531.description: A surreal profile portrait of a green-skinned woman with elaborate braided hair dripping with neon green and purple liquid, set against a desert landscape with a futuristic city skyline emerging from her neck. A large red sun hangs in a pink sky with planetary rings, while two small figures walk along a winding path through the orange desert dotted with rock formations.

1530.title: Woman and Luminous Dog
1530.description: A vibrant psychedelic painting depicts a black silhouette of a woman gently cupping the face of a large, glowing lime-green dog. Her long, flowing hair merges with swirling, fiery cosmic patterns against a starry, multicolored nebula background.

1532.title: Surreal Bubble Dreamscape
1532.description: A vibrant surreal painting depicts a large iridescent bubble containing a silhouetted haunted house on a green hill under a full moon, with two ornate silhouetted figures in the foreground. A wooden balcony railing holds a glass jar overflowing with colorful flowers beside a swirling blue sea and psychedelic sky.

1533.title: Snake Charmer in Psychedelic Landscape
1533.description: A vibrant surreal painting depicts a stylized woman with green hair and a large green hat smoking a pipe, from which a purple snake with yellow eyes emerges. The winding road below transforms into multiple purple snakes slithering through a foggy mountain range under a dramatic fiery orange and purple sky.

1534.title: Cowboy at the Stasis Fence
1534.description: A cowboy in a green hat and floral shirt leans on a wooden fence overlooking the ocean, holding a bucket of vibrant flowers. Behind him a stylized blue horse with red mane gallops across the waves under a dramatic sunset sky, with the word STASIS visible on the fence.

1535.title: Sloth Star Weaver
1535.description: A vibrant surreal painting depicts a woman with long braided hair reaching toward a glowing green star in a cosmic sky. Inside a cave in her torso, a sloth holds a smaller star while a red planet, multiple colorful orbs, and a desert landscape with winding paths fill the scene.

1536.title: Surreal Serpent and Lily
1536.description: A vibrant surreal painting features three overlapping profiles of a woman with dark skin, wearing a patterned headwrap, her faces rendered in purple, yellow, and blue tones. A large golden lily appears in the foreground while a patterned purple and green snake floats among stylized clouds in a striped sky.

1537.title: Surreal Desert Entanglement
1537.description: A vibrant surreal painting depicts a large green spherical entity containing multiple women's faces, entwined with black vines and glowing patterns, resting on a rocky desert roadside. In the background, a winding path leads toward distant figures walking under a massive red celestial body in a swirling orange sky.

1538.title: Mushroom Vision
1538.description: A vibrant surreal painting shows four silhouetted women with colorful psychedelic hair patterns gazing at giant glowing mushrooms under a starry green sky. On the right, the same women stand on a wooden balcony overlooking a calm blue ocean with a vase of bright wildflowers.

1539.title: Bubbles Over Haunted Shore
1539.description: A surreal night scene viewed from a wooden balcony railing overlooking a turbulent dark blue sea. A bouquet of vibrant purple, pink, and yellow flowers sits on the railing while numerous transparent bubbles float across the frame, some containing miniature figures, with a dark illuminated house perched on a misty cliff under a glowing moon.

1540.title: Dragon with Flower Bouquet
1540.description: A vibrant green dragon with intricate patterns and flower decorations leans on a decorated wooden railing, holding a large yellow vase filled with colorful flowers. In the background, a calm blue sea stretches under a rainbow sky with a small sailboat and a woman visible on the water.

1541.title: Psychedelic Heart Scene
1541.description: A vibrant surreal painting depicts three colorful humanoid figures standing in a misty forest clearing, gazing at a large heart-shaped portal filled with a starry night sky, shooting stars, and a flaming golden heart at its center. The foreground features oversized red-and-white spotted mushrooms, while a quaint glowing house sits among twisted trees in the background, all framed by dripping purple borders and floating circular patterns.

1542.title: Lily Whisperer Portrait
1542.description: A profile portrait of a young woman with long reddish-brown hair in braids, adorned with golden lilies and floral patterns. She gently holds a large golden lily flower against a vibrant, swirling background of yellows, greens, and purples with circular motifs and distant silhouettes.

1544.title: Surreal Dragonfly Muse
1544.description: A large detailed dragonfly with two women's faces on its wings rests on a vibrant red chrysanthemum. To the right, a stylized woman's profile with golden hair and red silhouette stands beside a large yellow lily against a starry twilight sky.

1543.title: Mushroom Forest Dreamscape
1543.description: A vibrant psychedelic painting featuring a large red and white spotted mushroom surrounded by smaller fungi in a dark forest clearing. The scene is encircled by numerous translucent bubbles containing colorful stylized female profile faces with elaborate curly hair in neon yellow, green, pink, and blue.

1545.title: Mushroom Child Vision
1545.description: A surreal portrait of a young East Asian boy with golden cracks across his face and one glowing yellow eye, set against a swirling purple vortex background. Golden linework connects floating profile faces and intricate circular patterns, while prominent red-capped Amanita muscaria mushrooms grow in the foreground.

1546.title: Lotus Dream by the Sea
1546.description: A vibrant surreal painting depicts a large red lotus with a spiral center in a green bowl filled with blueberries, resting on a wooden railing. In the background, a stylized green-skinned woman with colorful hair and flowers gazes over a blue sea with a sailboat, under a sunset sky with floating orange squares.

1547.title: Lotus Bowl by the Sea
1547.description: A vibrant surreal painting features a giant red lotus flower with silhouetted female figures in its petals, emerging from a green bowl filled with blueberries. On a wooden pier overlooking a blue ocean, three stylized women with flower headdresses stand beside a bouquet of purple and white flowers under a colorful pixelated sky.

1549.title: Geisha and Giant Dragonfly
1549.description: A woman in a red and gold kimono holds a red paper umbrella while standing on a path and gazing at an enormous yellow dragonfly hovering nearby. The surreal scene is set in a misty forest with two large red chrysanthemum trees and smaller dragonflies in the background.

1548.title: Mushroom Wizard and Dragonfly
1548.description: A silhouetted wizard with glowing green spiral hair stands on a purple hill holding a staff, facing a giant luminous green mushroom with white spots and dripping patterns. A large detailed dragonfly perches on the mushroom cap while four robed figures stand in the background within a circular ornate frame.

1550.title: Fairy and Chrysanthemum
1550.description: An Art Nouveau style illustration featuring two overlapping women's profiles in red and yellow, one with large golden insect wings and elaborate red floral headdress, facing a large red chrysanthemum flower against a swirling green and yellow psychedelic background.

1551.title: Dragonfly Lighthouse
1551.description: A surreal night scene featuring a towering green lighthouse with a giant dragonfly perched on its lamp, projecting a bright beam of light. In the foreground, a massive dragonfly rests on purple cracked ground while small human figures stand nearby, with a stylized city of face-adorned buildings and a large green planet in the starry sky.

1552.title: Birds on Branch with Women
1552.description: A stylized painting shows two small green birds perched on a thin branch that extends from the left side. The background features a large profile of a yellow-green woman on the right alongside two smaller overlapping female profiles with colorful patterned hair in the center, all set against a dark blue field filled with floating translucent squares in orange, red, and pink.

1554.title: Psychedelic Eye and Hares
1554.description: A surreal painting of a large stylized human face in profile with an enormous green eye containing a swirling forest and central blue orb. Two brown hares leap from the eye and nose toward the right against a turquoise background filled with floating floral orbs and decorative patterns.

1555.title: Celestial Road of Ancestors
1555.description: A surreal desert landscape features a winding golden road under a large red sun. Floating in the sky are multiple stylized female profiles of varying skin tones, adorned with intricate patterns and headwraps, enclosed within translucent bubbles filled with spirals and cosmic motifs.

1556.title: Floral Women Portrait
1556.description: A vibrant psychedelic artwork featuring overlapping profiles of women's faces in yellow, green, and purple hues. A large pink peony with detailed center dominates the composition, surrounded by swirling patterns, dots, and smaller floral motifs.

1557.title: Alien Lotus Meditation
1557.description: A woman in a yellow dress and patterned headscarf sits in a pond of concentric ripples among pink lotus flowers, gazing upward at a large green orb containing a curled glowing alien figure waving its hand. The surreal scene is connected by ornate blue and teal braided patterns to smaller floating orbs with alien heads and lotuses against a white background.

1558.title: Mouse and Cosmic Eye Spiral
1558.description: A brown mouse stands on a yellow lily pad gazing up at a large swirling vortex that forms an enormous eye. The spiral contains stylized human faces, stars, yin-yang symbols, and intricate patterns in teal, purple, and green.

1559.title: Mushroom Dreamscape
1559.description: A vibrant surreal nighttime forest scene dominated by a giant red-and-white spotted mushroom with a woman emerging from its stem. Numerous translucent bubbles float throughout, each containing stylized portraits of Black women with colorful headwraps and hairstyles.

1553.title: Blueberry Lotus Dream
1553.description: A vibrant surreal painting featuring a large green bowl overflowing with blueberries, from which grows a tall stylized red lotus flower with a golden spiral center. To the right, a series of colorful stylized female profiles with ornate headdresses and swirling pink and purple decorative flourishes emerge against a bright green background patterned with orange and red geometric squares.

1560.title: Psychedelic Mushroom Path
1560.description: A vibrant surreal landscape features a winding path leading toward a massive red-and-white mushroom with a green stem standing in a lily pond. In the foreground, four stylized female profiles in overlapping colors face right, set against a teal sky with a large red sun and colorful circular patterns.

1561.title: Psychedelic Ruins
1561.description: A vibrant surreal painting depicts four stylized women in profile with colorful patterned hair and faces in the foreground, set against a backdrop of decaying high-rise buildings under a dramatic red sky. Swirling orange, purple, and blue circular patterns and splashes overlay the dystopian urban scene.

1562.title: Mushroom Cabbage Dreamscape
1562.description: A vibrant surreal painting featuring a giant green cabbage with a large Amanita muscaria mushroom growing from its center. The background contains a stylized female profile with purple hair, surrounded by floating circular vignettes depicting tiny figures and mushrooms.

1564.title: Psychedelic Mushroom Swamp
1564.description: A surreal fantasy landscape featuring a giant red Amanita muscaria mushroom with white spots at the center of a dark reflective pool filled with lily pads. In the foreground is a large green cabbage-like plant with a glowing red core, set against black rocky formations dripping with orange lava under a swirling red and pink cosmic sky.

1565.title: Psychedelic Mushroom Vortex
1565.description: A vibrant surreal painting depicts a giant green mushroom with a woman's silhouette and flowing colorful hair on its cap, surrounded by smaller red-capped mushrooms on lily pads in dark water. A large swirling vortex of concentric circles in pink, orange, and blue dominates the background with abstract drips and patterns.

1567.title: Psychedelic Floral Vision
1567.description: A surreal portrait of a woman's face in profile with one normal eye and the other replaced by a large green rose with a red center. Translucent bubbles containing smaller versions of the face and geometric patterns float to the left against a green background with glowing yellow orbs.

1566.title: Cabbage Oracle
1566.description: A surreal painting featuring a large green cabbage with a glowing red core on the left side, alongside four overlapping stylized female profiles in green, purple and pink hues adorned with intricate golden patterns and headdresses.

1568.title: Cabbage Muse
1568.description: A large, vibrant green cabbage with intricate layered leaves dominates the composition, its center revealing a deep purple core with a bright red diamond shape. Within the right side of the cabbage leaves, a stylized female profile with ornate golden patterns is integrated into the form, set against a textured gold background with dripping blue and green watercolor elements and circular motifs.

1569.title: Golden Veil Cabbage Bloom
1569.description: A surreal watercolor painting featuring a large green cabbage-like flower with a glowing red drop at its dark center. Above it, stylized teal female profiles with intricate spiral patterns emerge from layered gold leaf bands that drip downward against a fluid blue background.
1569.medium: watercolor and gold leaf on paper

1571.title: Alien Oracle in Neon City
1571.description: A grey-skinned alien with large yellow eyes and elongated fingers holds a glowing yellow orb containing faint faces. The surreal nighttime street scene features floating orbs with spiral patterns, geometric overlays, and green graffiti under a purple sky.

1570.title: Golden Muse Portrait
1570.description: A grayscale woman with long flowing hair streaked with yellow looks upward against a vibrant green background. Dynamic yellow and gold circular patterns, splatters, and swirling lines emanate from her hair and the right side of the composition.
1570.medium: digital art with overhead projector texture

1573.title: Cabbage Flame Goddess
1573.description: A vibrant surreal painting featuring a large green cabbage with a glowing red core at its center, surrounded by bright orange and yellow flames. Three stylized female profiles with intricate head patterns and flowing hair in green and yellow tones emerge from the right side against a background of colorful concentric circles.

1572.title: Hydra of Verdant Realms
1572.description: A surreal painting depicts four green female faces in profile sharing a single neck, gazing leftward. A large black and purple scaled dragon with glowing yellow eyes coils behind them, its head raised above with mouth open.

1574.title: Zombie Bubble Portraits
1574.description: A surreal digital painting featuring multiple cracked, green-skinned zombie-like female faces with yellow and red eyes, each enclosed in translucent glowing spheres connected by geometric lines and splashes of paint. The figures have swirling black hair patterns and appear against a gray background with diagonal white stripes and smaller colorful circular motifs.

1575.title: Green Dog Portrait
1575.description: A surreal green dog with intricate patterns and a human female profile visible within its head, surrounded by three circular cabbage-like forms with red centers against a patterned background.

1576.title: Split Face Desert Portrait
1576.description: A surreal split-face portrait of a woman emerges from stylized sand dunes, with the left side in warm red-orange tones adorned with green leaves and the right side in cool green-blue hues featuring small human figures. The background shows a gradient sky from teal to purple with two celestial bodies, one white and one yellow, above rocky formations.

1577.title: Women Boating to Mushroom Isle
1577.description: Three women wearing colorful patterned headscarves and vibrant clothing sit together in a red and white ornate boat on stylized water. They are paddling toward a giant red-and-white mushroom surrounded by smaller mushrooms growing on lily pads under a twilight sky.

1578.title: Psychedelic Mushroom Voyage
1578.description: A vibrant surreal scene depicts a colorful Viking-style longship with a white sail gliding across dark water toward an island covered in giant red, yellow, and purple mushrooms. In the foreground, stylized human profiles with intricate swirling patterns emerge from the water, surrounded by lily pads under a twilight sky.

1579.title: Cosmic Visionaries
1579.description: Three stylized figures with green and purple skin stand in a desert landscape gazing upward at a vibrant cosmic scene. A large green planet, swirling blue vortex, colorful energy ribbons, and floating asteroids fill the starry purple sky above orange rock formations.

1580.title: Surreal Cosmic Whale Serpent
1580.description: A vibrant surreal scene depicts a large teal whale floating above a stylized city street at night, intertwined with a colorful patterned serpent whose body coils around it. In the psychedelic sky, two stylized female profiles with green and yellow skin appear amid swirling patterns, glowing orbs, and concentric circles.

1581.title: Mushroom Dreamscape
1581.description: A surreal night scene featuring a large blue-skinned woman's head and shoulders emerging from lily pads on water, with closed eyes and a smoking cigarette. Psychedelic mushrooms grow around her, while a robed figure stands on the shore beside a sailboat under a starry sky with green aurora borealis.

1582.title: Psychedelic Desert Vision
1582.description: A vibrant surreal painting depicts four colorful women with elaborate headdresses standing in a line, gazing right toward a large green bird-like tree creature with a single large eye and orange beak. The background shows a desert landscape with orange rock formations under a starry night sky transitioning to twilight, with yellow orbs floating from the creature's branches.

1583.title: Tree of Visions
1583.description: A massive, gnarled tree with a large bird-like head and multiple green human faces grows from cracked desert ground. In the background, four glowing figures walk across a yellow path in front of towering red rock buttes under a starry night sky with a crescent moon.

1584.title: Women in a Striped Boat
1584.description: Four colorful women with distinct hair colors sit together in a red and white striped boat on rippling water. Two forested islands float in the background beneath a dark teal sky filled with overlapping translucent circles in vibrant hues.

1585.title: Millipede Sage
1585.description: A surreal illustration shows a dark-skinned man wearing a black beret, round glasses, and a green fringed scarf, holding a large coiled black and yellow millipede in his outstretched hand. In the background, a stylized woman's profile with intricate golden patterns appears against a deep blue sky, while a procession of small silhouetted figures walks along a sandy path toward rocky formations under a large glowing moon with concentric circles.

1586.title: Psychedelic Mind Garden
1586.description: A vibrant surreal scene features a blue stylized head at the center with colorful swirling thought forms and icons emerging from its mind. It is surrounded by potted plants with patterned leaves and stems, set against a background of concentric circles and a large central spiral vortex.

1588.title: Man with Green Dog
1588.description: A stylized portrait of a serious man wearing a blue beret, round glasses, and a bright green scarf, standing beside a lime-green dog with a patterned ear. The vibrant pink background features concentric circles, floating stylized faces, and dynamic blue diagonal streaks crossing the composition.

1587.title: Surreal Whale and Serpent Sky
1587.description: A massive teal whale adorned with golden ropes and a woman's silhouette floats above a cracked pink road between two rows of glowing storefronts. A large colorful serpent coils through the psychedelic purple sky filled with swirling patterns and bubble-like orbs containing smaller figures.

1589.title: Citrus Archipelago Steampunk
1589.description: A surreal steampunk spider-like machine with glowing orange eyes and smoking pipes towers over a miniature city labeled 'CITRUS ARCHIPELAGO' with palm trees. To the left, a portrait of a bearded man wearing a beret and glasses has an orange-segment beard, connected by swirling lines to the mechanical creature.

1590.title: Whale in Cosmic Teardrop
1590.description: A large translucent blue whale composed of intricate circuit-like patterns floats in space, its body containing a portrait of a bearded man wearing a beret and glasses. A swirling cosmic vortex with glowing purple center and yellow-green rings dominates the dark purple background, surrounded by floating faces and colorful abstract swirls.

1591.title: Psychedelic Braided Muse
1591.description: A surreal portrait merges a young woman's face adorned with a flower crown and an elderly bearded man wearing a beret, their forms connected by an elaborately braided hair strand embedded with flowers and googly eyes. To the left, a dripping purple slime creature with large green eyes and a wide grin melts into puddles against a vibrant swirling background.

1592.title: Millipede Scholar
1592.description: A stylized portrait of a bespectacled man wearing a patterned black beret and a green fringed scarf, holding a large coiled black millipede in his open palm. The surreal night scene features a glowing full moon, swirling yellow patterns, and an abstract rocky landscape under a deep blue and teal sky.

1593.title: Steampunk Spider and Psychedelic Mushroom
1593.description: A surreal night scene featuring a giant mechanical spider robot with glowing orange eyes towering over a foggy cityscape, while a large blue mushroom character with a smiling face stands in the foreground. Vibrant, glowing orbs filled with icons, silhouettes, and miniature scenes float above against a swirling cosmic sky.

1594.title: Steampunk Bug Over City
1594.description: A massive mechanical insect with glowing orange eyes and intricate green and yellow body hovers over a stylized nighttime city street. The surreal psychedelic scene features swirling colorful smoke patterns, scattered oranges on the ground, and buildings with glowing signs under a hazy sky.

1595.title: Cucumber Robot Over City
1595.description: A large mechanical robot with glowing orange eyes and cucumber-like texture stands over a misty cityscape featuring signs for Orange Grove and Holly Plaza. The foreground shows a dense cluster of whole and sliced green cucumbers on the left, while three stylized women with patterned hair and hats observe from the bottom right against a dark blue background with floating orange spheres.

1596.title: Cabbage Goddess Trio
1596.description: A vibrant surreal illustration features a large, detailed green cabbage with a glowing red heart at its core, surrounded by floating orange slices and leaves. To the right, three overlapping stylized female profiles in yellow, red, and green with ornate hair patterns emerge from the foliage against a deep purple background.

1597.title: Surreal Spider Waterfall
1597.description: A vibrant surreal painting depicts a mechanical spider with glowing eyes and circuit-board patterns standing on a circular platform covered in shamrocks and clovers. In the background, a neon-lit city street with pedestrians sits below a massive swirling vortex in purple and green containing two floating heads, while a large red rock formation pours a multicolored waterfall into the mist.

1599.title: Oranges and Sisters Portrait
1599.description: Two women in profile face left against a dark blue background filled with a repeating pattern of oranges, orange slices, lemons, garlic bulbs, and green leaves. The woman on the left has yellow-green skin and an elaborate updo adorned with orange slices, while the woman on the right has magenta skin and wears a colorful patterned headwrap with a circular earring featuring a silhouette.

1598.title: Pickled Patriarch Portrait
1598.description: A stylized portrait of an older man with a stern expression, his face and head fragmented into a mosaic of irregular shapes. Large green pickles with bumpy texture cover portions of his face, ears, and head against a purple patterned background.

1600.title: Verdant Eye Vision
1600.description: A vibrant surreal painting features a large stylized green female profile whose hair and body transform into flowing leaves and vines. Her eye is a detailed spiral vortex containing a miniature forest landscape with pine trees under a glowing orange sun, surrounded by floating pickles and three smaller colorful female faces above.

1601.title: Psychedelic Fairy Profile
1601.description: A vibrant surreal illustration shows a large translucent dragonfly-fairy hybrid with a woman's profile face, integrated into flowing orange and pink ribbons. The dark purple and blue background is filled with orange slices, green leaves, and smaller colorful fairy figures amid decorative swirls and dots.

1602.title: Cyberpunk Floral Portrait
1602.description: A surreal cyberpunk portrait features two women's faces merged with vibrant, flowing hair adorned with colorful flowers. In the background, a giant robotic spider-like machine with glowing orange eyes looms over a foggy, neon-lit futuristic city street at night.

1603.title: Golden Lily in Cosmic Bands
1603.description: A vibrant surreal painting featuring a large glowing golden lily at center with swirling energy patterns. Diagonal bands contain stylized orange slices, green leaves, and colorful silhouetted female profiles with intricate hair designs against a starry purple and blue background.

1604.title: Triune Dripping Beast
1604.description: A surreal purple dinosaur-like creature with golden spikes stands on a bright green hill, its body melting and dripping vibrant green slime. Three overlapping women's faces in purple, orange, and pink emerge from the creature's back, set against a deep purple background with swirling orange lines and glowing yellow orbs.

1605.title: Stained Glass Citrus Portrait
1605.description: A vibrant circular stained glass style artwork featuring a stylized woman's profile with elaborate swirling blue and orange hair. She holds a textured orange against a background of segmented citrus slices and green leaves set within a purple border.

1606.title: Cybernetic Floral Muse
1606.description: A surreal portrait of two women merged together, one with flowing blonde hair and floral crown, the other a teal-skinned cyborg smoking a cigarette. A large mechanical spider robot with glowing orange eyes looms behind them against a neon cyberpunk cityscape.

1607.title: Stasis Dreamscape
1607.description: A woman in a green hijab sits upright in bed with white sheets, gazing at a surreal landscape visible through a large arched opening. The scene blends a vibrant sunset over rolling green hills and water with a giant mechanical spider robot emitting green smoke above a cyberpunk street lined with signs reading 'STASIS' and 'PROTECT'.

1608.title: Witch's Crimson Waterfall
1608.description: A silhouetted witch with a crescent moon staff stands on a dark cliff overlooking a glowing green waterfall that cascades into a pool filled with swimmers on lily pads. A massive red celestial body with inner silhouettes dominates the twilight sky above the surreal landscape.

1609.title: Otter and Millipede
1609.description: A vibrant surreal painting shows a human hand holding a detailed otter and a large black millipede against a deep blue background. A stylized yellow female profile with closed eyes emerges from swirling orange and blue psychedelic patterns, surrounded by floating yellow planets and small white creatures.

1610.title: Surreal Cybernetic Dreamscape
1610.description: A vibrant surreal scene depicts large stylized humanoid figures with spiral patterns and multiple faces in the foreground, while a massive mechanical robot with glowing orange eyes and a transparent torso looms in the misty background. The city street is lined with glowing signs reading 'SMIRL' and 'GOOD' amid swirling psychedelic patterns and floating orbs.

1611.title: Sea Turtle Waterfall
1611.description: A large stylized sea turtle swims through teal water toward a cascading waterfall. The turtle's shell and flippers are intricately decorated with multiple female faces, swirling patterns, and floral motifs in vibrant greens and yellows.

1612.title: Knight Before Psychedelic Muse
1612.description: A lone armored knight stands on a tiled balcony holding a trident, facing a massive colorful mural of a stylized woman's face with swirling psychedelic patterns. A giant blood-red moon dominates the starry night sky behind the vibrant, flowing artwork.

1613.title: Melting Blue Android
1613.description: A surreal cyberpunk street scene features a large melting blue humanoid figure with yellow eyes and multiple smaller eyes across its body, standing in the foreground. In the background, a towering mechanical robot with glowing orange eyes strides through a foggy city street populated by Victorian-dressed silhouettes, all watched over by giant green eyes in the purple sky.

1614.title: Steampunk Mind Weaver
1614.description: A towering mechanical steampunk robot with glowing orange eyes strides through a foggy nighttime city street. A large blue wave-like form containing a pink brain and multiple stylized female heads with hypnotic spiral patterns flows from the left toward the robot.

1615.title: Psychedelic Melting Clock Pumpkin
1615.description: A surreal night scene features a large, multicolored pumpkin with melting clock faces and swirling patterns, dripping vibrant liquid into a reflective pool. In the background, a green mountain with a cascading rainbow waterfall sits under a starry purple sky with spiral motifs.

1616.title: Cosmic Eye Vision
1616.description: A vibrant surreal painting framed within a large stylized purple eye. Inside the eye's iris, a purple-skinned woman in patterned dress and headwrap stands in the foreground holding a glowing orb, while a silhouetted family of three walks toward a large full moon over a reflective body of water against a colorful sunset sky.

1617.title: Cosmic Eye Vision
1617.description: A vibrant surreal painting framed within a large stylized purple eye shape, showing a green-skinned woman in profile wearing a patterned golden headwrap and holding a small glowing orb. The background depicts a dreamy night landscape with a large yellow moon, pink sunset over green hills, a reflective body of water with circular patterns, stars, and constellations.

1618.title: Witch by the Crimson Moon
1618.description: A silhouetted witch in a pointed hat stands on a rocky outcrop holding a glowing staff, overlooking a vibrant waterfall that cascades into a swirling colorful pool. A massive glowing red moon dominates the psychedelic night sky filled with colorful diagonal stripes and floating symbols.

1619.title: Witch and Solar Eclipse
1619.description: A silhouetted witch in a pointed hat and polka-dot cloak sits thoughtfully on a hill, gazing at a large stylized red sun or solar eclipse with fiery orange corona. The surreal night landscape features glowing plants, swirling patterns, and small green figures in the distance under a starry sky.

1620.title: Golden Waterfall Dream
1620.description: A vibrant surreal scene featuring two blonde women with green-tinged skin against a vivid red background filled with concentric circles and radiating golden coins. One woman stands prominently in the foreground with flowing hair while another appears in the midground beside a cascading waterfall of glowing coins pouring into a turquoise pool below.

1621.title: Witch and Red Moon
1621.description: A silhouetted witch with flowing teal hair stands on a hill holding a wand, releasing glowing bubbles into the night sky. A large, textured red moon dominates the dark blue background filled with floating pink, green, and purple bubbles and floral patterns.

1622.title: Skull and Magnolias
1622.description: A surreal landscape features a large translucent human skull floating in a dramatic sky, entwined with a giant blooming magnolia flower that drips white liquid. Below, a muddy ground displays a handprint reading 'gone already', scattered magnolia petals, an alarm clock nestled in a flower, coins, and small insects against a colorful sunset horizon.

1623.title: Crimson Moon Offering
1623.description: A silhouetted woman with a long flowing dress stands on a cratered lunar surface, extending her hand toward a pink dripping altar. An octopus-like creature emerges from the ground beside the altar beneath a giant red moon in a starry cosmos.

1624.title: Stasis
1624.description: A surreal scene depicts an open book on a wooden stand at the edge of a marshy pond, emitting blue smoke and butterflies. A tattooed hand reaches toward the book while a boat in the water holds a glowing red tree-like structure labeled 'STASIS' with floating thought bubbles containing miniature scenes.

1625.title: Dreams Taking Flight
1625.description: A young person with a halo sits in a purple velvet chair, eyes closed and head tilted upward as colorful butterflies, birds, paper boats, clocks, and floating words emerge from their mouth and fly toward an arched stone window. The room features a wooden floor, a table with an overflowing teacup and an open illustrated book, while the walls blend into a vibrant field of red poppies under a dreamy sky.

1626.title: Surreal Mind Storm
1626.description: A woman in a blue dress sits upright in a wooden chair with a distressed expression as a chaotic stream of books, clocks, birds, and symbols erupts from her head into a glowing bubble. The surrounding room features bookshelves, scattered papers, an artist's palette, and a stormy sky with lightning above.

1628.title: Floating Idea Fusion
1628.description: A surreal painting depicts a bald woman's head with large white butterfly wings emerging from a colorful artist's palette. The palette holds a pocket watch, paintbrush, paper boat, and key against a dreamy twilight sky with floating papers and abstract forms.

1627.title: Surreal Dreamscape Release
1627.description: A woman in a flowing yellow dress stands barefoot in a fantastical landscape, releasing a paper boat that transforms into a vibrant hummingbird surrounded by swirling ribbons and sparkles. An ornate stone table in the foreground holds an open book with handwritten text, a teacup filled with a starry night sky, a pink peony, and scattered butterflies, while a floral gate spills autumn leaves into a colorful field beneath a twilight sky.

1629.title: Fleeting Idea Fusion
1629.description: A surreal painting depicts a woman seated at a table, her head open to reveal swirling thoughts, clouds, flames, an open book, and a butterfly. The decaying room wall breaks open to a twilight landscape with a glowing brain in the sky and a silhouetted meditating figure in a doorway.

1630.title: Braided Luminescence
1630.description: A portrait of a young East Asian woman with elaborate lime-green braided hair and matching glowing skin tones, wearing a traditional high-collared garment. She is set against a vibrant geometric background of repeating red, pink, and green chevron patterns with atmospheric watercolor textures.

1631.title: Lotus Saint in Waters
1631.description: A green-skinned woman with a white headscarf and halo stands waist-deep in turquoise water surrounded by blooming lotus flowers and lily pads. Behind her is a stylized zigzag pattern in pastel hues with red bleeding effects at the waterline.

1632.title: Dreaming Hummingbird Thoughts
1632.description: A surreal painting depicts a young woman with closed eyes, her head open at the top like a vessel containing a pool of water and a floating paper boat. A vibrant hummingbird hovers above her head while another flies near a large thought bubble containing a clock, a key, and handwritten text reading 'what if what if already knew the answers'.

1634.title: Amber Dreamscape with Runes
1634.description: A large glowing amber stone covered in intricate spiral carvings floats centrally in an abstract swirling vortex of earthy tones. Ornate stylized symbols resembling ancient runes drip with blue and purple hues from the upper left, surrounded by floating circular patterns and coin-like medallions.

1633.title: Dreaming in the Greenhouse
1633.description: A young woman in a blue Victorian dress sits at a wooden table inside a dilapidated greenhouse, writing in a notebook while smoking a pipe. A large blue thought bubble above her head contains a detailed airship, flying books, and mechanical objects against a starry twilight sky.

1635.title: Psychedelic Spiral Dreamscape
1635.description: A vibrant surreal painting featuring a smiling purple orb with blue wings floating beside a large swirling spiral of pink, blue, and green. Colorful looping ribbons and a glowing teardrop shape adorn the dark purple background dotted with white specks.

1636.title: Cosmic Swirl Emergence
1636.description: A vibrant abstract painting featuring a luminous, multi-layered spherical form at the center of a swirling vortex. Radiating organic, tentacle-like streams filled with colorful circles, dots, and flowing patterns extend outward in a dynamic, psychedelic composition.

1638.title: Bubble Fish Dreamscape
1638.description: A surreal night scene featuring translucent bubbles containing white fish floating above a misty, rocky terrain with aquatic plants. A large glowing orange moon illuminates the dark blue sky filled with clouds and additional swimming fish.

1637.title: Cosmic Teardrop
1637.description: A large, translucent teardrop shape floats centrally against a dark, smoky background. Inside the droplet is a vibrant cosmic scene featuring swirling green and purple nebulae, planets, and rings, surrounded by smaller floating bubbles and ethereal light streaks.

1639.title: Holly Adorned Statue
1639.description: A classical female bust with closed eyes and pale green skin is adorned with holly leaves, red berries, and a large shiny red Christmas ornament at the neck. The background is a blurred abstract field of red and pink tones with floating circular elements.

1640.title: Digital Solitude
1640.description: A solitary woman with blue skin and short curly hair sits curled on the ground, looking down at a small glowing rectangular device in her hands. She is surrounded by numerous floating and scattered orange digital cards and fragments displaying binary code, letters, and numbers against a hazy purple and orange twilight background.

1641.title: Muted Murmurs Reflection
1641.description: A woman with dark hair in a bun stands in profile facing a large mirror leaning against an orange brick wall. Her hands are pressed against the mirror surface, which reflects her face and hands marked with orange handprints.

1642.title: Z Time Nest
1642.description: A surreal portrait of a woman in profile with closed eyes, her head adorned with a large nest of twigs, leaves, and colorful paper strips. From the nest emerges a glowing circular clock face with Roman numerals and a bright blue and yellow aura against a gray background filled with mathematical equations and geometric shapes.

1643.title: N Zone Stasis
1643.description: A blue-grey humanoid figure lies supine with arms outstretched, a large white dripping letter N painted on its chest. The body is fragmented by sharp orange geometric shards and overlaid with repeating black text reading "Z@36%,22%" and "Z@36%,22% TOTAL ZONE" against a vibrant orange background.

1644.title: Dreamcatcher Ritual
1644.description: A pale humanoid figure with outstretched arms holds aloft a massive ornate dreamcatcher against a surreal pink and purple cloudy sky. The dreamcatcher features intricate webbing, hanging feathers, beads, and red text reading 'H6582 101-2' at the top.

1646.title: Green Splatter Hand
1646.description: A realistic hand with dark green nail polish and a metallic bracelet presses down onto aged, crumpled papers covered in handwritten text and mathematical notations. Bright green and yellow paint splatters dramatically across the documents from an overhead perspective.

1645.title: Rooted in Brick
1645.description: A dark-skinned figure with white root-like veins covering their body and face stands against a wall of orange and red bricks. The person has a large letter E marked on their cheek and chest, with one arm raised to touch the bricks above.

1647.title: Surreal Cosmic Collage
1647.description: An abstract surreal painting featuring a central torn paper collage element with stylized black letter-like forms. The dark blue and black background contains flowing organic shapes, spherical forms with eye-like details, and scattered golden circular accents suggesting celestial or underwater movement.

1648.title: Cosmic Vortex Artifact
1648.description: A large, twisted, golden-brown crystalline or metallic structure floats at the center of a vibrant, swirling cosmic vortex. The background features a deep purple starry sky with shooting stars and colorful concentric rings of pink, purple, teal, and green containing scattered gems, fragments, and celestial debris.

1649.title: Psychedelic Archway Bloom
1649.description: A vibrant surreal painting depicts a massive, multi-layered flower with swirling petals and glowing neon outlines emerging from a weathered stone archway. The arch is covered in turquoise patina and bears the inscription '1/26' on its keystone against a dramatic, stormy sky of deep purples, teals, and oranges.

1650.title: Golden Cosmic Face
1650.description: A surreal painting of a giant golden human face floating in space with one eye open and filled with stars. Golden rings orbit the head while viscous golden liquid drips from the mouth, nose, and detached floating ears against a dark cosmic background.

1652.title: Bananas NFT Artwork
1652.description: A surreal digital painting featuring a glossy purple spherical character with a wide yellow grin and purple bat-like wings floating above a large pile of ripe yellow bananas covered in purple splatters. The bananas display the word 'Bananas' in dripping white stylized text, set against a cosmic background with a glowing green and purple aurora borealis framed in a decorative border.

1651.title: Banana Octopus Dream
1651.description: A surreal painting featuring a purple spherical creature with a yellow smiley face and large iridescent wings floating above a large yellow octopus made of bananas. A swirling brain-like object hovers above with the text "1/26" against a dark cosmic background with aurora lights.

1653.title: Winged Pizza Planet
1653.description: A spherical purple creature with a smiling face, covered in pepperoni and melted cheese, floats above a littered brown surface. Large feathered wings extend from its sides against a surreal cosmic background of dripping green, purple and red aurora-like formations.

1654.title: Ranch Flower Vortex
1654.description: A large creamy white flower with green speckles floats above a glowing pink and orange swirling vortex. A dark bottle labeled RANCH emerges from the center of the whirlpool while golden liquid drips from the fiery sky above.

1655.title: Cosmic Floral Rift
1655.description: A surreal painting depicts a diagonal band of deep space containing a glowing spiral galaxy and stars cutting across the composition. Large white and cream flowers with green speckles and leaves float against a vibrant aurora borealis background of swirling orange, purple, and pink cosmic clouds.

1656.title: Cosmic Dandruff
1656.description: A vibrant watercolor painting depicts a large teal teardrop-shaped planet with dripping edges, featuring a central purple winged creature and smaller orbiting purple beings. Rainbow-colored nebulae and flowing cosmic streams swirl around it, containing three glowing green planets with smiling faces against a starry, multicolored sky.

1657.title: Cosmic Teardrop Nebula
1657.description: A large glossy teal teardrop-shaped object with wings floats in a vibrant psychedelic space scene. It is surrounded by colorful orbiting smiley-face planets, swirling rainbow rings, and a background of starry purple sky with puffy multicolored clouds.

1658.title: Cosmic Sperm Whale Voyage
1658.description: A vibrant psychedelic painting depicts a large smiling purple sperm whale with pink wings swimming through a swirling spiral vortex of rainbow colors. Smaller smiling whales and various eye-like planets float in the surrounding space against a dark starry background with colorful scalloped patterns in the upper left.

1659.title: Cosmic Whale Vortex
1659.description: A large teal whale-like creature with a smiling face floats in space, its body forming a swirling colorful vortex that leads to a purple planet with a happy face at the center. Smaller smiling planets, stars, and playful tentacled creatures surround the scene against a vibrant cosmic background.

1660.title: Psychedelic Space Creature
1660.description: A vibrant turquoise blob-like alien with a smiling face, rosy cheeks, and purple butterfly wings floats in a cosmic void. It is encircled by a swirling, multi-colored rainbow trail containing four stylized floating eyeballs of varying sizes and designs.

1661.title: Cosmic Teardrop Entity
1661.description: A vibrant surreal painting depicts a smiling teal teardrop-shaped creature with orange cheeks and large black eyes floating in a psychedelic cosmic space. It is encircled by a glowing multicolored ribbon trail with orbiting planets, while a purple winged orb and a green one-eyed creature hover nearby against a swirling purple, pink, and turquoise cloudy background.

1662.title: Cosmic Comet Family
1662.description: A vibrant surreal painting depicts a large smiling teal comet with a trailing tail of smaller smiling purple comets, encircled by a swirling rainbow aura. A smiling green and yellow spiral planet floats above against a wavy striped cosmic background with smaller celestial faces and stars.

1663.title: Cosmic Teardrop Creature
1663.description: A vibrant surreal painting depicts a large smiling teal and purple teardrop-shaped creature with butterfly wings, floating above a swirling colorful vortex. The vortex contains multiple smaller melting smiley faces, set against a starry space background with aurora borealis and pink clouds.

1664.title: Psychedelic Space Slime
1664.description: A vibrant surreal painting featuring a large translucent teal orb containing a smiling purple winged creature with rings, set against a swirling cosmic background. Smaller planets, eyeballs, smiley faces, and colorful nebulae in pink, yellow, and green float throughout the fantastical scene.

1665.title: Winged Teardrop in Nebula
1665.description: A large turquoise teardrop-shaped creature with a smiling face, rosy cheeks, and pink-and-white wings floats at the center of a vibrant cosmic scene. It is surrounded by smaller purple spherical creatures, some also winged, set against swirling rainbow nebulae and a starry purple space background.

1667.title: Psychedelic Layered Tapestry
1667.description: A vibrant, colorful painting featuring overlapping rectangular artworks with bold patterns. The top layer shows a red and white tie-dye spiral with flowing green wavy lines, while the middle layer displays a folk-art scene of stylized animals including foxes, deer, and birds in bright hues, all set against a dynamic background of swirling rainbow patterns and a central potted plant with blue splashes.

1666.title: Psychedelic Pot of Life
1666.description: A vibrant surreal painting features a glossy blue pot at center overflowing with thick, multicolored liquid streams in green, magenta, purple, and lime that swirl and drip across the composition. The dark background is filled with a grid of circular frames each containing stylized animals like cats, dogs, birds, and lizards in bright contrasting hues.

1668.title: Psychedelic Christ Gardener
1668.description: A long-haired Jesus figure with a crown of thorns sits beside a large blue cauldron overflowing with vibrant potted plants and flowers. He gestures with one hand as glowing concentric circles and blue energy rise from the plants against a swirling cosmic background.

1669.title: Psychedelic Pot Overflow
1669.description: A vibrant surreal painting depicts a glossy blue cauldron at the bottom center, overflowing with colorful, wavy green vines and stems that twist outward. The background features a radiating tie-dye pattern in hot pink, turquoise, and orange, with floating concentric circles and additional flowing, serpentine forms in bright rainbow hues.

1670.title: Psychedelic Potted Plants
1670.description: A vibrant surreal painting featuring three potted plants with colorful, wavy leaves sitting atop a blue dripping vessel. The background consists of layered rainbow hills, green squiggly vines, floating bubbles, and concentric rainbow circles against a textured pink and magenta backdrop.

1671.title: Psychedelic Melting Popsicle Cauldron
1671.description: A vibrant surreal painting depicts a central blue cauldron overflowing with colorful liquid and bubbles while dripping rainbow paint. It is surrounded by potted plants with melting, dripping popsicles on sticks, all set against a swirling psychedelic background of bright rainbow hues and looping green tendrils.

1672.title: Psychedelic Potted Plants
1672.description: A vibrant surreal painting depicts a large blue cauldron-like pot overflowing with bubbly blue foam and four smaller pink pots containing stylized green and yellow plants. The composition is surrounded by thick, swirling green tubes intertwined with multicolored rings and floating transparent bubbles against a textured pink and teal background.

1692.title: Sundial Sentinel
1692.description: A weathered, statue-like male figure emerges from wet sand at the beach, partially covered in vines and branches with a red flower on his chest. He holds a large, ornate sundial with Roman numerals as the setting sun casts long shadows across the dramatic sky.

1746.title: Crowned Man and Unicorn
1746.description: A bald man with an elaborate mustache and ornate crown looks upward, positioned in the foreground. Behind him stands a majestic white unicorn with a braided mane and horn, next to a ruined stone tower, all rendered in a detailed monochromatic illustration.

1726.title: Tavern Circa 2026
1726.description: A surreal collage scene featuring a cozy living room with a large ornate golden frame containing a cosmic eye with fire, a cute anthropomorphic squirrel sitting in a blue armchair, and a glowing green smiley-face spider-like creature. The background blends a swirling purple cosmic sky with a cracked street leading to a twilight city, overlaid with text reading 'Change Time to Think' and 'Angels and Demons'.

1747.title: Volcanic Multi-Faced Portrait
1747.description: A surreal portrait shows a bald man with a prominent curled mustache and glowing red eyes, his head splitting into multiple overlapping faces. Dark columnar rock formations resembling basalt columns erupt with flowing orange lava, set against a swirling cosmic vortex in the sky.

1748.title: Taco Reel Column
1748.description: Four upright tacos filled with meat, purple cabbage, and herbs stand vertically in a metal taco holder on a turquoise table, with sauce dripping down. The vibrant scene includes lime wedges, a hot sauce bottle, crumpled wrappers, hanging red lanterns, string lights, and a blue patterned wall with a 'TACOS REEL COLUMN 4 $4' sign.

1749.title: Golden Elixir of Life
1749.description: A golden skeleton leans over a cluster of bubbles, pouring a thick stream of glowing golden liquid from its mouth and hand into the open mouth of a large-eyed white caterpillar-like creature.

1750.title: Eye of the Dreamer
1750.description: A colossal human eye fills the frame, its iris a swirling cosmic portal revealing a cloaked figure standing beneath a glowing moon and starry night sky. In the foreground, a man in a long blue coat stands on the lower eyelid, gazing into the surreal scene as a single tear drips from the eye.

1751.title: Demon Taco Beast
1751.description: A fierce Japanese oni demon with blue skin, golden eyes, and ornate facial patterns emerges from an oversized taco shell. The taco is filled with ingredients, dripping sauce, and features a red tag with the kanji for anger, set against a swirling dark red and blue background with floating taco fragments.

1752.title: Tacos El Fusion
1752.description: A vibrant surreal painting depicts three oversized elaborate tacos in the foreground on yellow paper, surrounded by lime wedges, a glass soda bottle, and a receipt for 'STASIS'. In the background stands a colorful taco food truck named 'TACOS EL FUSION' with a striped awning against a graffiti-covered pink wall under a dramatic purple sky. Steam rises from the food toward a small floating platform holding a potted plant and an ornate scale-like object.

1753.title: Angel and Demon Embrace
1753.description: A winged angel with a glowing halo and a horned demon with red bat wings stand locked in a close embrace atop a crumbling ornate pillar. The dramatic scene includes an open illuminated book with a small figure inside, scattered treasures, lit candles, lilies, and a dark stormy sky with fiery clouds.

1754.title: Fallen Angel Bound
1754.description: A surreal symbolic scene featuring a hybrid angelic-demonic figure with one large white feathered wing and one black bat-like wing, wrapped in barbed wire around a stone pillar. The dramatic setting shows an ornate church or cathedral interior with red and gold drapery, candles, and scattered religious objects on a tiled floor.

1755.title: Allegory of Time
1755.description: A dramatic Baroque painting featuring a winged angelic figure atop a stone pillar inscribed with 'TEMPUS FUGIT', restraining a dark skeletal figure of Father Time with an hourglass. In the foreground, two cherubs examine a large book amid scattered symbols of vanity and transience including a skull, jewels, and an overturned goblet, set against opulent golden curtains and a stormy, cloudy sky.

1756.title: Yello Bingo Slime Creatures
1756.description: Surreal painting featuring four magenta slime-like creatures with large yellow eyes and dripping forms, each topped with clusters of blue bingo balls. Vibrant paint splatters and swirls fill the background with the text 'YELLO BINGO' prominently displayed in a circular motif.

1757.title: Lottery Column in Ruins
1757.description: A surreal painted scene of a derelict shelter room dominated by a tall glowing golden lottery number column. The decaying space features a checkered floor littered with fallen lottery tickets, empty bottles, and a metal chair holding a yellow ticket and beer bottle, with faded posters and handprints on the walls.

1758.title: Yellow Bingo Slot Machine
1758.description: A surreal painting depicts a large yellow slot machine with three reels showing sevens, bells, and a 'BINGO' ticket. A woman's hand with a gold bracelet reaches toward a purple-clothed bingo card on the table below, next to an ashtray with a lit cigarette and scattered gold coins.

1759.title: Stasis Protocol Active
1759.description: A man in a red and black jumpsuit with 'SEVIN' on his chest stands in an abandoned industrial room, holding a large mechanical reel. He touches a detailed mural on the wall that depicts himself, the text 'STASIS PROTOCOL ACTIVE - 143', hazard symbols, and graffiti.

1760.title: Lotus Berry Elixir
1760.description: A vibrant red lotus flower emerges from a cracked green bowl overflowing with blueberries, as a swirling pink and magenta liquid pours from above, creating bubbles and dripping over the edges onto a ornate pink and gold platform.

1761.title: Vault 1298 Projection
1761.description: A man in an orange vault suit and leather jacket sits in a derelict, sand-filled bunker room holding a film reel. Behind him a large projection on the cracked wall shows a desert landscape with a massive nuclear mushroom cloud labeled 370 in red.

1762.title: The Gilded Cage
1762.description: A melancholic blonde woman in an ornate Renaissance-style gown sits by a stone window at sunset, her hands clasped near her heart. On the windowsill rests an open golden birdcage with a small green bird inside, a pocket watch, and lavender flowers, while her reflection appears in the glass.

1763.title: Fallout Film Reel
1763.description: A man with blond hair emerges from a rusted, towering film reel structure in a desolate wasteland, holding a film canister labeled 'FALLOUT'. Film strips with various scenes unwind from the massive reel as it stands in a barren landscape with transmission towers and a 'FALLOUT' sign visible in the distance under a dramatic sky.

1764.title: Vault Door in Decay
1764.description: A surreal scene depicts a massive cracked concrete pillar entwined with grotesque mutated tentacles and yellow eyes, leaning against a rusted red vault door marked 1220. An open book, caution tape, and scattered debris lie on the checkered floor of a long abandoned hallway lined with framed pictures under a glowing green aurora-like ceiling.

1765.title: Decaying Film Reel Monument
1765.description: A massive, rusted film reel sits atop a concrete pedestal in a desolate wasteland, with film strips unspooling across the ground covered in yellow graffiti. The surreal scene includes scattered film canisters, old newspapers, gloves, and a distant utility pole under a dramatic sky with green aurora-like lights.

1766.title: Reel Prayer in the Wasteland
1766.description: A hooded figure in blood-stained white robes kneels in prayer beside a towering rusted film reel structure in a desolate desert landscape. The massive column is covered in film strips, vines, and text including the phone number 817-823-212, with ruined buildings and mesas visible under a dramatic, colorful apocalyptic sky.

1767.title: Cracked Mirror Reflection
1767.description: A young woman with elaborate golden braided hair and a dark blue velvet dress stands before a large cracked oval mirror, her reflection visible. She touches her lace collar while gazing at her image, with a lit candle, two small portraits, and a key resting on the marble vanity below.

1768.title: Film Reel Waterfall
1768.description: A surreal scene featuring three large film reels in a vine-covered room. A glowing orange film strip flows from a weathered green reel into a red one, while a blue reel pours a cascading waterfall into a basin filled with papers and purple flowers.

1769.title: Film Reel Column
1769.description: A classical fluted column stands in a derelict hall, wrapped in a spiraling film strip containing fragmented cinematic images including an eye, flowers, a newspaper, and a red heart. Scattered 35mm film reels and torn film strips lie on the cracked marble floor amid dark liquid pools and small green sprouts.

1788.title: Surreal Visionary Bust
1788.description: A classical stone bust with a cracked head and ivy is centered in a vibrant surreal composition. A large fiery green eye drips red above it, while a purple eye with a spider and red squirrels appears to the right, a green snake coils around the neck, and a feathered-hatted silhouette sits amid blue foliage on the left.

1789.title: Man by the Bunker Door
1789.description: A man in green military uniform sits on a folding chair writing in a notebook beside an open, illuminated bunker door set into a graffiti-covered concrete wall. The desolate scene features a dramatic sunset sky, distant mountains, a towering electricity pylon, and scattered debris on cracked pavement.

1790.title: Cabbage Dragon in Alley
1790.description: A small green dragon with large expressive eyes and a toothy grin peeks out from inside an oversized leafy green cabbage. The creature rests on a sunlit cobblestone alleyway between warm yellow buildings adorned with pink flowers.

1791.title: Stasis Protocol Bunker
1791.description: A lone man in an orange hazmat-style suit sits pensively at a cluttered desk inside a decaying bunker. He gazes at an old CRT monitor displaying a woman's face while a radioactive wasteland is visible through the broken wall behind him.

1792.title: Porch Gathering at Dusk
1792.description: A whimsical scene on the porch of a rustic wooden cabin at sunset, featuring a robot with a skull head and glowing goggles standing behind a donkey in overalls leaning on the railing with a glass of red liquid. A young man with orange hair and glasses holds a mug while speaking to a white dove in mid-flight.

1793.title: Porch of Eccentric Wonders
1793.description: A diverse group stands on the wooden porch of a rustic house decorated with string lights: a classical marble bust wearing a feathered hat, a steampunk robot, a donkey in blue overalls, a white dove in flight, and a young red-haired man in a colorful t-shirt. The vibrant twilight sky features a solar eclipse, a squirrel logo, a large green eye, and swirling psychedelic patterns.

1795.title: Porch Gathering at Dusk
1795.description: A vibrant surreal scene on a wooden porch at twilight shows a young man in a colorful shirt gesturing toward a white dove in flight, while a donkey in overalls and hat leans on the railing beside a glowing steampunk robot. In the foreground, a large decorated pot bubbles with colorful orbs as a fantastical swirling galaxy lights up the sky above a neon-lit town with an Apollo Arcade sign.

1794.title: Porch of the Surreal
1794.description: A vibrant surreal scene on a wooden porch at twilight, featuring a red-haired young man in a smiley face t-shirt standing beside a donkey in overalls and a steampunk robot with glowing pink eyes. A white dove flies between them while two glowing skeletons and three ethereal green women appear in the background under a large smiling moon and string lights.

1796.title: Robot and Child on Porch
1796.description: A young boy with an orange bandana and a donkey in overalls stand on a wooden porch, gazing at a large metallic robot covered in green leafy vegetation. A white dove flies between them as string lights illuminate the warm, whimsical scene.

1797.title: Porch Gathering at Dusk
1797.description: A young red-haired man with glasses stands surprised on a wooden porch beside a donkey in overalls and a robot with glowing green eyes. A white dove flies above them as string lights illuminate the rustic scene at sunset.

1798.title: Robot, Donkey and Boy on Porch
1798.description: A detailed scene on the porch of a rustic wooden cabin at sunset. A metallic robot with glowing eyes releases a white dove while a donkey in overalls and a young red-haired man holding a glass stand nearby, all surrounded by string lights and warm bokeh particles.

1799.title: Porch Gathering at Dusk
1799.description: A red-haired boy stands on a wooden porch between a donkey in overalls and a steampunk robot, as a white dove flies nearby. The rustic cabin scene is decorated with string lights during a warm sunset.

1800.title: Boy, Donkey and Robot
1800.description: A young red-haired boy stands on a wooden balcony overlooking a tropical atoll, pointing at a white dove in flight. Beside him, an anthropomorphic donkey in overalls and a steampunk robot with glowing eyes lean on the railing under string lights.

1801.title: Robot, Donkey and Boy
1801.description: A detailed scene on a wooden porch of a red cabin shows a metallic robot with goggles standing behind a donkey wearing a plaid shirt and overalls, while a young man with orange hair and glasses reaches toward a white dove in flight. String lights hang above the porch against a warm, golden background.

1802.title: Stasis on Fractured Plain
1802.description: A pale woman with long dark braided hair sits in an ornate crystalline throne on a vast cracked plain. She wears an elaborate ruffled collar and flowing patterned robes while holding a small hourglass, with scattered pocket watches around her under a dramatic, colorful sky.

1804.title: Surreal Eye in Desert
1804.description: A hyper-detailed close-up of a large human eye with a vibrant pink and purple iris. Poppies and a small red mouse grow from the lower eyelid while a cloaked figure stands on a sand dune in the background under a purple crescent moon.

1803.title: Atoll Lagoon Vista
1803.description: An aerial view of a lush tropical atoll with dense green vegetation, sandy beaches, and a vibrant turquoise lagoon showing swirling currents. The surrounding deep blue ocean contrasts with a dramatic, colorful sky painted in swirling strokes.

1805.title: Desert Moon Walk
1805.description: A silhouetted figure walks a small rat on a leash across a starry desert dune under a large full moon containing the shadow of a leaping dog. To the right, a bright green dog head with a pink rectangular backdrop overlaps the scene, with a brown rat perched on its neck.

1806.title: Stasis Chamber Fusion
1806.description: A pixelated sorceress with pale skin and white hair stands inside a glowing cylindrical stasis chamber, arms outstretched while holding a wired controller. The scene depicts a retro-futuristic laboratory with purple stone walls, checkered floors, scattered video game controllers, and arched windows revealing a surreal green landscape with a cracked moon.

1807.title: Rat and Bear in Desert
1807.description: A vibrant red and white rat perches on a leafy branch adorned with flowing pink, orange, and purple ribbons in the foreground. In the surreal desert landscape, a wooden bear head floats near a large pale moon while a small human figure walks along a distant sand dune.

1808.title: Surreal Eye Waterfall
1808.description: A massive human eye with a pink iris dominates a fantastical landscape, its pupil revealing a cascading waterfall that flows into a pool below. A red rat stands on the upper eyelid beside a large pink moon while a robed figure stands at the water's edge.

1809.title: Mouse Wizard in Oasis
