2372.description: A vibrant surreal painting featuring a woman's face composed of colorful geometric panels filled with multiple eyes. Her long, flowing red-orange hair dominates the composition, containing a brown horse with blue patterns, a man in a blue suit wearing a 'LOVE BOMB' sash holding a candle, and a large shadowy monster with glowing white eyes and sharp teeth.

2373.title: Celestial Embrace
2373.description: A vibrant surreal painting depicts an angelic figure with large white and red wings embracing a red demonic creature and a colorful bear-like being. They stand atop a cracked marble column holding an open book with a tiny silhouetted figure inside, surrounded by lit candles, a bubbling cauldron, flowers, and a fiery swirling sky with a crescent moon portal.

2131.title: Dark Fantasy Citadel
2131.description: A lone cloaked figure in an orange cape stands on a small boat on a reflective body of water, facing a massive dark fantasy city with towering gothic spires and colossal guardian statues carved into the buildings. The dramatic red and orange sky features a large glowing spiral symbol and a smaller setting sun, casting fiery reflections across the scene.

2374.title: Surreal Mosaic Muse
2374.description: A vibrant surreal painting features a woman's face and neck composed of colorful mosaic tiles with orange eyes, her hair styled in swirling colorful patterns. Below her, a small brown horse stands among pink flowers as a cloaked figure rows a boat on reflective water toward a dark castle under a dramatic red sunset sky with teal geometric overlays and dripping paint effects.

2375.title: Alien Mother and Child
2375.description: A green-skinned alien woman with elaborate braided hair and floral adornments stands waist-deep in stylized purple and blue water, gently cradling a small grey alien infant. The background features a vibrant cosmic sky with planets, stars, and a large multicolored zigzag pattern resembling a mountain or aurora.

2376.title: Three Crowned Angels
2376.description: Three winged angels with golden halos and ornate crowns stand closely embraced, each holding white lilies. They wear deep blue robes patterned with orange spheres against a backdrop of a burning gothic cathedral and fiery red-orange sky filled with flying dragons.

2377.title: Cosmic Serpent Apocalypse
2377.description: A surreal visionary scene featuring a giant blue serpent coiled around a swirling rainbow vortex in a cosmic sky, with a three-faced winged angel standing on a platform and a bearded man in blue robes reaching upward in distress. Below are two alien creatures in water near the Colosseum while a gothic cathedral and Italian buildings appear in the background under a starry, fiery sky filled with floating orbs and figures.

2325.title: Soldier on Lakeside Deck
2325.description: A realistic painting depicts a man in full military camouflage uniform and cap standing on a wooden deck overlooking a calm lake. He leans forward with hands clasped, gazing directly at the viewer beside a vibrant bouquet of purple, pink, and white flowers, framed by lush trees and distant water under a bright sky.

2378.title: Surreal Eye Over Landscape
2378.description: A soldier in green uniform sits pensively on a wooden dock overlooking a reflective body of water that swirls into a vortex. The sky is dominated by a massive stylized eye with a nuclear symbol for a pupil, surrounded by colorful concentric rings, while a polluted industrial city billows black smoke in the background.

2379.title: Serpent Eye Projection
2379.description: A man in military uniform leans on a wooden dock railing at sunset, gazing at an overhead projector displaying a surreal image. The projection shows a large central eye encircled by two intertwined green serpents with dripping slime, mathematical diagrams, and the text 'Ictus de 2000' and 'WOT'.

2191.title: Cosmic Cats on Cliff
2191.description: Three colorful cats stand on a rocky mountain peak under a dramatic stormy sky with purple lightning and glowing elemental orbs floating around them. A gray cat points forward, a black cat with green patterns raises its paw, and an orange tabby with colorful markings dances joyfully.

2380.title: Surreal Desert Mirage
2380.description: A surreal desert landscape features Humpty Dumpty in a red checkered suit holding a mirror on a wooden deck, while a soldier in green uniform and purple cape stands on a cliff. Three cats on the cliff edge overlook a body of water with a giant woman's face embedded in the rock face, all under a stormy purple sky with lightning and floating bubbles containing figures.

2123.title: Surreal Meadow Dreamscape
2123.description: A giant stylized woman's face emerges from a rolling green hillside, adorned with a crown of pink and red roses. A mechanical fox with glowing purple circuits runs across the grass under a large geometric celestial body in a vibrant sunset sky.

2381.title: Cosmic Heart Vision
2381.description: A surreal painting depicts a large pink heart containing a three-faced figure with purple curly hair and pink roses, dripping a pink heart shape. Below, a stylized tree with a blue bird and white dove stands beside stone stairs on a green hill, while a purple mechanical fox runs across the landscape under a starry sky with a glowing d20 die and colorful shooting stars.

2382.title: Surreal Camouflage Dreamscape
2382.description: A woman in military camouflage stands on a wooden pier, holding a centipede-like creature with a red flower. Her hair is a mass of swirling blue tentacles with eyes, a bright green dog rests on her shoulder, while a volcanic mountain with a giant watching eye and hanging flower chimes dominate the psychedelic background.

2383.title: Surreal Psychedelic Wanderer
2383.description: A smiling man with vibrant blue curly hair and swirling body tattoos stands on a wooden dock, wearing camouflage while holding a large patterned snake. A melting Dali-style clock drips from the sky above a purple lake, surrounded by wind chimes, flowers, a small green frog, and a green reptilian creature on his shoulder.

2410.title: 1751 Film Set
2410.description: A woman in a grey jumpsuit and white mask operates a vintage film camera on a tripod inside a dilapidated theater. The cracked back wall displays the burning numbers '1751' above a dystopian landscape mural, with skeleton audience members seated in red chairs and film reels scattered on the floor.

2409.title: Aurora Station Phantom
2409.description: A woman in a black Victorian dress stands on a marble train platform holding a vintage camera, with film strips scattered at her feet. Behind her, a glowing steam train emerges from red curtains under a dramatic aurora borealis sky, with an ornate red armchair placed on the tracks.

2408.title: Cinematic Dream Projection
2408.description: A woman in vintage film-themed attire sits in a red theater seat, holding a newspaper and film reel while looking forward. Behind her, a large arched screen displays a surreal, colorful allegorical scene with floating figures, stairs, and clouds under dramatic golden light beams.

2407.title: Overture - Reel 29
2407.description: A woman in a vintage dark green patterned suit stands in an ornate, flooded room holding a film clapperboard. She is illuminated by a dramatic beam of purple light from above, surrounded by a large spiral painting of birds and clocks, a red velvet chair with an open book, and an antique movie camera on a tripod.

2406.title: Alien Boat in Cosmic Sea
2406.description: Surreal painting of two large-headed aliens with green skin and oversized eyes floating in a wooden boat on a swirling, colorful cosmic sea. A third alien figure appears to the right amid glowing orbs, nebulae, and starry space swirls in the background.

2405.title: Overhead Projector Stasis
2405.description: A woman in a shimmering one-shoulder gown stands amid the ruins of a derelict theater, holding a film slide and conductor's baton. Behind her, a large overhead projector casts a radiant burst of light and floating images onto a decaying screen while the dilapidated room is littered with popcorn, film reels, and broken frames.

2404.title: Cosmic Bubble Head
2404.description: A surreal portrait of a large teal spherical head with glowing pink eyes, a stitched smile, and prominent ears, centered against a cosmic background. Translucent bubbles float around the figure while swirling blue and purple patterns emanate from the right side, with light rays and stars filling the dark space.

2403.title: Honey Skull Surreal Scene
2403.description: A surreal painting depicts a large cracked skull floating above a smaller skull with wide cartoon eyes and a toothy grin, both dripping with golden honey from a skeletal arm and spoon. The scene is set against a cosmic starry background with swirling nebulae, palm fronds, and a foreground of bubbling honey filled with ants and bubbles.

2402.title: Cosmic Lotus Orb
2402.description: A surreal cosmic scene featuring a large glowing orb containing swirling nebulae and layered cloud formations, resting within an ornate dark brown lotus-like structure. The background displays a vibrant starry sky with purple, pink, and teal nebulae, accented by translucent geometric overlays and flowing abstract ribbons.

2401.title: Ghostly Projection
2401.description: A woman in a dark military-style coat stands on stone steps holding a film reel while touching the translucent shoulder of a ghostly seated man writing in a large open book. Behind them, a dramatic beam of light projects swirling cinematic images onto a wall adorned with maps and a cityscape at dusk.

2400.title: Cosmic Psychedelic Dog
2400.description: A surreal portrait of a green dog-like creature with one large orange eye and a pink flower for the other, set against a vibrant cosmic nebula background. The figure has flowers growing from its neck and head, with its tongue hanging out, surrounded by stars and swirling patterns in deep space.

2399.title: Overture - Reel 16
2399.description: A woman in a dark coat and glasses stands on stone steps in a ruined cinematic theater. She is surrounded by scattered film reels, movie projectors casting beams of light, old photographs, blueprints, and a human skull on the cracked floor.

2398.title: Cosmic Leafed Entity
2398.description: A surreal portrait of a female figure whose face is split between a beautiful woman with closed eyes and a glowing third eye, and a monstrous green leafy creature with an open mouth revealing a starry void and sharp teeth.

2397.title: Woman with Lion
2397.description: A surreal portrait of a woman with geometric golden patterns on her face and body, her long dark hair flowing amidst vibrant flowers. A majestic male lion appears behind her while a smaller lion stands in the foreground, all set against a lush green jungle background.

2396.title: Cosmic Maine Coon Cat
2396.description: A majestic long-haired grey cat with golden eyes dominates the right side of a vibrant cosmic landscape. Swirling galaxies, colorful nebulae in orange, blue and red, and a small robed figure with a cart appear on a textured earthy foreground.

2395.title: Cybernetic Nature Fusion
2395.description: A surreal portrait merges a golden robotic head with glowing yellow eyes and intricate leaf-like circuitry growing from its form. A winding, ornate path resembling a river of patterns flows through the composition against a dark red and green leafy background.

2394.title: Skeleton with Flowers
2394.description: A translucent human skeleton sits in a curled, contemplative pose at the center of an ethereal composition. It is surrounded by vibrant yellow roses, purple grapes, and swirling ornate patterns against a dreamy, multicolored atmospheric background.

2393.title: Radioactive Prayer
2393.description: A woman with glasses kneels in prayer holding a yellow radiation warning sign that reads 'GOTO-OVERTURE'. She is positioned before a large broken concrete doorway revealing a surreal cosmic landscape with a swirling galaxy and dead tree, while a film strip containing faces unspools from a movie reel across the foreground.

2392.title: Neon Canine Portal
2392.description: A golden retriever's face emerges from layered translucent panels covered in graffiti and geometric symbols. The scene is set within a surreal, glowing tunnel of pink and orange light with floating spirals and cityscape fragments.

2391.title: Overture - Stasis
2391.description: A woman in a blue cape stands on a stage holding a film reel and a small telescope, looking upward. Behind her is a grand, decaying theater with a large screen displaying 'STASIS' and a telescope graphic, surrounded by floating books, film reels, and ornate chandeliers under dramatic beams of light.

2390.title: Dual Faces with Dragonfly
2390.description: A surreal profile portrait shows a red-skinned woman with elaborate dark red floral headdress facing a golden-yellow woman with closed eyes, their lips nearly touching. An ornate mechanical dragonfly with golden filigree rests on the red woman's shoulder against a vibrant swirling background of concentric circles and organic patterns.

2389.title: The Keyholder's Gaze
2389.description: A woman in a velvet coat and black gloves stands in an opulent, flooded gallery at night. She holds an ornate golden key while beams of light shine from her eyes across a moonlit scene filled with floating tickets and classical paintings.

2388.title: Cosmic Serpent Vision
2388.description: A woman with flowing dark hair stands in a fantastical landscape, reaching toward a massive iridescent green serpent that curves across the scene. The sky is dominated by a giant cosmic eye containing a glowing orange portal with three silhouetted figures inside, surrounded by swirling galaxies and vibrant nebulae.

2387.title: Celestial Shadow Portrait
2387.description: A surreal painting featuring a large yellow celestial orb containing a woman's face, superimposed over the dark silhouette of a robed figure with outstretched arms. The dramatic sky is filled with swirling clouds, floating orbs, and feather-like forms against a cosmic backdrop.

2386.title: Theater of Dreams
2386.description: A woman in an ornate blue velvet cloak sits in a red velvet theater box, holding an open book and a decorative mask. Behind her, a grand theatrical stage displays a fantastical painted backdrop featuring a stormy purple sky with bats, a golden harp on a staircase, and a fiery orange scene with dancing figures in white gowns.

2385.title: Phantom Projectionist
2385.description: A masked woman in an elegant gown adorned with vines and lilies stands on a decaying theater stage, operating a vintage film projector that casts a beam of light into the darkness. The scene features red theater seats, old movie posters on the walls, scattered playing cards, and ghostly silhouettes under dramatic cinematic lighting.

2384.title: Oracle of Visions
2384.description: A woman in a blue dress sits in an ornate velvet theater box, holding a glowing crystal ball and a paper while peering through a telescope. A beam of light projects from her mouth into the night sky, revealing a surreal stream of floating objects including a burning ship, birds, a shark, and film reels above a dark body of water.

2192.title: Stormy Sorcerer Sea
2192.description: A lone wizard in a dark cloak stands atop a turbulent teal wave during a violent storm. The scene features massive curling waves, floating translucent bubbles with dripping liquid, red autumn leaves, lightning strikes, and a distant mountain range under a dramatic purple and pink sky.

2778.title: Cosmic Sorcerer Storm
2778.description: A surreal fantasy scene featuring a hooded sorcerer with a staff standing on turbulent waves beside a giant glowing mushroom and a massive dragon coiled within a swirling cosmic portal filled with galaxies and stars. Lightning strikes across a purple sky as glowing orbs float above the stylized ocean and distant mountains.

2780.title: Grok Awakens
2780.description: A cyberpunk-style female character with green skin and yellow eyes stands in the foreground wearing a red and black jacket labeled 'SEVIN'. She reaches toward a glowing yellow circle containing her own portrait while a radioactive wasteland with a red moon, cracked walls, and toxic drips fills the background.

2781.title: Stasis Protocol Active
2781.description: A vibrant surreal cyberpunk scene featuring a blue-skinned woman in ornate robes reaching toward a cosmic green dragon ridden by a figure with blue hair. Above them floats a large glowing orb containing a neon green alien holding a film reel, set against a dystopian cityscape with graffiti-covered walls, toxic symbols, and a colorful cosmic sky with planets and a smiling red sun.

2464.title: Wanderer 2067
2464.description: A lone female wanderer with a red bandana and glowing wrist device stands on a cracked desert road, looking back toward a massive vault door in the distance. The post-apocalyptic landscape features an abandoned drive-in theater, film reels, cacti, and utility poles under a dramatic twilight sky.

2782.title: Serpentine Oracle
2782.description: A green-skinned woman with blonde hair and a large snake tail holds a glowing, spiked orb emitting colorful energy streams. She stands in a surreal apocalyptic landscape featuring a massive orange moon, a vault door in a rock face, a burning screen, and hanging colorful corpses under a dark sky.

2783.title: Alien Pizza Cat
2783.description: A surreal cosmic scene featuring a giant glowing green alien head hovering above a swirling vortex of floating pizza slices, set against an aurora-filled night sky with planets and stars. In the foreground, a white cat with orange stripes walks toward a yellow robot sitting at a small table eating pizza on a purple mountainside.

2784.title: Psychedelic Monkey Oracle
2784.description: A surreal psychedelic scene featuring a giant ornate circular mandala with a turquoise monkey skull at its center, surrounded by glowing lanterns and dollar signs. In the foreground, a robed figure holds a chain of beads while a green lizard, chained otter, and green dog with a golden key sit on a crumbling wall before a volcanic castle beneath a red planet with a cross symbol.

2413.title: Mushroom Witch Portrait
2413.description: A vibrant surreal portrait of a green-skinned female figure with a large glowing mushroom cap covered in skulls for a hat. Her flowing blue and orange hair swirls dramatically amidst green smoke and dark purple flowers.

2786.title: Surreal Geometric Muse
2786.description: A large fragmented female face with geometric patterns dominates the surreal landscape, her multicolored hair flowing into a stormy sky pierced by an orange beam of light. Below her are twin haloed angels in blue robes holding lotuses, a brown horse, lily pads with pink water lilies, and floating golden orbs against a dark, fantastical backdrop.

2787.title: Sphinx and Serpent
2787.description: A vibrant surreal portrait of a woman in profile with a hair bun adorned in flowers, a hairless cat perched on her shoulder, facing a massive fiery blue serpent with glowing orange eyes. Below, a small silhouetted figure stands on the snake's coils amid explosive paint splashes, set against a colorful striped background with floating paw prints.

2673.title: Return to Me
2673.description: A woman in a red dress and heels stands in an empty vintage movie theater aisle, holding a film reel and a white rose while looking back over her shoulder. Behind her, a large movie screen displays a black-and-white film still of a woman in a gown with the text 'RETURN TO ME 281'.

2788.title: Alien Cinema Date
2788.description: A green tentacled alien in a yellow robe holds a white rose while escorting a woman in a flowing red dress through a colorful, swirling cosmic theater. They stand in a puddle of purple liquid surrounded by film reels as a movie screen behind them displays the title 'RETURN TO ME'.

2199.title: Enchanted Garden Cats
2199.description: Three cats sit together in a lush, magical nighttime garden filled with vibrant flowers, glowing orbs, and floating bubbles. A ginger tabby, a grey cat, and a black cat are surrounded by dense foliage and pink blossoms under a purple twilight sky.

2790.title: Threefold Angelic Trinity
2790.description: Three conjoined angelic women with six wings stand centrally holding a white lily, surrounded by three haloed cats in an enchanted garden. The surreal scene features gothic castles, dragons, floating bubbles, and vibrant dripping liquid from the top of the frame under a starry sky.

2232.title: Celestial Wind Chimes
2232.description: A surreal dreamlike painting featuring floating white sheep and a cow drifting among glowing golden wind chimes in a cloudy, ethereal sky. Light rays break through stormy clouds while colorful crystal prisms and sparkles float throughout the soft, misty atmosphere.

2624.title: Psychedelic Spiral Canopy
2624.description: Vibrant abstract painting filled with overlapping concentric circles, spirals, and organic dot patterns in saturated rainbow hues. Dark tree branches stretch across the top of the composition against a deep teal background.

2791.title: Fairy of the Mystic Tree
2791.description: A winged fairy queen in a flowing pink gown sits on a large gnarled tree branch above a moonlit lake, releasing glowing orbs into the night. Below her, a colorful male duck swims with seven yellow ducklings while sheep stand in the distant water under a dramatic, swirling purple and green sky.

2213.title: Otter in Retro Lounge
2213.description: A detailed otter with purple eyes sits on a wooden credenza in a mid-century modern living room. Behind it, a large window reveals a vibrant jungle scene while a glowing purple magical portal with vines adorns the opposite wall.

2793.title: Surreal Ghostly Seascape
2793.description: A vibrant surreal scene depicts a glowing blue ghost with orange dripping liquid emerging from a whirlpool in stylized blue water. A green horse with a fiery multicolored mane runs across the waves beside a large green sailing ship with horse-headed sails, while circular bubbles in the pink-orange sky contain various figures and a window scene with a cat.

2620.title: Oracle of the Cosmos
2620.description: A pale oracle wearing a circuit-board headdress and dark ornate robes sits on a gothic throne inside an observatory. She holds a film reel while a beam of light from an overhead projector illuminates the scene, surrounded by framed pictures and a view of planets and stars through the dome window.

2158.title: Puzzle Dragon Bridge
2158.description: A surreal painting of a blonde woman with closed eyes standing before a crumbling stone bridge made of oversized puzzle pieces. A large dragon flies above while another dragon head emerges from the bridge breathing fire, with scattered puzzle pieces falling into the water below.

2794.title: Hive & Hum
2794.description: A mystical blue-skinned goddess with a pink lotus headdress sits on a stone throne connected to a massive ship fused with a glowing glass greenhouse. A fiery dragon emerges from the water while another flies overhead against a dramatic twilight sky filled with floating lanterns and distant castle towers.

2751.title: Cosmic Eye of Creation
2751.description: A massive surreal eye with a cracked golden-brown sclera and fiery iris dominates the left side, emitting glowing orbs and swirling cosmic tentacles filled with stars and patterns that flow rightward into a vibrant nebula.

2178.title: Corn God Spell Inventory
2178.description: A surreal painting centered on a large yellow corn cob with a purple cyclopean eye, wearing a broken heart emblem and green husk robes. It is flanked by a fern-crowned snake and a purple alien mask, all set within a circular chart containing alphabet letters, spell labels, and botanical illustrations.

2795.title: Surreal Corn Eye Kitchen
2795.description: A surreal night scene set in a retro kitchen where a large anthropomorphic corn cob with a single purple eye and red lips stands on the counter beside a snake and ornate mask. In the stormy sky above, a giant cracked eye with text floats over desert dunes while two silhouetted women with a red umbrella stand nearby under a full moon.

2796.title: Overhead Projector Stasis
2796.description: Two women in 1950s attire stand in a dimly lit kitchen, intently studying an old CRT television displaying green text. A large overhead projector hangs from the ceiling projecting cryptic messages onto the scene.

2758.title: Surreal Blue Moon Scene
2758.description: A vibrant surreal desert landscape features a giant smiling blue moon with yellow eyes dominating the center. Various steampunk robots, mechanical structures, potted plants, and a small character holding a mug populate the cracked ground under a warm sunset sky.

2797.title: Surreal Dreamscape
2797.description: A surreal fantasy scene featuring a blue-skinned witch with long dark hair casting lightning from her hands. In the background, a smiling crescent moon with a face looms over a floating castle, while a purple infinity serpent carries a red-robed figure through a cracked wasteland populated by small steampunk robots and jellyfish-like creatures.

2798.title: Serpent of No
2798.description: A surreal desert scene featuring a giant blue serpent with a tree growing from its body, a red-robed figure with a large eye for a head perched on its back, and a black hooded figure standing below a wooden sign that reads 'NO'.

2678.title: Cosmic Creature and Cat
2678.description: A large blue multi-eyed cosmic creature with a glowing body stands in the center of a vibrant surreal scene, observed by a white and gold patterned cat touching its leg. The background features intricate golden spirals, colorful nebula patterns, dancing figures in ornate clothing, and a starry cosmic sky.

2799.title: Cosmic Fantasy Seascape
2799.description: A vibrant surreal fantasy scene featuring a glowing blue cosmic creature, a purple dragon, a wizard with a trident, and various magical beings on a rocky shore under a starry sky with a rainbow and castle.

2216.title: Whispers from the Abyss
2216.description: A surreal dark painting featuring a giant open mouth emerging from a metallic industrial wall, vomiting streams of fleshy, ribbon-like forms containing embedded human faces that twist upwards into smoky darkness.

2724.title: Verdant Overgrowth
2724.description: A surreal night landscape features a giant green man's head and shoulders formed from living trees and vines on the right, with ancient stone ruins and scaffolding on the left.
